meta.source: Prydwen.gg NIKKE 가이드(Team Building, Meta Teams - Story/Tribe Tower, Teams Database, Tier List 변경 이력) 및 니케 위키를 참고해 정리한 2차 자료. 원문을 그대로 인용하지 않고 우리말로 재구성/요약함. 캐릭터 이름은 데이터베이스(characterDatabase.json)의 title/name_kr 기준. 2026-07-31부터는 사용자가 지정한 니케 유튜버 4인(고뇨/스페란도/에펜바움/김진서)의 최근 영상 내용도 1순위 자료로 반영.
meta.updateNote: 새 공략/패치 정보를 확인할 때마다 archetypes, synergyPairs, counters 배열에 계속 항목을 추가해 나갈 것. 이 파일은 조합 추천 스코어링 엔진의 '근거 자료'로 쓰인다. 2026-07-31: 7/23 패치(신규 유닛 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로, 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉 출시)와 관련해 스페란도(유튜버) 영상들에서 반복적으로 소개된 PVP 조합을 1건 추가함(archetypes 'laplace-maxwell-pip-deck', synergyPairs 마지막 항목). 국내 유튜버 1개 채널 기준 정보라 추가 확인 필요. 2026-08-04: 주간 조사 결과 반영 — archetypes에 'wind-laplace-maxwell'(풍라플/풍맥덱, 스페란도 출처, 맥스웰 기여도에 대한 이견 있음), 'swha-alt-marciana'(마르차나: 마린 스터디를 스노우화이트: 헤비암즈 대체픽으로 활용, 김진서 출처) 2건 추가. 기존 'laplace-maxwell-pip-deck'(피뻥덱)과는 별개의 조합임. (2026-08-07: prydwen 개별 캐릭터 Team 탭 447개 임포트 중 실제로는 5인 팀 시너지를 설명하지 않고 캐릭터 1명에 대한 일반 조언이거나 내용 없는 플레이스홀더였던 항목 72개를 품질 검수 후 제거함.)
meta.cleanupNote: 2026-08-08: 같은 조합이 출처마다 다른 이름으로 중복 등록돼 있어 33건을 병합했다(516 -> 483). 이름은 aliases로, 설명은 note 뒤에 출처를 밝혀 이어 붙여 정보를 버리지 않았다. 내역: (1) 모드·멤버·슬롯이 완전히 같은 순수 중복 26건, (2) 멤버는 같은데 한쪽에만 자유 슬롯이 있어 슬롯 없는 쪽이 완전일치 후보가 될 수 없던 반쪽 기록 7건. 슬롯 구성 자체가 다른 변형(El-Macho의 B1-CDR vs El Ma-chor의 B1)은 서로 다른 조합이라 남겼다.

burstPhase.rule: 버스트 게이지는 I -> II -> III 순서로만 진행된다. 각 단계에서 10초 안에 해당 버스트 타입 캐릭터가 스킬을 쓰지 않으면 게이지가 처음부터 다시 쌓인다. 팀에 버스트 I/II/III가 각각 최소 1명씩 없으면 풀버스트(4단계)에 도달할 수 없다.
burstPhase.implication: 5인 조합을 짤 때 버스트 I/II/III 세 타입이 모두 포함돼야 한다는 것은 취향이 아니라 강제 규칙. 스코어링에서 이 조건 미충족 시 크게 감점(사실상 탈락)해야 함.

autoSkillOrder.rule: 오토스킬(자동전투) 사용 시, 왼쪽부터 오른쪽 순서로 버스트I -> II -> III 캐릭터를 각각 한 명씩 찾아 스킬을 사용한다. 같은 타입이 여러 명이면 왼쪽에 배치된 캐릭터가 우선 사용되고, 쿨타임/사망/스턴 상태면 다음 순번으로 넘어간다.
autoSkillOrder.implication: 같은 버스트 타입이 팀에 2명 이상 있을 때는 배치 순서와 쿨타임 조합이 실제 발동 캐릭터를 결정한다. 상세 배치 최적화는 향후 고도화 대상.

burstSkillCooldown.rule: 버스트 스킬 쿨타임은 캐릭터마다 다르며 보통 20초 또는 40초. 쿨타임이 짧을수록(20초) 풀버스트 진입 빈도가 높아진다.
burstSkillCooldown.implication: 버스트 I/II 캐릭터는 쿨타임 20초 여부가 '풀버스트 안정성' 점수의 핵심 요소. characterDatabase.json의 skills[].cd 값을 그대로 활용 가능.

cdr.concept: CDR(Cooldown Reduction, 쿨타임 감소)은 아군 버스트/스킬 쿨타임을 줄여주는 효과로, 풀버스트 사이클 속도를 좌우하는 핵심 자원. 기본공격 트리거형(D: 킬러 와이프, 루주), 버스트 트리거형(솔린: 프로스트 티켓, 도로시) 등 발동 조건이 캐릭터마다 다름.
cdr.implication: 팀에 CDR 제공 캐릭터가 최소 1명 있는지가 고티어 조합의 필수 조건 중 하나로 자주 언급됨. 스코어링에서 CDR 보유 여부를 가산 요소로 넣을 것.

formations.2-1-2: 버스트I 2명 + 버스트II 1명 + 버스트III 2명. 유연하고 안정적이며 초반/자원이 부족할 때 기본형. 특정 무기 특화 조합에도 적합(서포터가 더 필요하므로).
formations.1-1-3: 버스트I 1명 + 버스트II 1명 + 버스트III 3명. 화력은 극대화되지만 버스트I/II가 최상급이 아니면 생존력이 부족해짐. 고investment 팀에 적합.

elementCycle.rule: 물이 불에게, 불이 바람에게, 바람이 철에게, 철이 전기에게, 전기가 물에게 상성 우위(피해량 +10%)를 가지는 순환 구조. 상성 보너스는 10%로 비교적 작아서 버스트 궁합/CDR/역할 구성보다 우선순위가 낮음.
elementCycle.implication: 스코어링에서 원소 상성은 가벼운 보너스 가중치로만 반영하고, 절대적 기준으로 삼지 않을 것.

archetypes.name: 홍련: 흑영(SBS) 원맨아미
archetypes.note: 저페널티 구간 최강 화면 클리어형 캐릭터. 한 타겟을 맞히면 화면 전체가 정리되는 광역 전이 효과가 핵심.
archetypes.name_ja: 紅蓮：ブラックシャドウ（SBS）ワンマンアーミー
archetypes.note_en: The strongest screen-clearing character in low-penalty brackets. The key is her wide-area transfer effect that wipes the whole screen once she hits a single target.
archetypes.note_ja: 低ペナルティ帯で最強の画面クリア型キャラ。1体に当てると画面全体が片付く広範囲の伝播効果が核心。

archetypes.name: 크라운(+티아+나가 대체)
archetypes.note: 크라운은 '티아+나가' 아키타입의 상위호환이자 대체재입니다 — 같은 역할(버스트II 코어)을 더 잘 수행하므로, 크라운을 보유하고 있다면 이 조합에 티아+나가를 추가로 넣지 마세요. 특히 나가는 버스트II를 크라운이 담당하게 되면 자신의 버스트 스킬(쿨타임 20초, 크라운과 동일)이 실제로 발동할 타이밍을 얻지 못해 토템(1/2스킬 상시 효과만 남는 역할)으로 전환되는데, 이 경우 나가와의 궁합에만 의존하는 티아를 넣을 근거도 함께 사라집니다. 티아+나가는 크라운이 로스터에 없을 때만 대신 채택하는 조합입니다. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "The King of all units, come to make Campaign easy"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Crown for both Bossing or Campaign
aliases: The King of all units, come to make Campaign easy
archetypes.name_ja: クラウン（ティア＋ナガの代替）
archetypes.note_en: Crown is a straight upgrade over, and a replacement for, the "Tia + Naga" archetype — she does the same job (Burst 2 core) better, so if you own Crown, do not add Tia + Naga on top of this team. In particular, once Crown takes over Burst 2, Naga never gets the timing to actually fire her own Burst Skill (20s cooldown, the same as Crown's) and converts into a totem (only the permanent effects of Skills 1 and 2 remain) — and in that case the reason to field Tia, who depends solely on her synergy with Naga, disappears as well. Tia + Naga is only adopted as a substitute when Crown is not in your roster. [The same team described by another source — "The King of all units, come to make Campaign easy"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Crown for both Bossing or Campaign
archetypes.note_ja: クラウンは「ティア＋ナガ」アーキタイプの上位互換であり代替でもある — 同じ役割（バーストIIのコア）をより良く果たすため、クラウンを所持しているならこの編成にティア＋ナガを追加で入れないこと。特にナガは、バーストIIをクラウンが担当するようになると自分のバーストスキル（クールタイム20秒、クラウンと同じ）が実際に発動するタイミングを得られず、トーテム（スキル1・2の常時効果だけが残る役割）に転じる。この場合、ナガとの相性だけに依存するティアを入れる根拠も一緒に消える。ティア＋ナガはクラウンがロスターにいないときにのみ代わりに採用する編成だ。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "The King of all units, come to make Campaign easy"］［Source: prydwen.gg character page］General team comp for Crown for both Bossing or Campaign

archetypes.name: 이자벨+아르카나 전기/철 보스전 코어
archetypes.note: 안니스: 스타, 신데렐라/신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브와 함께 전기 약점/철 약점 보스전에서 핵심 조합으로 꼽히는 페어.
archetypes.name_ja: イサベル＋アルカナ 電撃／鉄甲ボス戦コア
archetypes.note_en: A pair counted as a core combination for Electric-weak and Iron-weak boss fights, together with Anis: Star and Cinderella / Cinderella: Crystal Wave.
archetypes.note_ja: アニス：スター、シンデレラ／シンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブとともに、電撃弱点・鉄甲弱点のボス戦で中核の編成として挙げられるペア。

archetypes.name: 나가는 신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브 전용
archetypes.note: 나가는 코어 데미지 증뎁이라 스킬뎀 위주인 스노우화이트/SBS 등과는 궁합이 나쁘고, 코어뎀 스케일링하는 신데렐라: 크리스탈웨이브와 조합했을 때만 진가를 발휘함.
archetypes.name_en: Naga is exclusively for Cinderella: Crystal Wave
archetypes.name_ja: ナガはシンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブ専用
archetypes.note_en: Naga's debuff increases core damage taken, so she has poor synergy with skill-damage-focused units such as Snow White and SBS, and only shows her true worth when paired with Cinderella: Crystal Wave, who scales off core damage.
archetypes.note_ja: ナガはコアダメージ増加のデバフなので、スキルダメージ主体のスノーホワイトやSBSなどとは相性が悪く、コアダメージでスケーリングするシンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブと組んだときにのみ真価を発揮する。

archetypes.name: 즈바이(트레저)+민트
archetypes.note: 즈바이 트레저의 약점(크리티컬 확률/피해 부족)을 민트의 버프가 정확히 보완해줘서 최상급 페어링으로 평가됨.
archetypes.name_ja: ツバイ（宝もの）＋ミント
archetypes.note_en: Mint's buffs cover exactly what Treasure Zwei lacks (crit rate and crit damage), which is why the pairing is rated top class.
archetypes.note_ja: 宝ものツバイの弱点（クリティカル確率／ダメージの不足）をミントのバフがちょうど補ってくれるため、最上級のペアリングと評価される。

archetypes.name: 델타: 닌자시프+크라운
archetypes.note: 델타가 받는피해 증가 디버프를 걸어 크라운의 S2를 반복 발동시키는 연계.
archetypes.name_ja: デルタ：ニンジャシーフ＋クラウン
archetypes.note_en: A chain where Delta applies a damage-taken-increase debuff to trigger Crown's Skill 2 repeatedly.
archetypes.note_ja: デルタが被ダメージ増加のデバフをかけ、クラウンのスキル2を繰り返し発動させる連携。

archetypes.name: 택티컬 엠마+택티컬 은화
archetypes.note: 고정 데미지(참데미지) 버프를 주고받는 듀오. 혼자서는 약하지만 둘이 묶이면 베스티: 택티컬 업그레이드와 함께 PvP에서 순간 폭딜을 낼 수 있음.
archetypes.name_en: Emma: Tactical Upgrade + Eunhwa: Tactical Upgrade
archetypes.name_ja: エマ：タクティカル・アップ＋ウンファ：タクティカル・アップ
archetypes.note_en: A duo that trades fixed-damage (true damage) buffs with each other. Weak alone, but bound together they can put out burst damage in PvP alongside Vesti: Tactical Upgrade.
archetypes.note_ja: 固定ダメージ（真のダメージ）バフをやり取りするデュオ。単独では弱いが、2人を組ませるとベスティー：タクティカル・アップとともにPvPで瞬間的な爆発ダメージを出せる。

archetypes.name: 베스갓의 바람 속성 카운터
archetypes.note: PvP에서 방어 무시 데미지 때문에 바람 속성 캐릭터들이 특히 쉽게 저격당함(레이 아야나미: 잠정판, 홍련 등이 취약 사례로 언급).
archetypes.name_ja: ベスゴッドの風圧属性カウンター
archetypes.note_en: In PvP, Wind characters are especially easy to snipe because of her DEF-ignoring damage (Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name) and Scarlet are cited as vulnerable examples).
archetypes.note_ja: PvPでは防御無視ダメージのため風圧属性のキャラが特に狙撃されやすい（アヤナミレイ(仮称)や紅蓮などが脆弱な例として挙げられている）。

archetypes.name: 불멸(인돔) 캐릭터군의 즉사기 카운터
archetypes.note: PvP에서 즉사급 버스트 데미지를 막는 핵심 수단이 이 캐릭터들의 무적/불멸 효과. 이들을 상대하려면 지연발동 공격이나 무적 관통 수단이 필요.
archetypes.name_en: The Indomitability group as a counter to instant-kill bursts
archetypes.name_ja: 不滅（インドミタビリティ）勢の即死技カウンター
archetypes.note_en: In PvP, the key means of stopping instant-kill-class burst damage is the invulnerability/indomitability effects these characters bring. To fight through them you need delayed-trigger attacks or a way to pierce invulnerability.
archetypes.note_ja: PvPで即死級のバーストダメージを防ぐ核心的な手段が、これらのキャラの無敵／不滅効果だ。彼女たちを相手にするには遅延発動の攻撃や無敵貫通の手段が必要になる。

archetypes.name: 2RL 인스턴트 누크(홍련+레드후드B1+트리나)
archetypes.note: 레드후드B1의 공격력 버프와 트리나의 버프를 홍련에게 몰아줘서 상대가 대응하기 전에 순삭시키는 PvP 초반 러시형 조합. RL(로켓런처) 무기가 2번 발사하면 버스트 게이지가 가득 차는 특성을 활용.
archetypes.name_en: 2RL Instant Nuke (Scarlet + Red Hood B1 + Trina)
archetypes.name_ja: 2RLインスタントニューク（紅蓮＋レッドフードB1＋トリナ）
archetypes.note_en: A PvP early-rush team that funnels Red Hood B1's ATK buff and Trina's buff into Scarlet to delete the opponent before they can respond. It exploits the property that rocket launcher (RL) weapons fill the burst gauge after two shots.
archetypes.note_ja: レッドフードB1の攻撃力バフとトリナのバフを紅蓮に集中させ、相手が対応する前に瞬殺するPvP序盤のラッシュ型編成。RL（ロケットランチャー）武器が2回発射するとバーストゲージが満タンになる特性を活用する。

archetypes.name: 피뻥덱(라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로+맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉+루주+트리나)
archetypes.note: 2026년 7월 23일 신규 유닛 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로/맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉 출시 직후, 국내 니케 유튜버(스페란도)가 여러 영상에서 반복 소개한 PVP 즉발 폭딜 조합. 라플라스가 순간 폭딜을 내고 맥스웰의 최대체력 버프가 생존력을 보강하는 형태로 추정. 국내 유튜버 1개 채널 기준 정보라 스킬작/오버로드 세부 구성은 추가 확인이 필요함(2026-07-31 기준).
archetypes.name_en: Pi-ppeong deck (Laplace: Ultimate Hero + Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic + Rouge + Trina)
archetypes.name_ja: ピポンデッキ（ラプラス：アルティメットヒーロー＋マクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニック＋ルージュ＋トリナ）
archetypes.note_en: A PvP instant-burst team that a Korean NIKKE YouTuber (Sperando) introduced repeatedly across several videos right after the new units Laplace: Ultimate Hero and Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic released on 23 July 2026. The shape is presumed to be Laplace putting out instant burst damage while Maxwell's max-HP buff shores up survivability. As this comes from a single Korean YouTube channel, the detailed skill-level and Overload setup needs further checking (as of 2026-07-31).
archetypes.note_ja: 2026年7月23日に新ユニットのラプラス：アルティメットヒーローとマクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニックが実装された直後、韓国のニケ系YouTuber（スペランド）が複数の動画で繰り返し紹介したPvPの即発爆発ダメージ編成。ラプラスが瞬間的な爆発ダメージを出し、マクスウェルの最大HPバフが生存力を補強する形と推定される。韓国のYouTubeチャンネル1つの情報のため、スキルレベルやオーバーロードの詳細な構成は追加確認が必要（2026-07-31時点）。

archetypes.name: 풍라플/풍맥덱(라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로+맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉+트리나)
archetypes.note: 2026년 8월 시점 조사. 라플라스: 얼티밋 히어로를 축으로 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉을 서브 파츠로 넣는 풍압 속성 보스전 조합. 다만 맥스웰의 실제 기여도(엄폐물 회복 버프가 나가+티아 조합과 상충한다는 지적 있음)에 대한 평가가 유튜버 간에 갈려 필수픽으로 단정하기는 이름. 이사카나로 맥스웰을 대체하는 조합도 대안으로 거론됨(출처: 스페란도).
archetypes.name_en: Wind Laplace / Wind Maxwell deck (Laplace: Ultimate Hero + Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic + Trina)
archetypes.name_ja: 風ラプラス／風マクスウェルデッキ（ラプラス：アルティメットヒーロー＋マクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニック＋トリナ）
archetypes.note_en: Researched as of August 2026. A Wind element boss-fight team built around Laplace: Ultimate Hero with Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic as a sub part. That said, YouTubers disagree on Maxwell's actual contribution (some point out that her cover-restore buff conflicts with the Naga + Tia pairing), so it is too early to call her a mandatory pick. Replacing Maxwell with the Isabel + Arcana pair is also raised as an alternative (source: Sperando).
archetypes.note_ja: 2026年8月時点の調査。ラプラス：アルティメットヒーローを軸に、マクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニックをサブパーツとして入れる風圧属性のボス戦編成。ただしマクスウェルの実際の貢献度（カバー回復バフがナガ＋ティアの編成と競合するという指摘がある）についてはYouTuber間で評価が割れており、必須ピックと断定するのは早い。マクスウェルをイサベル＋アルカナのペアで置き換える編成も代案として挙げられている（出典：スペランド）。

archetypes.name: 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 대체 조합(마르차나: 마린 스터디)
archetypes.note: 2026년 7월 출시 신캐 마르차나: 마린 스터디를 기존 스노우 화이트: 헤비암즈 자리의 대체픽으로 활용하는 조합(출처: 김진서). 재장전 시 탄환 2배 + 공격력 대폭 증가 스킬 구조가 핵심으로 언급됨(출처: 고뇨).
archetypes.name_en: Snow White: Heavy Arms replacement team (Marciana: Marine Study)
archetypes.name_ja: スノーホワイト：ヘビーアームズの代替編成（マルチャーナ：マリンスタディ）
archetypes.note_en: A team that uses Marciana: Marine Study, a new character released in July 2026, as a replacement pick in Snow White: Heavy Arms' slot (source: Kim Jinseo). The key point cited is her skill structure of doubling her ammo on reload plus a sharp ATK increase (source: Gonyo).
archetypes.note_ja: 2026年7月実装の新キャラ、マルチャーナ：マリンスタディを既存のスノーホワイト：ヘビーアームズの枠の代替ピックとして活用する編成（出典：キム・ジンソ）。リロード時に弾数2倍＋攻撃力大幅増加というスキル構造が核心として挙げられている（出典：ゴニョ）。

archetypes.name: 오토팀(초심자용 밸런스 조합)
archetypes.note: 힐/공격버프/쿨감이 고루 섞인 무난한 자동전투용 조합. 베스티/라피 대신 신데렐라나 홍련: 흑영, 모더니아로 대체 가능하고 리터 대신 페퍼(쿨감은 없지만 강한 힐)나 D:킬러와이프/루주(기본공격 트리거 쿨감)로 대체 가능.
archetypes.name_ja: オート編成（初心者向けバランス編成）
archetypes.note_en: A safe auto-battle team with healing, ATK buffs and cooldown reduction evenly mixed. Vesti and Rapi can be swapped for Cinderella, Scarlet: Black Shadow or Modernia, and Liter can be swapped for Pepper (no cooldown reduction but strong healing) or D: Killer Wife / Rouge (normal-attack-triggered cooldown reduction).
archetypes.note_ja: 回復・攻撃バフ・クールタイム短縮がバランスよく混ざった無難な自動戦闘用の編成。ベスティーやラピはシンデレラ、紅蓮：ブラックシャドウ、モダニアに置き換えられ、リターはペッパー（クールタイム短縮はないが強力な回復）やD：キラーワイフ／ルージュ（通常攻撃をトリガーとするクールタイム短縮）に置き換えられる。

archetypes.name: 엘리시온 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 광역 화력(라피/베스티)에 헬름 트레저의 힐, 앵커의 HP 저장 버프가 더해진 자동전투 특화 조합.
archetypes.name_ja: エリシオンタワーおすすめ編成
archetypes.note_en: An auto-battle-focused team that adds Treasure Helm's healing and Anchor's stored-HP buff on top of wide-area damage (Rapi and Vesti).
archetypes.note_ja: 広範囲火力（ラピ／ベスティー）に宝ものヘルムの回復とアンカーのHP保存バフを加えた、自動戦闘特化の編成。

archetypes.name: 미시리스 타워 추천 조합
archetypes.note: 리터-티아-나가 '삼위일체' 코어에 나머지 2딜러는 스테이지별로 교체(아인/라플라스, 혹은 드레이크 트레저/퀀시: 에스케이프 퀸). 참고: 2026-07-31 기준 국내 유튜버(김진서)는 신규 유닛 맥스웰: 오디너리 미케닉이 미시리스 타워 콘텐츠 정상화의 핵심이라고 평가함 - 구성 개편 여부는 추가 확인 필요.
archetypes.name_ja: ミシリスタワーおすすめ編成
archetypes.note_en: The Liter-Tia-Naga "trinity" core, with the remaining two dealers swapped per stage (Ein / Laplace, or Treasure Drake / Quency: Escape Queen). Note: as of 2026-07-31 a Korean YouTuber (Kim Jinseo) rates the new unit Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic as the key to making Missilis Tower content workable — whether the composition should be reworked needs further checking.
archetypes.note_ja: リター－ティア－ナガの「三位一体」コアに、残り2枠のアタッカーをステージごとに入れ替える（アイン／ラプラス、あるいは宝ものドレイク／クエンシー：エスケープクイーン）。参考：2026-07-31時点で韓国のYouTuber（キム・ジンソ）は、新ユニットのマクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニックがミシリスタワーのコンテンツを正常化する鍵だと評価している — 構成の改編が必要かは追加確認が必要。

archetypes.name: 미러 컨테이너(전기) 신데렐라 하이퍼캐리
archetypes.note: 팀 전원이 신데렐라 버프에 올인하는 구성. 헬름 트레저를 수동으로 완충시켜 버스트 게이지 회복을 극대화하는 게 핵심 테크닉.
archetypes.name_ja: ミラーコンテナ（電撃）シンデレラ・ハイパーキャリー
archetypes.note_en: A composition where the whole team goes all-in on buffing Cinderella. The key technique is manually charging Treasure Helm to the full to maximise burst gauge recovery.
archetypes.note_ja: チーム全員がシンデレラのバフに全振りする構成。宝ものヘルムを手動でフルチャージさせ、バーストゲージの回復を最大化するのが核心のテクニックだ。

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapi
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very basic team for Campaign. Rapi provides high single target and AoE DPS, while Mod and Helm are used according to the situation. Since both of the Fire DPS are MG units, they can hunt down any rapture with ease because MG units can easily lock on to core. If you need AoE support, burst with Modernia, but otherwise just burst with HelmT to ensure the team lives through anything. If your Modernia is not well built, but your Rapi has great OL gear, you may sub her out for Naga. This way, you basically funnel all buffs into Rapi and allow her to showcase why she is the best unit in the game. This team is usable accross any element! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast or Naga if Siren is B1. Siren may be replaced by other B1-CDR units if HelmT is in the team for burst generation. Modernia can be replaced by Naga if you have a well invested Rapi.
archetypes.name_ja: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapi（ラピ軸のキャンペーン編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very basic team for Campaign. Rapi provides high single target and AoE DPS, while Mod and Helm are used according to the situation. Since both of the Fire DPS are MG units, they can hunt down any rapture with ease because MG units can easily lock on to core. If you need AoE support, burst with Modernia, but otherwise just burst with HelmT to ensure the team lives through anything. If your Modernia is not well built, but your Rapi has great OL gear, you may sub her out for Naga. This way, you basically funnel all buffs into Rapi and allow her to showcase why she is the best unit in the game. This team is usable accross any element! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast or Naga if Siren is B1. Siren may be replaced by other B1-CDR units if HelmT is in the team for burst generation. Modernia can be replaced by Naga if you have a well invested Rapi.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］キャンペーン向けの非常に基本的な編成。ラピが高い単体・範囲DPSを担い、モダニアとヘルムは状況に応じて使い分ける。灼熱のアタッカー2人がどちらもMGユニットなので、MGはコアにロックオンしやすく、どんなラプチャーも容易に狩れる。範囲支援が必要ならモダニアでバーストし、そうでなければ宝ものヘルムでバーストしてチームが何にでも耐えられるようにする。モダニアの育成が不十分でラピのオーバーロード装備が優秀なら、モダニアをナガに差し替えてもよい。こうすると基本的にすべてのバフをラピに集中させ、なぜ彼女がゲーム最強のユニットなのかを見せつけられる。この編成はどの属性でも使える。差し替え：セイレーンがB1なら宝ものヘルムをメイドマストかナガに置き換え可能。バースト生成用に宝ものヘルムが編成にいるなら、セイレーンは他のB1のクールタイム短縮ユニットに置き換えてよい。ラピをしっかり育てているならモダニアをナガに置き換えられる。

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Solohood (CDR + RH Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A very strong contender for the easiest to use Campaign team for players who prefer bossing modes over others, and are not looking to invest into the likes of VestiTU for example. Red Hood's burst generation ensures that the team can get to next burst before Siren's cooldown time. Not just that, but the addition of HelmT as a B3 support means you can do a special combo for players looking to push into higher deficits. While for the first few bursts you would be following the usual pattern of RRH->RH->RRH.., you can break this pattern by bursting with Helm once to heal the team to full (especially useful against Bronchus (farter)), and then using RH-B1 with Rapi's B3 to deal devestating damage to the final boss of the stage. This ensures that the team doesn't die to chip damage and confirms the kill. Substitutions: - [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + RH Variant)"] [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The Red Hood variant of the Rapi: Red Hood + HelmTr team. Substitutions: - (속성: Water)
aliases: Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + RH Variant)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］ボス戦モードを好み、たとえばベスティー：タクティカル・アップのようなユニットに投資するつもりがないプレイヤーにとって、最も扱いやすいキャンペーン編成の有力候補。レッドフードのバースト生成により、セイレーンのクールタイムが明ける前に次のバーストへ到達できる。それだけでなく、B3サポートとして宝ものヘルムを加えることで、より高い戦力差に挑みたいプレイヤー向けの特別なコンボが可能になる。最初の数回のバーストはRRH→RH→RRH…という通常のパターンをたどるが、一度ヘルムでバーストしてチームを全快させ（特にブロンカス（放屁するボス）に有効）、その後レッドフードのB1とラピのB3を合わせてステージの最終ボスに壊滅的なダメージを与えることで、このパターンを崩せる。これによりチームが削りダメージで倒れず、確実に仕留められる。差し替え：- ［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Surf-ing Through Campaign ft. Rapihelm (CDR + RH Variant)"］［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］ラピ：レッドフード＋宝ものヘルム編成のレッドフード型。差し替え：-（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Alice
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A fully built Alice is a beast for Fire-Weak campaign. She scales well with basically every buffer, but this specific combo of Alice paired with Rapi has everything: Burst Generation with Alice, Helm and Siren, AoE Damage with Rapi and Alice's pierce, Single Target Focus DPS with Alice piercing through shields even! A very strong team and probably the best if not the best if not for Vesti's AoE being so useful in later stages where clearing a few small mobs such as Volleyballs becomes a neccessity. HelmT can even be replaced with Red-Hood or Maid Mast for making use of ATK buffs to counter higher CP Deficits! Substitutions: HelmT can be replaced with Maid Mast for her reload and ATK buffs, or Red-Hood for her B1 stage. Siren may be replaced with any other B1-CDR if you do not have her yet. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］しっかり育てたアリスは灼熱弱点のキャンペーンで猛威を振るう。彼女は基本的にどのバッファーとも噛み合うが、アリスとラピを組ませたこの特定の組み合わせにはすべてが揃っている：アリス・ヘルム・セイレーンによるバースト生成、ラピとアリスの貫通による範囲ダメージ、さらに盾すら貫通するアリスの単体集中DPS。非常に強力な編成であり、バレーボールのような小型の敵を数体処理する必要が出てくる後半ステージでベスティーの範囲攻撃が非常に有用でなければ、最良の編成と言えるだろう。より大きな戦力差に対抗するために攻撃力バフを活かしたいなら、宝ものヘルムをレッドフードやメイドマストに置き換えることもできる。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはリロードと攻撃力のバフを持つメイドマスト、あるいはB1段階を持つレッドフードに置き換え可能。セイレーンをまだ持っていない場合は、他のどのB1クールタイム短縮ユニットに置き換えてもよい。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Asupi (CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Asuka is a strong DPS for fire, especially for stages without any shielders. No shields = no one to stop Asuka's teammates from making use of Asuka's core damage bonus for fire allies. Even if there are shields, Asuka deals higher damage to them, making them break early allowing for faster wave clearing. Not to mention, she can even hit raptures through shields thanks to her pierce! Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced with Red Hood's B1 or Maid Mast. Make sure at least one burst gen assist unit is in the team before replacing Siren for another CDR. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］アスカは灼熱の強力なアタッカーで、特にシールド持ちがいないステージで強い。シールドがなければ、灼熱の味方に対するアスカのコアダメージボーナスをチームメイトが活かすのを邪魔する者がいない。シールドがあっても、アスカはそれに高いダメージを与えて早く割るので、ウェーブの処理が速くなる。しかも貫通のおかげでシールド越しにラプチャーへ当てることさえできる。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはレッドフードのB1かメイドマストに置き換え可能。セイレーンを別のクールタイム短縮ユニットに替える前に、バースト生成を補助するユニットが最低1人は編成にいることを確認すること。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Blaze-ing Through Campaign ft. Asulice (Rapi as B1)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Well, we've seen enough about Rapi B3. It is now time to discuss Rapi as B1. Rapi doesn't buff a lot as B1, but she really doesn't need to considering the damage she dishes out. A manaul intensive Alice for burst generation gets all the assist she needs from Asuka and Rapi that she needs to ensure that the stage is cleared! Fire mains can try using this team to achieve high deficit clears for the leaderboards. With both main B3s and the B1 being core focused units (with the B3s having pierce as well), Naga can also assist this team well. ATK buffs and reload speed from Maid Mast also allow for heavily improved DPS. Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced with Maid Mast, Naga or RH-B1. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］ラピのB3運用については十分に見てきた。今度はラピをB1として使う話だ。ラピはB1としてはあまりバフをしないが、彼女が叩き出すダメージを考えればその必要もない。手動操作が要求されるアリスのバースト生成には、アスカとラピからステージ攻略に必要な支援がすべて入る。灼熱を主力にするプレイヤーは、この編成でリーダーボード向けの高い戦力差クリアに挑戦してみるとよい。主力のB3 2人とB1がどちらもコア狙い（B3は貫通も持つ）なので、ナガもこの編成をうまく支援できる。メイドマストの攻撃力バフとリロード速度もDPSを大きく引き上げる。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはメイドマスト、ナガ、レッドフードのB1に置き換え可能。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Breeze-ing Through Campaign ft. SBLice (RRH CDR Variant)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] For Low deficit players, there is nothing better than a good SBS! And who better to pair her with than Alice! Alice provides the single target focus damage that SBS does not have while there is a large number of mobs on the screen. Meanwhile, SBS with elemental damage is simply.. lovely! 2+ years since her release, and she is still probably the best low deficit DPS to exist in Nikke, even with all the new tech we have with units like Rapi etc. But who says no to using Rapi? If you lack Siren, just use Rapi to cover all your bases for wind weak content! She will assist not only Alice in focus target DPS, but also SBS by doing chip damage to mobs. All is well and easy in low deficit as long as you have SBS. You may take advantage of Maid Mast's Distributed Damage and ATK buffs to further buff your Scarlet, provided that you are able to properly burst gen with Alice. Substitutions: HelmT may be replaced by Maid Mast. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Tornado Incoming"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Best Wind team for Campaign. Substitutions: Helm Treasure can be replaced with Naga.Rapi can be replaced by Red Hood as solo B1, Liter, or D:Killer Wife. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］戦力差の小さいプレイヤーにとって、育ったSBSに勝るものはない。そして組ませる相手としてアリス以上の存在はいない。アリスは、画面に多数の雑魚がいるときにSBSが持たない単体集中ダメージを提供する。一方でSBSに有利コードダメージが乗ると、それはもう見事だ。実装から2年以上が経ち、ラピのような新しいユニットの技術が出そろった今でも、彼女はおそらくニケで最良の低戦力差アタッカーである。とはいえラピを使わない理由もない。セイレーンがいなければ、風圧弱点コンテンツはラピで穴を埋めればよい。彼女はアリスの単体集中DPSを補助するだけでなく、雑魚に削りダメージを入れてSBSも助けてくれる。SBSさえいれば低戦力差はすべて順調で簡単だ。アリスで適切にバースト生成できるなら、メイドマストの分配ダメージと攻撃力バフを活かして紅蓮をさらに強化してもよい。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはメイドマストに置き換え可能。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Tornado Incoming"］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］キャンペーン最良の風圧編成。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはナガに置き換え可能。ラピは単独B1のレッドフード、リター、D：キラーワイフに置き換え可能。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Auto Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] At this level, this team brings a lot to the table, and unless it’s a very nasty stage where a lot of oneshot mobs are spawned, you can use this team to play automatically. It’s balanced and well-rounded with heal, offensive, buffs. Substitutions: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade, Rapi: Red Hood can be replaced with: Cinderella, the better Scarlet. Huge wipe, strong DPS, and Blanc gives her everything she wants too (HP + Damage increase). Scarlet: Black Shadow is a great choice, but when the penalty starts breathing on her neck, her clearing power is not as impressive as at lower penalty. Modernia: is clapped hard by Rapi, both in single target and AoE, but if you don’t have Rapi, Modernia is still very good. Incase you don't have Liter, of course you pick Siren here. But if you don't even have Siren. Pepper is a decent healer with high offensive power. She doesn’t reduce cooldown, but she heals a lot with her Burst. D: Killer Wife / Rouge also provide Cooldown Reduction (CDR) just like Liter, except their other buffs feel pale compared to Liter. Dorothy brings both CDR and offensive power on her own. Definitely a good alternative. Note that Dorothy is a Pilgrim so it’s not easy to roll her. N102 is your go-to when you don’t have any of the above Nikke, go N102. If you are missing Crown, you can use Tia.

archetypes.name: Old "God Team"
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] They used to be the most braindead team in Nikke until Blanc-Noir were released. This team has wipe, strong DPS, CDR, a shield that blocks most instant death attacks once in a while, and a nice passive heal from Rapunzel that doesn’t even require her Bursting. Rapunzel can even come in clutch with her revival Burst, saving your run from a disaster. Heavily out-classed by any other duos, but if your duos are not completely, you can go this route. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: Manual Play with Lots of Clicking
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This is the traditional team pushing story. They have semi wipe with Privaty (mostly, just stun), boss killing with Alice (requires extremely high investment but she’s worth), and damage buffers with Maxwell + Liter + Privaty. Problem is, they require you to “aim” manually, and it’s not a good experience aiming those small flying Raptures from afar. Highly NOT recommended, just putting them here as a tribute to the past. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

Problem is, they require you to "aim" manually, and it's not a good experience aiming those small flying Raptures from afar. Highly NOT recommended, just putting them here as a tribute to the past. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] To push at this level, not only you have to fully invest in these Nikkes, but also you have to rely on good Overload roll, and Elemental advantage. By the way, in this deficit, the enemy's defense will feel so high your Nikke deals very little damage, except Vesgod - she ignores all defense! In fact, if you don’t feel like running those teams below, you can just spam this team, it works. Example Gameplay: Youtube Video - Normal Stage Youtube Video - Base Defence Stage Youtube Video- Defence Stage Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. archetypes.name: God Comp #3
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Okay these teams will blow your mind, not only from how you craft them, but also you will say: Is that even possible? Key Point to Note: Red Hood is the Solo Burst I Unit, and DO NOT USE RAPI: The Hood here because she will be B1 version This team can deal with stages by relying on 2, or at maximum 3 full Bursts to pass a stage. When you use Red Hood as Burst 1 only, you have an insanely high amount of attack buffs over 10s, and you can even do it twice before she goes on cooldown. It allows you to bring 2 DPS, which will a lot of times be Modernia + Nikke that matches the “Weak Element” of the Stage. Ideally, the B3 choices depend on the stage, and aren’t as easy as - this stage is Wind Weak, so I will pick Vesti: Tactical Upgrade / Scarlet: Black Shadow Huh? Why is Vesti in Wind weak? It’s because there will be a time when you face so many Raptures at once that your SBS damage is splitted too much; it deals meme damage. When that time comes, please remember praying to Vesgod and she will answer. (1145F for example). You want to study the stage step by step and see what best helps you progress from one wave to the other wave, and what the next wave requires. At times, you might need to i-frame to dodge Remnant Raptures, or hold your Burst while your Modernia kills off Raptures outside of Burst. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Strongest Campaign Team"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If a stage can be cleared within 3 or fewer Burst rotations, you can choose to bring a 40s or 60s CD Burst I unit (eg Rapunzel for heals) to replace the B1-CDR unit. Alternatively, you can add another B3 instead. In this 1-1-3 team, Red Hood will act as a support buffer, replacing the B1-CDR. Do Red Hood rotation 2 times, and after that, you're left with no Burst rotation for 40s. Try to keep a small rapture alive and allow ~40 seconds to elapse so that Red Hood can Burst again. Kill the small rapture and now proceed to the Boss wave and try to kill it with the insane Crown + RedHood buff chain for your B3 units.For more information on this team, kindly visit: https://www.prydwen.gg/nikke/guides/meta-teams/

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］さて、これらの編成は組み方だけでなく「そんなことが可能なのか」と言いたくなる点でも度肝を抜く。押さえるべき要点：レッドフードは単独のバーストIユニットであり、ここでラピ：レッドフードを使ってはいけない（彼女がB1版になってしまうため）。この編成は、ステージを2回、多くても3回のフルバーストで突破できる。レッドフードをバーストIとしてのみ使うと、10秒間に途方もない量の攻撃バフが乗り、しかもクールタイムに入る前に2回それができる。おかげでアタッカーを2人連れて行け、多くの場合はモダニア＋そのステージの「弱点属性」に合うニケという構成になる。理想を言えばB3の選択はステージ次第で、「このステージは風圧弱点だからベスティー：タクティカル・アップ／紅蓮：ブラックシャドウを選ぶ」というほど単純ではない。えっ、なぜ風圧弱点にベスティーが？それは、あまりに多くのラプチャーを一度に相手にしてSBSのダメージが分散されすぎ、笑えるほど小さなダメージしか出ないときがあるからだ。そのときはベスゴッドに祈ることを思い出してほしい。彼女は応えてくれる（例：1145F）。ステージを一段ずつ研究し、あるウェーブから次のウェーブへ進むのに何が最も役立つのか、次のウェーブが何を要求するのかを見極めたい。ときにはレムナント・ラプチャーを避けるために無敵フレームを使ったり、モダニアがバースト外でラプチャーを片付ける間バーストを温存したりする必要がある。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Strongest Campaign Team"］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ステージを3回以下のバーストローテーションでクリアできるなら、B1のクールタイム短縮ユニットの代わりに、クールタイム40秒または60秒のバーストIユニット（回復ならラプンツェルなど）を連れて行く選択もできる。あるいは代わりにB3をもう1人追加してもよい。この1-1-3編成では、レッドフードがB1のクールタイム短縮役に代わってサポートバッファーとして働く。レッドフードのローテーションを2回行うと、その後40秒間バーストローテーションがなくなる。小型のラプチャーを1体生かしておいて約40秒を経過させ、レッドフードが再びバーストできるようにするとよい。その小型を倒したらボスウェーブへ進み、クラウン＋レッドフードの凄まじいバフ連鎖をB3ユニットに乗せて仕留めよう。この編成の詳細は https://www.prydwen.gg/nikke/guides/meta-teams/ を参照。

archetypes.name: Tetra Tribe Tower Team #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] With the release of Crust and Bready, we can now run them together for a very decent and constant AoE blast. Bready requires Crust to trigger her Distribute Damage, else she will have no skill. Crust requires you to fast tap her 3 times from the very start to trigger her buff, else on auto she also has 0 skill. This team is such a hassle to play, but it's indeed strong. Substitutions: You can replace Xlud with Blanc for a more comfortable gameplay but weaker damage output.

archetypes.name: Pierce Heaven
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] When using Red Hood, save her B1 to be used with her B3 and Maid Mast’s Burst at 3 stacks once a fight. Burst Maid Mast every third burst (Crown → Crown → Mast). However, there will be situations where you need Crown to go third instead for her shield. When that happens, Burst Maid Mast at 2 stacks instead (Crown → Mast → Crown). Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with Little Mermaid or Rapi: Red Hood or Liter. Red Hood or Cinderella: Crystal Wave may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood, Milk: Blooming Bunny, Laplace (Treasure), or Raven. Mast: Romantic Maid may be replaced with Naga or Privaty (Treasure) or Helm (Treasure) or Helm: Aquamarine. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Artillery vs Moth
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A high investment, high reward team. Snow White needs highest final ATK than the rest of the team to make sure she gets Miranda (Treasure)’s Critical Rate buff. Make sure every Snow White nuke hits the core and 2 parts. Substitutions: Zwei (Treasure) may be replaced by Miranda (Treasure). Maxwell may be replaced with Rapi: Red Hood or Cinderella: Crystal Wave if and only if Snow White still manages to get Miranda (Treasure)’s S2 Critical Rate buff. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Battle without your King
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] A shielder is needed to survive the fight, which is the only reason Tia is here. Tia needs to Burst to apply shields and requires a second B1 Nikke for the team to function. Since Tia is Iron, you pretty much get the freedom of running whatever you’ve invested in, hence very beginner friendly. Burst Tia to block the slam or shockwave from Ultra. Substitutions: Anis: Star may be replaced with any B1 CDR. Naga may be replaced with Nayuta or Grave. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: AFK Kraken S7
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The team has it all: heals, shielding, damage and AoE (for shooting down missiles), which actually allows it to run full auto. This is made possible by Anchor: Innocent Maid storing the excess heals provided by Helm to survive the attack caused by failing the QTE (red circles). For this team to run properly it is very important that Helm is in the middle and Anchor: Innocent Maid is on the left side of Crown for burst rotations to line up. This team only works at high investments with SR collection items and high synchro level (recommended 381+) to be able to survive. Reaching Boss Stage 7 is also possible if your SBS is strong enough. Substitutions: - (속성: Wind) [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Fully Auto Stage 7 - Kraken is down!"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While we did indeed mention that Anchor’s fate is destined to be to take care of a drunk Mast, we have news for you. Insane QoL update alert! By far the best team yet for an easy Kraken daily run. This team is able to comfortably stage 6 or stage 7 Kraken provided your DPS are decently invested into. With above average investments, players should be able to get to stage 7 on full auto with this comp. Players may need doll investments to survive the QTE on full auto. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］この編成には回復、シールド、火力、範囲攻撃（ミサイル迎撃用）がすべて揃っており、実際にフルオートで回せる。これが可能なのは、アンカー：イノセントメイドがヘルムの提供する余剰回復を蓄えておき、QTE（赤い円）の失敗によるダメージを耐えられるようにするからだ。この編成を正しく機能させるには、バーストのローテーションが揃うよう、ヘルムを中央に、アンカー：イノセントメイドをクラウンの左側に置くことが非常に重要だ。この編成が成立するのは高投資の場合だけで、SRのコレクションアイテムと高いシンクロレベル（381以上を推奨）がないと生き残れない。SBSが十分に強ければボスステージ7への到達も可能だ。差し替え：-（属性：風圧）［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Fully Auto Stage 7 - Kraken is down!"］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］アンカーの運命は酔っ払ったマストの世話をすることだと確かに述べたが、お知らせがある。とんでもない快適性の改善だ。クラーケンの日課を楽にこなすための、現時点で断然最良の編成である。アタッカーがそれなりに育っていれば、この編成でクラーケンのステージ6や7を余裕をもって回せる。平均以上の投資があれば、この編成でフルオートのステージ7に到達できるはずだ。フルオートでQTEを耐えるにはドールへの投資が必要になる場合がある。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Spider Slayer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team chews through Harvester AI like Snow White seeing a fat worm. Snow White will take care of the pesky mobs and solo kill Harvester herself. If you want to achieve a faster run, time Helm's Burst to not hit a mob. Burst Maid Mast every third burst (Crown → Crown → Mast). If Maid Anchor is used, burst Maid Mast with the stronger DPS. Substitutions: Crown may be replaced with Anchor: Innocent Maid or Nayuta. Anis: Star may be replaced with Siren or Rapi: Red Hood. Snow White: Heavy Arms may be replcaed with Dorothy: Serendipity or Cindrella: Crystal Wave. Helm (Treasure) may be replaced by Privaty (Treasure). Mast: Romantic Maid may be replaced by Privaty (Treasure) or Elegg: Boom and Shock. (속성: Water)

archetypes.name: Elysion Tower Bossing with Diesel™
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Introducing the new Elysion Tower Bossing team featuring Diesel: Winter Sweets! In this comp, we use the standard B1 D:Wife, accompanied by the standard B2 MastM and AnchorM and the standard B3 Rapi: Red Hood. Diesel chimes in, replacing HelmTr or XMaiden as Neutral DPS. archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツを軸にした新しいエリシオンタワーのボス戦編成を紹介する。この構成では定番のB1であるD：キラーワイフを使い、定番のB2であるメイドマストとメイドアンカー、そして定番のB3であるラピ：レッドフードを合わせる。ディーゼルは宝ものヘルムや冬メイデンに代わる無属性アタッカーとして加わる。これらの他のアタッカーはそれぞれの属性ではなお優れているかもしれないが、無属性枠としては冬ディーゼルのほうが総合的に良い。差し替え：ラピ：レッドフードはB1に回せる。B1にする場合、もう一方のB3として宝ものヘルムか冬メイデンを使える。メイドたちの代わりにエマTU＋ウンファTU＋クールタイム短縮（ソリンFT／D：キラーワイフ）を使うこともできるが、わずかに劣る。

archetypes.name: Mermaid Enjoyer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Velvet boosts Siren so much that you can now make an entire team around her! Velvet burst deals a considerable amount of damage while consuming a lot of ammo to proc Siren's Skill 2 more frequently. Substitutions: PrivatyT may be replaced with HelmT. Crown may be replaced with Burst 1 Red Hood or Label. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］ベルベットがセイレーンを大きく強化するので、今や彼女を中心に編成を丸ごと組める。ベルベットのバーストはかなりのダメージを出しつつ弾薬を大量に消費し、セイレーンのスキル2をより頻繁に発動させる。差し替え：宝ものプリバティは宝ものヘルムに置き換え可能。クラウンはバーストIのレッドフードまたはラベルに置き換え可能。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Tetra Best Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team has 4 different ele which means you are only vulnerable against Wind weak ele shield. In that case, replacing duo Idols with duo Bunny (they are Wind ele) will do. Slot in Moran when you fight unavoidable damage dealer like Black Snake, Ziz or Nihilister. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Tribe Tower Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Tetra Idols"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Idol version for Tetra tower. They are very easy to use and buffing 2 Piercers by a lot. The fun part is, this team has 4/5 elements, so only against Wind-weak stage with elemental shield, you need to swap team

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］この編成は4属性を備えているので、弱点になるのは風圧弱点の属性シールドだけだ。その場合はアイドルデュオをバニーデュオ（風圧属性）に置き換えればよい。ブラックスネーク、ジズ、ニヒリスターのように回避不能なダメージを出す相手と戦うときはモランを入れる。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Tribe Tower Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Tetra Idols"］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］テトラタワー向けのアイドル版。非常に扱いやすく、2人の貫通アタッカーを大きくバフする。面白いのは、この編成が5属性中4属性を備えている点で、属性シールド付きの風圧弱点ステージのときだけ編成を入れ替える必要がある。

archetypes.name: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade (aka Vesgod)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] When they first dropped her, people were kinda disappointed with her Bossing power (which is the most famous mode in Nikke - Solo Raid). But eventually we figure out what a monster Shift Up has let loose onto their game. Vesgod is the one woman army. On burst, off burst, buffer has or not, it doesn’t matter. If loving you is the work of God, then Vesti’s work is sending you back to Him. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "베스갓(베스티: 택티컬 업그레이드 원맨아미)"] 버스트/논버스트, 버퍼 유무와 상관없이 혼자서 캠페인을 밀어붙일 수 있는 원맨아미형 캐릭터. 방어력 무시 데미지가 핵심이라 고디시트(페널티) 구간에서 특히 강력.
archetypes.name_ja: ベスティー：タクティカル・アップ（通称ベスゴッド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] When they first dropped her, people were kinda disappointed with her Bossing power (which is the most famous mode in Nikke - Solo Raid). But eventually we figure out what a monster Shift Up has let loose onto their game. Vesgod is the one woman army. On burst, off burst, buffer has or not, it doesn't matter. If loving you is the work of God, then Vesti's work is sending you back to Him. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [The same team described by another source — "Vesgod (Vesti: Tactical Upgrade one-woman army)"] A one-woman-army character who can push Campaign by herself, whether on Burst or off Burst, with or without buffers. DEF-ignoring damage is the key, which makes her especially strong in high-deficit (penalty) brackets.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］実装当初、彼女のボス戦性能（ニケで最も有名なモードであるソロレイド）には少しがっかりした人が多かった。しかし最終的に、シフトアップが自社のゲームに解き放ったのがどれほどの化け物だったのかが分かってきた。ベスゴッドはまさに一人で軍隊だ。バースト中でもバースト外でも、バッファーがいてもいなくても関係ない。あなたを愛することが神の御業なら、ベスティーの御業はあなたを神のもとへ送り返すことである。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — 「ベスゴッド（ベスティー：タクティカル・アップのワンマンアーミー）」］バースト中でもバースト外でも、バッファーの有無にも関係なく、単独でキャンペーンを押し進められるワンマンアーミー型のキャラ。防御力無視ダメージが核心なので、戦力差（ペナルティ）の大きい帯域で特に強力。

archetypes.name: Other One Nikke Army Teams
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The SSR version of our female protagonist brings shame to all current Nikkes ingame. She excels in both single target and AoE wiping, just like SBS (below) without the distributing damage fallback. She can even help you as a decent B1 CDR when you lack a proper team and just have her + another One Nikke Army below. Disadvantage? Require your device to run at 60 FPS consistently. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "라피: 레드 후드 원맨아미"] 단일 타겟/광역 모두 강력한 원맨아미형 딜러. 버스트I 쿨감 역할도 겸할 수 있음. 프레임 드랍 시 성능이 급락하는 단점.
archetypes.name_ja: Other One Nikke Army Teams（その他のワンニケアーミー編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The SSR version of our female protagonist brings shame to all current Nikkes ingame. She excels in both single target and AoE wiping, just like SBS (below) without the distributing damage fallback. She can even help you as a decent B1 CDR when you lack a proper team and just have her + another One Nikke Army below. Disadvantage? Require your device to run at 60 FPS consistently. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [The same team described by another source — "Rapi: Red Hood one-woman army"] A one-woman-army dealer strong at both single target and AoE. She can double as a Burst 1 cooldown-reduction role. Her drawback is that her performance drops sharply when the frame rate dips.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］我らが女性主人公のSSR版は、現在ゲーム内にいるすべてのニケに恥をかかせる。彼女は単体でも範囲殲滅でも優秀で、SBS（下記）と同じでありながら分配ダメージという保険がない。まともな編成が組めず、彼女＋下記の別のワンニケアーミーしかいないときには、そこそこのB1クールタイム短縮役としても助けてくれる。欠点は？デバイスが常時60 FPSで動く必要があること。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — 「ラピ：レッドフードのワンマンアーミー」］単体でも範囲でも強力なワンマンアーミー型アタッカー。バーストIのクールタイム短縮役も兼ねられる。フレームレートが落ちると性能が急落する欠点がある。

archetypes.name: Mint-ka Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The latest duo, they are insanely strong with a lot of buffs which vibes well with meta DPS too, and if your B1 is Anis Sparkling Star, it's set in stone Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "민트카(민트+프리카)"] 강력한 버프 듀오. 다만 실드/1차 풀버스트 화력이 약해 두 캐릭터가 세트로 묶여야만 제 성능이 나오는 경직적인 조합. 버스트I로 안니스: 스파클링 서머를 쓰면 시너지가 배가됨.
archetypes.name_ja: Mint-ka Team（ミンプリ編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] The latest duo, they are insanely strong with a lot of buffs which vibes well with meta DPS too, and if your B1 is Anis Sparkling Star, it's set in stone Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [The same team described by another source — "Mint-ka (Mint + Prika)"] A powerful buff duo. However, their shield and first-Full-Burst damage are weak, so it is a rigid pairing that only performs when both are fielded as a set. Using Anis: Sparkling Summer as the Burst 1 doubles the synergy.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］最新のデュオで、大量のバフを持ち非常に強力。メタのアタッカーとも噛み合いがよく、B1がアニス：スパークリングサマーなら盤石だ。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — 「ミンプリ（ミント＋プリカ）」］強力なバフデュオ。ただしシールドと最初のフルバースト火力が弱く、2人をセットで組んで初めて性能が出る硬直的な編成。バーストIにアニス：スパークリングサマーを使うとシナジーが倍増する。

archetypes.name: El Ma-chor
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] There were once Blanc and Noir, but let’s be real, they are outclassed heavily by this duo. El Ma-chor gives way stronger buff unconditionally, strong healing and comes with insane reload speed which allows you to ignore Ammo OL completely. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "엘마초(마스트: 로망틱 메이드+앵커: 이노센트 메이드)"] 무조건적인 강력한 버프 + 튼튼한 힐 + 재장전 속도 증가로 구 메타였던 블랑+누아르 조합을 완전히 대체함. 캠페인 보스 상대로 앵커의 HP 저장(스토리지) 효과와 궁합이 좋음.
archetypes.name_ja: El Ma-chor（エルマチョ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] There were once Blanc and Noir, but let's be real, they are outclassed heavily by this duo. El Ma-chor gives way stronger buff unconditionally, strong healing and comes with insane reload speed which allows you to ignore Ammo OL completely. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes. [The same team described by another source — "El Macho (Mast: Romantic Maid + Anchor: Innocent Maid)"] Unconditional strong buffs plus solid healing plus reload speed completely replace the old-meta Blanc + Noir pairing. Anchor's stored-HP effect pairs well against Campaign bosses.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］かつてはブランとノワールがいたが、正直に言えば彼女たちはこのデュオに大きく水をあけられている。エルマチョは無条件ではるかに強いバフと強力な回復を与え、しかも尋常でないリロード速度が付いてくるので、装填数のオーバーロードを完全に無視できる。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — 「エルマチョ（マスト：ロマンチックメイド＋アンカー：イノセントメイド）」］無条件の強力なバフ＋頑丈な回復＋リロード速度増加により、旧メタだったブラン＋ノワール編成を完全に置き換えた。キャンペーンのボス相手にはアンカーのHP保存（ストレージ）効果との相性が良い。

archetypes.name: Auto Team Story
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] At this level, this team brings a lot to the table, and unless it’s a very nasty stage where a lot of oneshot mobs are spawned, you can use this team to play automatically. It’s balanced and well-rounded with heal, offensive, buffs. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.
archetypes.name_ja: Auto Team Story（ストーリー用オート編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] At this level, this team brings a lot to the table, and unless it's a very nasty stage where a lot of oneshot mobs are spawned, you can use this team to play automatically. archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］この帯域では、この編成は多くを提供してくれる。一撃で倒してくる雑魚が大量に湧く非常に厄介なステージでもない限り、この編成で自動プレイができる。回復・火力・バフがバランスよく揃った万能型だ。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。

archetypes.name: Crownaga
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] This team is less comfy, but they can deal way more damage. By using this team, you may want to turn off “Auto Burst” and control burst time yourself, because these Nikkes have very impactful bursts that need to be used at proper time to make the most out of them. Substitutions: Same as above, Rapi, Snow White and Anis can be replaced with above listed Nikkes. And if you don’t have Crown, there’s always a Tia, waiting behind…

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］この編成は楽ではないが、はるかに大きなダメージを出せる。この編成を使うなら「オートバースト」を切って自分でバーストのタイミングを操作するとよい。ここのニケたちは影響力の大きいバーストを持っており、最大限に活かすには適切なタイミングで使う必要があるからだ。差し替え：上と同様に、ラピ、スノーホワイト、アニスは上に挙げたニケに置き換え可能。そしてクラウンがいなくても、後ろにはいつでもティアが控えている……

archetypes.name: Duo Maids Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] At this level, Anchor’s Storage buff will still protect you from being one shot, so it’s still relevant. As long as you don’t die, you will be healed back just fine. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.
archetypes.name_ja: Duo Maids Team（メイドデュオ編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] At this level, Anchor's Storage buff will still protect you from being one shot, so it's still relevant. As long as you don't die, you will be healed back just fine. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］この帯域でも、アンカーのストレージバフは一撃死から守ってくれるので、まだ有効だ。倒れさえしなければ、しっかり回復し直してもらえる。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。

archetypes.name: Pure Evil Team #1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] Surprisingly, this is where you start relying heavily on Crown and Mast instead. Their offensive capabilities allow you to “cheese” through a lot of stages by killing enemies before they can kill you. And Crown even has a cheese mechanic that allows her to soak a lot of damage during a certain window (When she taunts, she’s immortal. Time the taunt well will reward you nicely). Still Vesti will make sure you don’t even know what a wall means. Youtube Video Notice how he timed the Crown’s taunt to avoid the instant wipe phase Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg Team Database］意外にも、ここからはむしろクラウンとマストに大きく頼ることになる。彼女たちの攻撃性能のおかげで、敵に倒される前に倒しきるという「ズル」で多くのステージを抜けられる。しかもクラウンには、特定の時間帯に大量のダメージを受け止められるズル的な仕組みまである（挑発中は不死身だ。挑発のタイミングをうまく取れば大きな見返りがある）。それでもベスティーがいれば、壁という言葉すら知らずに済むだろう。YouTube動画：即時全滅フェーズを避けるために、彼がクラウンの挑発のタイミングをどう取っているかに注目してほしい。差し替え：この編成はMeta Teams - Story Guideの一部である。詳細と使える代替については、そちらを参照。

archetypes.name: Mission Impossible Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg Team Database] How is this even possible? Back when we started this guide, 45%+ seemed impossible, but then we have this Youtube Video This team builds on one basic concept: True Damage. True Damage ignores all defense, a thing which may seem underrate at surface level, but it becomes more and more evil the deeper deficit you dive. Most Nikkes deal 1 damage at 45+% Deficit, with only a few Nikkes who can still deal some damages due to high ATK amount self buff. Vesti is the main damage dealer, with Ada acts as both buffers and semi damage dealer. Takina also buffs a lot for true damage DPS. Substitutions: This Team is part of Meta Teams - Story Guide. Check here for further information and viable substitutes.

archetypes.name: AFK is a thing
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ada fixes the fundamental problem of Miranda: can't give 100% crit buff properly due to ATK diff between DPS. But with Ada, whoever burst ALWAYS has the highest ATK, thus gaining crit rate buff. So during Mihara burst, you afk Mihara. During Ada burst, you hold her burst till last second and release. Very fun team.
archetypes.name_ja: AFK is a thing（放置も立派な戦術）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ada fixes the fundamental problem of Miranda: can't give 100% crit buff properly due to ATK diff between DPS. But with Ada, whoever burst ALWAYS has the highest ATK, thus gaining crit rate buff. So during Mihara burst, you afk Mihara. During Ada burst, you hold her burst till last second and release. Very fun team.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］エイダはミランダの根本的な問題を解決する。アタッカー間の攻撃力差のせいで、100%のクリティカルバフをきちんと配れないという問題だ。しかしエイダがいれば、バーストした側が**必ず**最も高い攻撃力を持つことになり、クリティカル確率バフを得られる。そのためミハラのバースト中はミハラを放置し、エイダのバースト中は最後の瞬間までバーストを溜めてから解放する。とても面白い編成だ。

archetypes.name: Snow perma crit
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The idea is the same: Using Ada to fix Crit Rate buff landing. With this, during Snow burst, she always have Crit Rate buff, and making her burst deal juicy damage.

archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The idea is the same: Using Ada to fix Crit Rate buff landing. With this, during Snow burst, she always have Crit Rate buff, and making her burst deal juicy damage.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］考え方は同じで、クリティカル確率バフを確実に乗せるためにエイダを使う。これによりスノーホワイトのバースト中は常にクリティカル確率バフが乗り、バーストが極上のダメージを出すようになる。

archetypes.name: Guillotine flex team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is built solely for Guillotine, because she requires her HP to be as low as possible, and she needs to do it as fast as possible too. Normally B2 spot will be reserved for Mast, but if you do not have Mast, or Mast is used on another team, then you can use Ade here instead. This team has nice DPS, decent CDR (Sakura S2 level needs to be as high as possible) and a power to protect you from debuff. Make sure that Moran pulls damage away from both Ade and Guillotine, otherwise Ade will fail to provide her ATK buff if her HP falls below 90%!

archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is built solely for Guillotine, because she requires her HP to be as low as possible, and she needs to do it as fast as possible too. Normally B2 spot will be reserved for Mast, but if you do not have Mast, or Mast is used on another team, then you can use Ade here instead. This team has nice DPS, decent CDR (Sakura S2 level needs to be as high as possible) and a power to protect you from debuff. Make sure that Moran pulls damage away from both Ade and Guillotine, otherwise Ade will fail to provide her ATK buff if her HP falls below 90%!
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はギロチンだけのために組まれている。彼女はHPをできる限り低く保つ必要があり、しかもそれをできる限り速く行う必要があるからだ。通常B2の枠はマストのために取っておくが、マストがいない、あるいはマストを別の編成で使っている場合は、代わりにエードをここで使える。この編成は良好なDPS、そこそこのクールタイム短縮（サクラのS2レベルはできる限り高くする必要がある）、そしてデバフから守る力を備えている。モランがエードとギロチンの両方からダメージを引き受けるようにすること。さもないとエードのHPが90%を下回り、彼女の攻撃力バフが出せなくなる。

archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Wind team with Ade. Popular flex choices can be Crust (for cleanse against annoying bosses like Thermite in Union Raids), or can usually be buffers like HelmT, or even off-burst DPS units like Mihara: Bonding Chain. Substitutions: Scarlet Black Shadow may be replaced by Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name). Asuka: Wille may be replaced by Alice. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Electric Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Mari gets directly replaced here in the B2 slot as Ade takes over her job. Ade provides a new element option to the popular Cindy Electric team, and in general is a stronger option even against neutral elements. This is because she is able to buff non-pierce units better than Mari and Grave. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Iron Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Iron is her home element, and she definitely has fans here. Simple and easy to use her on this element, especially since Iron is home to many Pierce units. Substitutions: Red Hood may be replaced by Rapi: Red Hood, Eve or SnowWhite. Raven may also be replaced by them, but can also be replaced by Maxwell to pair alongside a SnowWhite. (속성: Iron)

archetypes.name: Fire Ade
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While an invested Grave is the stronger option, a low invested Grave is worse than a Low invested Ade. With Siren taking over Burst gen issues in this MG laden comp, you only need to shoot the boss with this team, and be absolutely care-free. Substitutions: Rei Ayanami may be replaced by Alice or Asuka. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Is That... Is That Uninvested Alice?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Guess what... Now, you can use Alice without too many investments thanks to Liberalio. Usually, Alice needs 10/x/10 and 2 Charge Speed OL to be usable, but Liberalio cuts this cost down to just... Burst Lv. 10 (if Liberalio's S1 is 10). This is a boon to new players. That said, we don't really recommend this team for late-game content, especially since SBS exists and invested Alice is still a recommendation. Substitutions: Crown/MastM can be replaced by Anchor: Innocent Maid. Other Reload Speed buffers also work, but do not use another B3 that might steal Liberalio's Charge Speed, including RRH B1.
archetypes.name_en: Is That... Is That Uninvested Alice?
archetypes.name_ja: Is That... Is That Uninvested Alice?（それ、育ててないアリス？）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Guess what... Now, you can use Alice without too many investments thanks to Liberalio. Usually, Alice needs 10/x/10 and 2 Charge Speed OL to be usable, but Liberalio cuts this cost down to just... Burst Lv. 10 (if Liberalio's S1 is 10). This is a boon to new players. That said, we don't really recommend this team for late-game content, especially since SBS exists and invested Alice is still a recommendation. Substitutions: Crown/MastM can be replaced by Anchor: Innocent Maid. Other Reload Speed buffers also work, but do not use another B3 that might steal Liberalio's Charge Speed, including RRH B1.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］なんと、リバーレリオのおかげで、今やアリスをそれほど育てなくても使えるようになった。通常アリスは実用に耐えるまでに10/x/10とチャージスピードのオーバーロード2行が必要だが、リバーレリオはそのコストを……バーストLv.10だけにまで削ってくれる（リバーレリオのS1が10であれば）。新規プレイヤーには大きな恵みだ。とはいえ終盤コンテンツにこの編成はあまり推奨しない。SBSが存在するうえ、育てたアリスのほうが依然として推奨されるからだ。差し替え：クラウン／メイドマストはアンカー：イノセントメイドに置き換え可能。他のリロード速度バッファーも機能するが、ラピ：レッドフードのB1を含め、リバーレリオのチャージスピードを奪いかねない別のB3は使わないこと。

archetypes.name: The SG Meta Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new meta SG comp, ready to compete against other teams for a top spot in Raids! B. Alice not only provides the basic necessities of healing and Ammo Support for this team, but she also provides the very crucially needed stack count up for Tove! Not only does B. Alice allow for a permanent uptime of Tove's S2 for all of the team, she also ensures that Leona gets to keep Tove's Burst Skill stacks as well. While this team still has its drawbacks, it awaits even stronger SG units to take it to an even higher level!
archetypes.name_ja: The SG Meta Team（ショットガン・メタ編成）

Alice allow for a permanent uptime of Tove's S2 for all of the team, she also ensures that Leona gets to keep Tove's Burst Skill stacks as well. While this team still has its drawbacks, it awaits even stronger SG units to take it to an even higher level!
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］レイドで上位を争えるだけの、新しいメタのショットガン編成。バニーアリスはこの編成に回復と弾薬支援という基本を提供するだけでなく、トーブにとって決定的に重要なスタック数の増加ももたらしてくれる。バニーアリスのおかげでトーブのS2をチーム全体に常時維持できるうえ、レオナがトーブのバーストスキルのスタックを保てるようにもなる。この編成にはまだ弱点もあるが、さらに強力なショットガンユニットの登場でもう一段上へ引き上げられるのを待っている状態だ。

archetypes.name: Reload Heaven
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we focus on overloading our units with maximum Reload Speed, allowing them to Fire to their heart's content. Both Rapi: Red Hood and Alice scale well with this. Crown is likely the better option here despite Mast's alliance with Anchor. This is not something you'd normally do in Solo Raid, but it might be something viable for Union Raid or Anomaly Interception, so keep that in mind! If you use Crown, then Anchor can be treated as an Off-Burst B2 or occasional B2. Substitutions: Crown instead of Mast: Romatic MaidLiter instead of Rapi: Red Hood
archetypes.name_ja: Reload Heaven（リロード天国）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we focus on overloading our units with maximum Reload Speed, allowing them to Fire to their heart's content. Both Rapi: Red Hood and Alice scale well with this. Crown is likely the better option here despite Mast's alliance with Anchor. This is not something you'd normally do in Solo Raid, but it might be something viable for Union Raid or Anomaly Interception, so keep that in mind! If you use Crown, then Anchor can be treated as an Off-Burst B2 or occasional B2. Substitutions: Crown instead of Mast: Romatic Maid / Liter instead of Rapi: Red Hood
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成では、ユニットのリロード速度をオーバーロードで最大まで盛り、心ゆくまで撃たせることに集中する。ラピ：レッドフードもアリスもこれとよく噛み合う。マストとアンカーの相棒関係があるとはいえ、ここではおそらくクラウンのほうが良い選択だ。ソロレイドで普通やることではないが、ユニオンレイドやアノマリー迎撃戦では十分あり得るので、頭に入れておいてほしい。クラウンを使う場合、アンカーはバースト外のB2、あるいは時々バーストするB2として扱えばよい。差し替え：マスト：ロマンチックメイドの代わりにクラウン／ラピ：レッドフードの代わりにリター。

archetypes.name: Elysion Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 2025. The year of Elysion! Ingrid stays cooking. The duo provides a new perspective for Elysion tower meta, and takes over the job of healing, Burst gen and buffing, all at once! Rapi: Red Hood insanely benefits from their buffs, and while the remaining B3 spot is quite weak in terms of pushing higher deficits, we still have solid options and even some synergy in Phantom! We finally have something solid for Elysion Tower, so start pushing that stage you have been stuck on for ages! [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Elysion Tower ft. HelmT #1"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Redefining Burst generation in Elysion Tower, Helm (Treasure) really does it all! She can even act alongside Mast Anchor to provide immense Heal for the team as Rapi: Red Hood destroys the enemy raptures. [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Elysions's Saver"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Elysion Tower FINALLY as a DPS unit as Rapi saves the day for them with her new found skills! Substitutions: Helm is replacable with Phantom, Maiden: Ice Rose or Maid Privaty

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］2025年。エリシオンの年だ。イングリッドはまだ仕込みを続けている。このデュオはエリシオンタワーのメタに新しい視点をもたらし、回復・バースト生成・バフの仕事を一手に引き受ける。ラピ：レッドフードは彼女たちのバフから途方もない恩恵を受ける。残るB3の枠は、より大きな戦力差を押し進めるという点ではかなり弱いものの、それでも堅実な選択肢があり、ファントムには多少のシナジーまである。エリシオンタワーにもようやく確かなものができたので、長年詰まっていたあのステージを進め始めよう。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Elysion Tower ft. HelmT #1"］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］エリシオンタワーのバースト生成を定義し直す宝ものヘルムは、本当に何でもこなす。ラピ：レッドフードが敵のラプチャーを破壊する間、メイドマストとアンカーと並んでチームに絶大な回復を提供することさえできる。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — "Elysions's Saver"］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］新たに得たスキルでラピが救ってくれたおかげで、エリシオンタワーにもついにアタッカーが。差し替え：ヘルムはファントム、メイデン：アイスローズ、メイドプリバティに置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Scarletto's Arc
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Two of the most common pairings for Scarlet in the Scar-Jack comp are Blanc and Anne: Miracle Fairy. Now, Anchor can join them. Instead of focusing on reviving and pressuring enemy adjustments, Anchor heals the team and boosts Scarlet's damage without feeding Jackal. Substitutions: Replace Laplace with Maiden:Ice Rose if you don't have treasure version

archetypes.name: Best Anis PvP Team 1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This Arena team (also works for CA) is a 2 RL comp (with Quantum on Anis, Helm, or Biscuit [or Anis + 1 of them]) that uses HelmTr's lifesteal + Nayuta's heal share to survive barrages of damage, Cindy to block SG attacks and ensure a full chain against Rosanna (who will kill HelmTr), and Biscuit to provide Anis with long periods of Immunity, allowing her to survive until enemy Indomitability ends. Nayuta + Anis + Cindy BA combine firepower to unleash devastating damage.Using Tempering or Vigor on HelmTr & Biscuit is recommended. Nayu must NOT be the second highest ATK in team to avoid being Rosanna-countered. Substitutions: Anis: Star can be P1 or P2. In P2, she procs Biscuit's immune slower or not at all, which can be good and bad. In P1, she is almost guaranteed to proc it.

Nayuta + Anis + Cindy BA combine firepower to unleash devastating damage. Using Tempering or Vigor on HelmTr & Biscuit is recommended. archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］このアリーナ編成（チャンピオンアリーナでも機能する）は2RL構成で（アニス、ヘルム、ビスケットのいずれか［またはアニス＋そのうち1人］にクオンタムを装備）、宝ものヘルムのライフスティール＋ナユタの回復共有でダメージの連打を耐え、シンデレラでショットガン攻撃を防いで（宝ものヘルムを倒しにくる）ロザンナに対する連鎖を確実にし、ビスケットがアニスに長時間の無敵を提供して、敵の不屈が切れるまで生き延びさせる。ナユタ＋アニス＋シンデレラの通常攻撃が火力を合わせ、壊滅的なダメージを解き放つ。宝ものヘルムとビスケットにはテンパリングかビガーの装備を推奨。ロザンナにカウンターされないよう、ナユタがチーム内で2番目に攻撃力の高いユニットになってはいけない。差し替え：アニス：スターはP1にもP2にも置ける。P2ではビスケットの無敵の発動が遅くなるか、まったく発動しないことがあり、これは良し悪しがある。P1ならほぼ確実に発動する。

archetypes.name: Isabel Operates a Shotgun, Remember?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Isabel operates a Shotgun, so by law we are obliged to introduce this team. Tove increases Isabel's ATK and ATK SPD and supplies her with Max Ammo, allowing her to shoot more and harder. Dolla also grants small offensive buffs, but most importantly she is here for CDR. DrakeTr provides ATK buff to Isabel and herself.If you have ever thought about it, do NOT use BSoda here. We have also asked people to try with Leona and MastM instead of Dolla, and both reduce the team's damage against Electric-weak monsters at least.Unlike the other two teams featured in this guide, this team lacks healing, which can be a problem in some Raids. Substitutions: Dolla can be replaced with Helm: Aqua Marine or Leona. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: Isabel Operates a Shotgun, Remember?（イサベルはショットガン使いだ、覚えてる？）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Isabel operates a Shotgun, so by law we are obliged to introduce this team. Tove increases Isabel's ATK and ATK SPD and supplies her with Max Ammo, allowing her to shoot more and harder. Dolla also grants small offensive buffs, but most importantly she is here for CDR. DrakeTr provides ATK buff to Isabel and herself. If you have ever thought about it, do NOT use BSoda here. We have also asked people to try with Leona and MastM instead of Dolla, and both reduce the team's damage against Electric-weak monsters at least. Unlike the other two teams featured in this guide, this team lacks healing, which can be a problem in some Raids. Substitutions: Dolla can be replaced with Helm: Aqua Marine or Leona. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］イサベルはショットガン使いなので、法にのっとってこの編成を紹介する義務がある。トーブがイサベルの攻撃力と攻撃速度を上げ、最大装填数も供給してくれるので、より多く、より強く撃てるようになる。ドラーも小さな攻撃バフを与えるが、何より重要なのはクールタイム短縮のためにここにいるという点だ。宝ものドレイクはイサベルと自分自身に攻撃力バフを与える。もし考えたことがあるなら言っておくが、ここでバニーソーダを使ってはいけない。ドラーの代わりにレオナやメイドマストを試してもらったこともあるが、少なくとも電撃弱点の敵に対してはどちらもチームのダメージを下げてしまう。このガイドで紹介する他の2編成と違い、この編成には回復がなく、レイドによってはそれが問題になり得る。差し替え：ドラーはヘルム：アクアマリンまたはレオナに置き換え可能。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Isabel and Scarlet Befriend Each Other
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A bossing team that matches 2 niche units with 2 other niche units. Does not steal DPS/supports from other already established teams. Scarlet benefits from Trina's skills and Arcana's lingering buffs, and Trina helps with burst gen and survivability. Liter is the best B1 CDR here, although she can be replaced by anyone, including Volume.Do note that this team is unideal for Trina + Scarlet. This is because Trina's Burst Skill is needed to activate her broken S2 effects. Sacrificing it every other rotation for Arcana's will reduce Scarlet's auto-attack damage measurably. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced with Volume. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_en: Isabel and Scarlet Befriend Each Other
archetypes.name_ja: Isabel and Scarlet Befriend Each Other（イサベルと紅蓮、友になる）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A bossing team that matches 2 niche units with 2 other niche units. Does not steal DPS/supports from other already established teams. Scarlet benefits from Trina's skills and Arcana's lingering buffs, and Trina helps with burst gen and survivability. Liter is the best B1 CDR here, although she can be replaced by anyone, including Volume. Do note that this team is unideal for Trina + Scarlet. This is because Trina's Burst Skill is needed to activate her broken S2 effects. Sacrificing it every other rotation for Arcana's will reduce Scarlet's auto-attack damage measurably. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced with Volume. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ニッチなユニット2人と、また別のニッチなユニット2人を組み合わせたボス戦編成。すでに確立された他の編成からアタッカーやサポーターを奪わずに済む。紅蓮はトリナのスキルとアルカナの持続バフの恩恵を受け、トリナはバースト生成と生存力を助ける。ここではリターが最良のB1クールタイム短縮役だが、ボリュームを含め誰に置き換えてもよい。ただしこの編成はトリナ＋紅蓮にとって理想的ではない点に注意。トリナの壊れたS2効果を発動させるには彼女のバーストスキルが必要だからだ。1ローテーションおきにそれをアルカナのために犠牲にすると、紅蓮の通常攻撃ダメージが目に見えて下がる。差し替え：リターはボリュームに置き換え可能。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Isabel Goes on Vacation With Cinderella
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A bossing team that revolves around Cinderella benefitting from Arcana's lingering buffs and quicker rotations. This team features 9-burst Cinderella accompanied by Rouge's, Arcana's, and Blanc's buffs/debuffs and healing. Blanc's Damage Taken scales well with Arcana + Isabel's already inflated ATK + ATK DMG. To carry this team to its greatest, learn how to manual Rouge for fast burst gen, which involves pre-reloading and pre-charging and a bunch of Max Ammo.Rouge also requires heavy manual gameplay in timing her CDR so that it triggers within Isabel's short 5s Full Burst. You will have to count, stop releasing Full Charge(s) before Full Burst, and make sure to land the 8th Full Charge only after Full Burst begins. Rouge's CDR has a small animation near her when triggered—pay a close attention! If this is not your fancy, avoid using this team (속성: Electric)

This team features 9-burst Cinderella accompanied by Rouge's, Arcana's, and Blanc's buffs/debuffs and healing. Blanc's Damage Taken scales well with Arcana + Isabel's already inflated ATK + ATK DMG. To carry this team to its greatest, learn how to manual Rouge for fast burst gen, which involves pre-reloading and pre-charging and a bunch of Max Ammo. Rouge also requires heavy manual gameplay in timing her CDR so that it triggers within Isabel's short 5s Full Burst. You will have to count, stop releasing Full Charge(s) before Full Burst, and make sure to land the 8th Full Charge only after Full Burst begins. Rouge's CDR has a small animation near her when triggered—pay a close attention! If this is not your fancy, avoid using this team (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］アルカナの持続バフと速いローテーションの恩恵をシンデレラが受けることを軸にしたボス戦編成。この編成は9バーストのシンデレラに、ルージュ、アルカナ、ブランのバフ／デバフと回復を添える。ブランの被ダメージ増加は、アルカナ＋イサベルによってすでに膨れ上がった攻撃力・攻撃ダメージとよく噛み合う。この編成を最大限に活かすには、素早いバースト生成のためにルージュを手動で扱う方法を覚える必要がある。事前リロードと事前チャージ、そして大量の最大装填数が要る。さらにルージュは、彼女のクールタイム短縮がイサベルの短い5秒のフルバースト中に発動するようタイミングを取る、かなりの手動操作を要求する。数を数え、フルバースト前はフルチャージを撃たずに止め、8回目のフルチャージをフルバースト開始後にだけ当てる必要がある。ルージュのクールタイム短縮は発動時に彼女の近くで小さなアニメーションが出る — よく見ておくこと。こうした操作が好みでないなら、この編成は避けたほうがよい。（属性：電撃）

Substitutions: Liter can be replaced by Rouge, but you need Max Ammo on Rouge and CDR preparation due to Full Charge mechanic. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Crown Pushing the Limits
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Well, we talked earlier that Asuka and Rei are both amazing buffers and even considered them the Anis: Sparkling Summer(es) of Fire Team. While Rei's kit does not fully synergize with Alice's playstyle, Asuka does, and her Core Damage boost is just insane. No, it's not better than Naga's, but you can save Naga for other teams. In this team, Crown + Privaty will ensure infinite ammo, while D:Wife and Liter will enable smooth rotation. Unless you have a good Alice, using Rei to buff Asuka is also a viable strategy. If minmaxing is not a concern, you can also use Naga instead of Privaty to spice things up! Substitutions: Liter => D:KW or Red Hood
