archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Well, we talked earlier that Asuka and Rei are both amazing buffers and even considered them the Anis: Sparkling Summer(es) of Fire Team. While Rei's kit does not fully synergize with Alice's playstyle, Asuka does, and her Core Damage boost is just insane. No, it's not better than Naga's, but you can save Naga for other teams. In this team, Crown + Privaty will ensure infinite ammo, while D:Wife and Liter will enable smooth rotation. Unless you have a good Alice, using Rei to buff Asuka is also a viable strategy. If minmaxing is not a concern, you can also use Naga instead of Privaty to spice things up! Substitutions: Liter => D:KW or Red Hood
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］先にも述べたとおり、アスカとレイはどちらも素晴らしいバッファーで、灼熱編成における「アニス：スパークリングサマー」的存在とさえ考えていた。レイのキットはアリスの立ち回りと完全には噛み合わないが、アスカは噛み合い、そのコアダメージ増加は尋常でない。ナガより優れているわけではないが、ナガを他の編成に温存できる。この編成ではクラウン＋プリバティが弾薬を切らさず、D：キラーワイフとリターが滑らかなローテーションを可能にする。優秀なアリスがいないなら、レイでアスカをバフする戦略も有効だ。細かい最適化を気にしないなら、プリバティの代わりにナガを入れて味付けを変えるのもよい。差し替え：リター ⇒ D：キラーワイフまたはレッドフード。

archetypes.name: Bunny Power
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ammo Support is crucial to some units in this game, and the OG Bunny Duo of Blanc and Noir is the best way to mitigate it. Noir's ammo buffs suit all of the 3 units: Rei, Modernia, and especially Asuka. If you lack Max Ammo rolls, using Bunnies is a viable strat. Similar to S. Rosanna, Blanc's Damage Taken debuff is a separate undiluted multiplier and hence a major driver for Asuka's DPS. However, Blanc's shield is NOT individual. Substitutions: Modernia => Rei
archetypes.name_ja: Bunny Power（バニーパワー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ammo Support is crucial to some units in this game, and the OG Bunny Duo of Blanc and Noir is the best way to mitigate it. Noir's ammo buffs suit all of the 3 units: Rei, Modernia, and especially Asuka. If you lack Max Ammo rolls, using Bunnies is a viable strat. Similar to S. Rosanna, Blanc's Damage Taken debuff is a separate undiluted multiplier and hence a major driver for Asuka's DPS. However, Blanc's shield is NOT individual. Substitutions: Modernia => Rei
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］このゲームでは一部のユニットにとって弾薬支援が決定的に重要で、それを補う最良の手段が元祖バニーデュオのブランとノワールだ。ノワールの弾薬バフはレイ、モダニア、そしてとりわけアスカという3人すべてに合う。最大装填数の厳選が足りないなら、バニーを使うのは有効な戦略だ。サマーロザンナと同様、ブランの被ダメージ増加デバフは独立した希釈されない倍率であり、アスカのDPSを大きく押し上げる要因になる。ただしブランのシールドは個別ではない点に注意。差し替え：モダニア ⇒ レイ。

archetypes.name: Demolish Unprotected P1 Wind Unit
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A sample setup to quickly kill an unprotected Blanc, Noah, or Scarlet Black Shadow in the first spot. Only Asuka and Rapunzel are essential in the team. The rest are replaceable. Needs Elemental DMG OL to work.
archetypes.name_ja: Demolish Unprotected P1 Wind Unit（無防備なP1の風圧ユニットを粉砕）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A sample setup to quickly kill an unprotected Blanc, Noah, or Scarlet Black Shadow in the first spot. Only Asuka and Rapunzel are essential in the team. The rest are replaceable. Needs Elemental DMG OL to work.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］1番手に置かれた無防備なブラン、ノア、紅蓮：ブラックシャドウを素早く仕留めるための構成例。編成上で必須なのはアスカとラプンツェルだけで、残りは置き換え可能。機能させるには有利コードダメージのオーバーロードが必要。

archetypes.name: Asuka Blanc Variant
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Basic speedy Blanc + Red Hood (Burst 1) team. Lifesteal should increase her odds of winning in most 1v1 indomitability standoffs.
archetypes.name_ja: Asuka Blanc Variant（アスカ＋ブラン型）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Basic speedy Blanc + Red Hood (Burst 1) team. Lifesteal should increase her odds of winning in most 1v1 indomitability standoffs.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］基本形の高速ブラン＋レッドフード（バーストI）編成。ライフスティールにより、大半の1対1の不屈のにらみ合いで勝率が上がるはずだ。

archetypes.name: Asuka x Rei Team Up Again
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The strongest no-Core Wind comp, featuring 2 EVA units. Liter Crown and Helm are the best supporters if you want to maximise Asuka and Rei’s damage. Since reload is quite irrelevant, you can Snow Whiteitch between Grave and Crown depending on the situation (Crown is still GOAT against A.I Kraken though). Rapi: Red Hood is the best if you are looking for just a single team comp and not for multiple teams. If Rei removes Wind-up, Rapi and Modernia might be the staple alongside her even on Raids where multiple teams are required.Both Raids or Wind-weak Campaign should fear this team. It can find itself being used outside Wind-weak Raids, but we will have to see how Rei practically performs first before giving you a 100% on that. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_en: Asuka x Rei Team Up Again
archetypes.name_ja: Asuka x Rei Team Up Again（アスカとレイ、再びタッグ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The strongest no-Core Wind comp, featuring 2 EVA units. Liter Crown and Helm are the best supporters if you want to maximise Asuka and Rei's damage. Since reload is quite irrelevant, you can switch between Grave and Crown depending on the situation (Crown is still GOAT against A.I Kraken though). Rapi: Red Hood is the best if you are looking for just a single team comp and not for multiple teams. If Rei removes Wind-up, Rapi and Modernia might be the staple alongside her even on Raids where multiple teams are required. Both Raids or Wind-weak Campaign should fear this team. It can find itself being used outside Wind-weak Raids, but we will have to see how Rei practically performs first before giving you a 100% on that. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］EVAユニット2人を据えた、コアなし相手で最強の風圧編成。アスカとレイのダメージを最大化したいなら、リター、クラウン、ヘルムが最良のサポーターだ。リロードがほぼ無関係なので、状況に応じてグレイブとクラウンを使い分けられる（とはいえA.I.クラーケン相手ではクラウンが依然として最強だ）。複数編成ではなく単一編成だけを求めるなら、ラピ：レッドフードが最良である。レイがワインドアップを解消してくれるなら、複数編成が要求されるレイドでも、彼女の隣にはラピとモダニアが定番になるかもしれない。レイドでも風圧弱点のキャンペーンでも、この編成は恐れられるべきだ。風圧弱点のレイド以外でも使われる可能性はあるが、それを100%と言うにはまずレイの実戦での働きを見る必要がある。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: The Wind Terror
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Wind element is in business now that they have another mega DPS unit to use. In the end, it’s better to run Scarlet Black Shadow and Asuka Shikinami Langley: Wille together without Rei or even Alice to achieve the highest result against a Wind-weak Boss. This is the best team to use straight up for Wind Weak Bosses. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: The Wind Terror（風圧の恐怖）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Wind element is in business now that they have another mega DPS unit to use. In the end, it's better to run Scarlet Black Shadow and Asuka Shikinami Langley: Wille together without Rei or even Alice to achieve the highest result against a Wind-weak Boss. This is the best team to use straight up for Wind Weak Bosses. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］もう一人の超火力ユニットを手に入れたことで、風圧属性は商売繁盛だ。結局のところ、風圧弱点のボスに対して最高の結果を出すには、レイやアリスを入れずに紅蓮：ブラックシャドウと式波・アスカ・ラングレー：WILLEを一緒に使うほうが良い。風圧弱点のボスにはこの編成をそのまま使うのが最良だ。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Tornado Bunnies
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Bunnies in 2025? Well they still have their use, especially in running braindead MG comps. Noir being a Wind unit helps her cause as well. This comp provides a lot of healing amount, a lot of ammo for Rapi and Asuka to shoot (due to Noir’s + Asuka’s anmo refund). Bread and butter team, use it when you are too lazy to even think. Machine Guns love ammo and make Noir a very happy relevant unit. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Tornado Bunnies（トルネード・バニーズ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Bunnies in 2025? Well they still have their use, especially in running braindead MG comps. Noir being a Wind unit helps her cause as well. This comp provides a lot of healing amount, a lot of ammo for Rapi and Asuka to shoot (due to Noir's + Asuka's ammo refund). Bread and butter team, use it when you are too lazy to even think. Machine Guns love ammo and make Noir a very happy relevant unit. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］2025年にバニー？いや、彼女たちにはまだ使い道がある。特に何も考えずに回せるMG編成ではそうだ。ノワールが風圧ユニットであることも彼女にとって追い風になっている。この編成は大量の回復量と、ラピやアスカが撃ち続けるための大量の弾薬を提供する（ノワールとアスカの弾薬還元による）。定番中の定番の編成で、考えるのも面倒なときに使えばよい。マシンガンは弾薬を愛しており、そのおかげでノワールはとても幸せで意味のあるユニットでいられる。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Off element Raid WAsuka
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Asuka: Wille can be used to high effect in off elemental situations even without Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name). Her damage taken down has often been used to help Elemental DPS to deal more damage.
archetypes.name_ja: Off element Raid WAsuka（属性外レイドのアスカWILLE）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Asuka: Wille can be used to high effect in off elemental situations even without Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name). Her damage taken down has often been used to help Elemental DPS to deal more damage.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］アスカ：WILLEは、アヤナミレイ(仮称)がいなくても属性外の状況で高い効果を発揮できる。彼女の被ダメージ増加は、属性アタッカーがより大きなダメージを出すのを助ける用途でよく使われてきた。

archetypes.name: Common Bay Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has 2 layers of protection: Noise or Moran provides the first layer, then Bay soaks damage. It's a 3 RL team, making it very hard to kill even with 3 RL Scarlet. And 2 RL Scarlet will never be able to kill 3 RL Noise team. The last B3 can be up to your choice, which can be:- Anis: Sparkling Summer,- Scarlet: Black Shadow,- Scarlet. This one is actually interesting, due to the damage share effect, this whole team will turn into a Thornmail instead, with each nikke providing a 30% chance to trigger Scarlet's S2 on being hit as long as Bay is alive.
archetypes.name_ja: Common Bay Team（一般的なベイ編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has 2 layers of protection: Noise or Moran provides the first layer, then Bay soaks damage. It's a 3 RL team, making it very hard to kill even with 3 RL Scarlet. And 2 RL Scarlet will never be able to kill 3 RL Noise team. The last B3 can be up to your choice, which can be: - Anis: Sparkling Summer, - Scarlet: Black Shadow, - Scarlet. This one is actually interesting, due to the damage share effect, this whole team will turn into a Thornmail instead, with each nikke providing a 30% chance to trigger Scarlet's S2 on being hit as long as Bay is alive.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成には2層の防護がある。ノイズかモランが第1層を提供し、その後ベイがダメージを吸収する。3RL編成なので、3RLの紅蓮でも倒すのが非常に難しい。そして2RLの紅蓮では3RLのノイズ編成を決して倒せない。最後のB3は好みで選べる：アニス：スパークリングサマー、紅蓮：ブラックシャドウ、紅蓮。最後の選択は実に面白い。ダメージ共有効果のおかげで、ベイが生きている限り編成全体が「棘の鎧」と化し、各ニケが被弾時に30%の確率で紅蓮のS2を発動させるようになるからだ。

archetypes.name: Stall team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team relies on a huge amount of damage reduction and healing to tank through any type of DPS through to your face, while slowly builds up the damage dealt by 5 RL. It's super annoying, although Anne: Miracle Fairy will give them a hard time due to healing potency debuff.
archetypes.name_ja: Stall team（足止め編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team relies on a huge amount of damage reduction and healing to tank through any type of DPS through to your face, while slowly builds up the damage dealt by 5 RL. It's super annoying, although Anne: Miracle Fairy will give them a hard time due to healing potency debuff.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は膨大な被ダメージ軽減と回復に頼り、正面から浴びるあらゆる種類の火力を受け止めつつ、5RLで与えるダメージをじわじわ積み上げていく。非常に鬱陶しいが、エヌ：ミラクルフェアリーは回復効果デバフによって彼女たちを苦しめてくれる。

archetypes.name: General Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Geneal team comp for Blanc and Noir.
archetypes.name_ja: General Team（汎用編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] General team comp for Blanc and Noir.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ブランとノワール向けの汎用編成。

archetypes.name: General Team for Blanc #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Another general team for using Blanc.
archetypes.name_ja: General Team for Blanc #2（ブラン向け汎用編成 #2）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Another general team for using Blanc.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ブランを使うためのもう一つの汎用編成。

archetypes.name: Maid-for-Bready
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best team for Bready and probably what will be used in Water-weak Raids. This activates her On Hit route, which allows her to perform at a highly competitive level. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Maid-for-Bready（ブレッディのためのメイド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The best team for Bready and probably what will be used in Water-weak Raids. This activates her On Hit route, which allows her to perform at a highly competitive level. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ブレッディにとって最良の編成で、おそらく水冷弱点のレイドで使われることになる。彼女の「命中時」ルートを発動させ、十分に競争力のある水準の働きをさせられる。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Sustain This Damage!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is the only team possible that activates her DoT Route. It is decent but will be weaker than the Maid Duo. We can replace Rosanna: Chic Ocean with better DoT Buffer when the time comes. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Sustain This Damage!（この持続ダメージを見よ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is the only team possible that activates her DoT Route. It is decent but will be weaker than the Maid Duo. We can replace Rosanna: Chic Ocean with better DoT Buffer when the time comes. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］彼女の持続ダメージ（DoT）ルートを発動させられる唯一の編成。悪くはないがメイドデュオより弱い。より優れた持続ダメージのバッファーが登場したら、ロザンナ：シックオーシャンをそちらに置き換えられる。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Harvester is an Anomaly
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new generic Water-weak Bossing team. Harvester has mobs, and Bready has distributed damage to take care of them. This allows your other Water DPS units to freely shoot the Boss. This team can be used to full auto Stage 7 (except for the QTE), given that the other B3 you use is Helm-Treasure for Burst generation. Substitutions: Helm (treasure) can be replaced by Ludmilla: Winter Owner and Quency: Escape Queen (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Harvester is an Anomaly（ハーベスターはアノマリー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The new generic Water-weak Bossing team. Harvester has mobs, and Bready has distributed damage to take care of them. This allows your other Water DPS units to freely shoot the Boss. This team can be used to full auto Stage 7 (except for the QTE), given that the other B3 you use is Helm-Treasure for Burst generation. Substitutions: Helm (treasure) can be replaced by Ludmilla: Winter Owner and Quency: Escape Queen (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］水冷弱点のボス戦における新しい汎用編成。ハーベスターは雑魚を出すが、ブレッディの分配ダメージがそれを処理してくれる。おかげで他の水冷アタッカーは自由にボスを撃てる。バースト生成用のもう一方のB3に宝ものヘルムを使えば、この編成でステージ7をフルオート（QTEを除く）で回せる。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーやクエンシー：エスケープクイーンに置き換え可能。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Let Me Copegg
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A cope team for Bready, but it does work. If you are a fan of chubby Nikkes, this team is for you! You can even add similar waifus like Anis here, with Biscuit in the FLEX spot to buff Anis and Elegg! Adding Scarlet Black Shadow or Quency: Escape Queen in the other B3 spot is also a viable option. Keep in mind, however, that this is one of the weaker teams for Bready. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Let Me Copegg（言い訳させて）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A cope team for Bready, but it does work. If you are a fan of chubby Nikkes, this team is for you! You can even add similar waifus like Anis here, with Biscuit in the FLEX spot to buff Anis and Elegg! Adding Scarlet Black Shadow or Quency: Escape Queen in the other B3 spot is also a viable option. Keep in mind, however, that this is one of the weaker teams for Bready. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ブレッディ向けの苦しまぎれの編成だが、これでも機能する。ぽっちゃりしたニケが好きなら、この編成はあなたのためのものだ。ここにアニスのような似た趣味のキャラを加え、自由枠にビスケットを入れてアニスとエレグをバフすることさえできる。もう一方のB3の枠に紅蓮：ブラックシャドウやクエンシー：エスケープクイーンを加えるのも有効だ。ただし、これはブレッディ向けの編成としては弱いほうであることは頭に入れておいてほしい。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Mary the Water buffer
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Strong team for Water raids. Substitutions: Dolla can replace D: Killer Wife (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Mary the Water buffer（水冷バッファーのメアリー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Strong team for Water raids. Substitutions: Dolla can replace D: Killer Wife (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］水冷レイド向けの強力な編成。差し替え：D：キラーワイフはドラーに置き換え可能。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Mono Fire with XBrid
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the new (and better) mono-Fire team with XBrid, who significantly buffs the output of Rapi: Red Hood B1, DieselWS, and MiharaBC. Rei Ayanami must Burst first because DieselWS wants to Burst second (mandatory). Very useful in Union Raid. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Mono Fire with XBrid（XブリッドのモノFire）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the new (and better) mono-Fire team with XBrid, who significantly buffs the output of Rapi: Red Hood B1, DieselWS, and MiharaBC. Rei Ayanami must Burst first because DieselWS wants to Burst second (mandatory). Very useful in Union Raid. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］Xブリッドを起用した、新しく（そしてより強力な）灼熱単色編成。彼女はラピ：レッドフード（B1）、ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツ、ミハラ：ボンディングチェーンの火力を大きく引き上げる。ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツが2番目にバーストする必要があるため（必須）、綾波レイが最初にバーストしなければならない。ユニオンレイドで非常に有用。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Mono Fire with XBrid & Crown
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The same Mono Fire team but with Crown instead of another Fire unit. Not as ideal but not everyone has Rei Ayanami due to its collab status. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Mono Fire with XBrid & Crown（Xブリッド＆クラウンのモノFire）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The same Mono Fire team but with Crown instead of another Fire unit. Not as ideal but not everyone has Rei Ayanami due to its collab status. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］同じ灼熱単色編成だが、もう一人の灼熱ユニットの代わりにクラウンを入れた形。理想的とは言えないが、綾波レイはコラボ限定なので誰もが持っているわけではない。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: XBrid Punching a Hole in Alteisen's Body
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid deals good personal damage with invested gear and when paired with Tove (Treasure version, especially) and DrakeTr. She shines best against Fire-weak due to elemental advantage. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by other off-burst CDR, such as DWife or Volume.HelmTr can be replaced by any B3. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_en: XBrid Punching a Hole in Alteisen's Body
archetypes.name_ja: XBrid Punching a Hole in Alteisen's Body（アルトアイゼンの装甲に穴を開けるXブリッド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid deals good personal damage with invested gear and when paired with Tove (Treasure version, especially) and DrakeTr. She shines best against Fire-weak due to elemental advantage. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by other off-burst CDR, such as DWife or Volume.HelmTr can be replaced by any B3. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］Xブリッドは装備を育てた上でトーブ（特に宝もの版）や宝ものドレイクと組ませると、本人の火力もしっかり出る。属性有利のため灼熱弱点相手で最も輝く。差し替え：ソリン：フロストチケットはD：キラーワイフやボリュームなど、他のバースト外クールタイム短縮役に置き換え可能。宝ものヘルムは任意のB3に置き換え可能。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: XBrid Buffing ATK-Reliant B3 in Miranda's Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid can be used as an alternative B2 to buff ATK-reliant units, such as MiharaBC, HelmTr, Liberalio, and DieselWS. She can also be used as an alternative if you lack better B2. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by other off-burst CDR, such as DWife or Volume.
archetypes.name_en: XBrid Buffing ATK-Reliant B3 in Miranda's Comp
archetypes.name_ja: XBrid Buffing ATK-Reliant B3 in Miranda's Comp（ミランダ編成で攻撃力依存B3をバフするXブリッド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid can be used as an alternative B2 to buff ATK-reliant units, such as MiharaBC, HelmTr, Liberalio, and DieselWS. She can also be used as an alternative if you lack better B2. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by other off-burst CDR, such as DWife or Volume.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］Xブリッドは、ミハラ：ボンディングチェーン、宝ものヘルム、リバーレリオ、ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツのような攻撃力依存ユニットをバフする代替B2として使える。より良いB2がいない場合の代役にもなる。差し替え：ソリン：フロストチケットはD：キラーワイフやボリュームなど、他のバースト外クールタイム短縮役に置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: XBrid in Campaign
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid doing her job in Campaign, a game mode who glorifies ATK buffs more than anything else. Substitutions: Feel free to use any B3.
archetypes.name_ja: XBrid in Campaign（キャンペーンのXブリッド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid doing her job in Campaign, a game mode who glorifies ATK buffs more than anything else. Substitutions: Feel free to use any B3.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］何よりも攻撃力バフが物を言うゲームモード、キャンペーンで仕事をするXブリッド。差し替え：B3は好きなものを使ってよい。

archetypes.name: XBrid in Elysion Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid in Elysion Tower can replace AnchorM (in Maid Duo comp) or as a solo B2. Substitutions: For solo B2, you need to remove MastM. You can use MirandaTr + CDR, or use B1 CDR alongside 3 B3.
archetypes.name_ja: XBrid in Elysion Tower（エリシオンタワーのXブリッド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid in Elysion Tower can replace AnchorM (in Maid Duo comp) or as a solo B2. Substitutions: For solo B2, you need to remove MastM. You can use MirandaTr + CDR, or use B1 CDR alongside 3 B3.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］エリシオンタワーのXブリッドは、（メイドデュオ編成の）アンカー：イノセントメイドの代わりにも、単独B2としても使える。差し替え：単独B2にするならマスト：ロマンチックメイドを外す必要がある。宝ものミランダ＋クールタイム短縮役を使うか、B1のクールタイム短縮役とB3を3人並べる形にできる。

archetypes.name: XBrid Just Being a B2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid being the BiS or an alternative B2.
archetypes.name_ja: XBrid Just Being a B2（ただのB2としてのXブリッド）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] XBrid being the BiS or an alternative B2.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］最適解、あるいは代替のB2として働くXブリッド。

archetypes.name: Centi's White Adventure
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Centi's main use will be in Blanc vs Blanc mirror match-ups. The flex and B3 units decide the speed of the team, so fill according to your need! Centi's job will be to go against a similar speed team and force the enemy to burst faster! This way, your blanc team lives longer, and you win! Might need rng in Champs arena still ofc ): (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Centi's White Adventure（センチの白い冒険）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Centi's main use will be in Blanc vs Blanc mirror match-ups. The flex and B3 units decide the speed of the team, so fill according to your need! Centi's job will be to go against a similar speed team and force the enemy to burst faster! This way, your blanc team lives longer, and you win! Might need rng in Champs arena still ofc ): (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］センチの主な用途はブラン対ブランのミラーマッチだ。自由枠とB3が編成の速度を決めるので、必要に応じて埋めればよい。センチの仕事は同程度の速度の編成に対し、相手に先にバーストを撃たせることだ。そうすればこちらのブラン編成が長く生き残り、勝てる。もちろんチャンピオンアリーナでは依然として運が絡むこともある。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Safer Blanc
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] CentiTr makes Blanc teams without Biscuit safer to run, especially against TVesti.

archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] CentiTr makes Blanc teams without Biscuit safer to run, especially against TVesti.

archetypes.name: Safer Noah

archetypes.name: Lapluh - PvP Defense I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Noah to protect the team and Soda to stun enemies trying to counter Lapluh with Noah. While this team has counters, it can throw off inexperienced players. Substitutions: SWHA can be replaced by HelmTr.
archetypes.name_ja: Lapluh - PvP Defense I（ラプウー：PvP防衛 I）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Noah to protect the team and Soda to stun enemies trying to counter Lapluh with Noah. While this team has counters, it can throw off inexperienced players. Substitutions: SWHA can be replaced by HelmTr.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はノアで味方を守り、ノアを使ってラプラス：アルティメットヒーローに対処しようとする相手をソーダでスタンさせる。対策手段は存在するものの、慣れていないプレイヤーを崩すことはできる。差し替え：スノーホワイト：ヘビーアームズは宝ものヘルムに置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Lapluh - PvP Offense I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Siren to stun enemy B1/B2/B3 (if possible depending on speed) and CentiTr to protect the team from early pressure. Substitutions: Trina can be replaced by any Clip RL, such as Rumani.
archetypes.name_ja: Lapluh - PvP Offense I（ラプウー：PvP攻撃 I）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses Siren to stun enemy B1/B2/B3 (if possible depending on speed) and CentiTr to protect the team from early pressure. Substitutions: Trina can be replaced by any Clip RL, such as Rumani.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はサイレンで相手のB1/B2/B3をスタンさせ（速度次第で可能な範囲で）、宝ものセンチで序盤の圧力から味方を守る。差し替え：トリナはルマニなど、装填数式のロケットランチャーであれば何にでも置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Lapluh - PvP Offense II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the same as Lapluh - PvP Offense I but uses MoranTr to stall instead of Siren to stun. Great against most Anis:S Blanc Biscuit teams. HelmTr + Liberalio are used to make Indom go to P5, who usually has a weaker Burst. Do not use this team if P5 has a strong Burst.
archetypes.name_ja: Lapluh - PvP Offense II（ラプウー：PvP攻撃 II）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is the same as Lapluh - PvP Offense I but uses MoranTr to stall instead of Siren to stun. Great against most Anis:S Blanc Biscuit teams. HelmTr + Liberalio are used to make Indom go to P5, who usually has a weaker Burst. Do not use this team if P5 has a strong Burst.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は「Lapluh - PvP Offense I」と同じ趣旨だが、サイレンでスタンさせる代わりに宝ものモランで時間を稼ぐ。アニス：スパークリングサマー＋ブラン＋ビスケットの編成の大半に強い。宝ものヘルム＋リバーレリオは、不屈を通常バーストの弱いP5に寄せるために使う。P5に強力なバーストがいる場合はこの編成を使わないこと。

archetypes.name: So Much True Damage
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features 1 big spec: True DMG. Everyone except Moran in this team deals True Damage, and Frima+Takina will provide up to 230% True Damage buff, enough to make this team viable to a certain level. Still, by using this team, you agree that Moran won't be the one using Burst (aka CDR Totem). If your Moran Treasure is Phase 3, don't waste her like this, replace her with other subs or just replace Frima's Treasure. Substitutions: Moran Treasure Phase 3 can be replaced by either D:Killer Wife or Rouge. Even Volume is fine.Frima Treasure can be replaced by Ada Wong, but we assume you have Ada and boss doesn't require you to heal constantly (Frima Treasure heals a lot). (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: So Much True Damage（固定ダメージ尽くし）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features 1 big spec: True DMG. Everyone except Moran in this team deals True Damage, and Frima+Takina will provide up to 230% True Damage buff, enough to make this team viable to a certain level. Still, by using this team, you agree that Moran won't be the one using Burst (aka CDR Totem). If your Moran Treasure is Phase 3, don't waste her like this, replace her with other subs or just replace Frima's Treasure. Substitutions: Moran Treasure Phase 3 can be replaced by either D:Killer Wife or Rouge. Even Volume is fine.Frima Treasure can be replaced by Ada Wong, but we assume you have Ada and boss doesn't require you to heal constantly (Frima Treasure heals a lot). (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成の売りは一点、固定ダメージだ。モラン以外の全員が固定ダメージを与え、プリム＋井ノ上たきなが最大230%の固定ダメージバフを供給するので、一定水準までは十分に通用する。ただしこの編成を使うということは、モランがバーストを撃たない（＝クールタイム短縮のトーテム役に徹する）ことを受け入れるという意味でもある。宝ものモランがフェーズ3なら、こんな使い方で無駄にせず、他の候補に替えるか、プリムの宝ものの方を替えるべきだ。差し替え：フェーズ3の宝ものモランはD：キラーワイフかルージュに置き換え可能。ボリュームでも構わない。宝ものプリムはエイダ・ウォンに置き換え可能だが、それはエイダを所持していて、かつボスが常時回復を要求しない場合の話だ（宝ものプリムの回復量は大きい）。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Campaign Coper
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Just as we said in the review, Chisato can be used as a stage target sniper, assuming you can hit it. With around 40% Hit Rate (2 OL lines on average), she will have spread as small as normal AR, so you should be fine hitting mid to far enemies. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Moran (Treasure) or Rapi: Red Hood.
archetypes.name_ja: Campaign Coper（キャンペーンの妥協編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Just as we said in the review, Chisato can be used as a stage target sniper, assuming you can hit it. With around 40% Hit Rate (2 OL lines on average), she will have spread as small as normal AR, so you should be fine hitting mid to far enemies. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Moran (Treasure) or Rapi: Red Hood.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］評価でも述べたとおり、当てられるならば錦木千束はステージ目標を狙撃する役として使える。命中率およそ40%（平均してオーバーロード2行）あれば拡散は通常のアサルトライフル並みに小さくなるので、中距離から遠距離の敵にも問題なく当たるはずだ。差し替え：サイレンは（宝ものの）モランやラピ：レッドフードに置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature both Laplace Treasure and Ada Wong, which means this team is a 2 True DMG B3 Hypercarry comp. Ada Wong provides healing to B3 and buffs the B3 vigorously. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced by Moran for increased survivability. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_en: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea I
archetypes.name_ja: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea I（鉄甲弱点ソロレイドの固定ダメージ編成案 I）

In this team, we feature both Laplace Treasure and Ada Wong, which means this team is a 2 True DMG B3 Hypercarry comp. Ada Wong provides healing to B3 and buffs the B3 vigorously. Substitutions: Liter can be replaced by Moran for increased survivability. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］鉄甲弱点のソロレイド向けの妥当な編成案。ここでは宝ものラプラスとエイダ・ウォンを両方採用しており、つまり固定ダメージB3を2人据えたハイパーキャリー編成になる。エイダ・ウォンはB3に回復を与えつつ、強力にバフする。差し替え：生存力を上げたいならリターをモランに置き換え可能。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature both DPS Takina and Chisato as hypercarries. Maxwell and PrivatyTr provide the necessary buffs for them to perform. Substitutions: Maxwell and PrivatyTr can be replaced by other buffers/debuffers. ATK is preferred due to how much True Damage Takina can provide (despite downtime). Plus, Takina has no ATK buff.Liter can be replaced by Moran for increased survivability. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_en: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea II
archetypes.name_ja: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea II（鉄甲弱点ソロレイドの固定ダメージ編成案 II）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature both DPS Takina and Chisato as hypercarries. Maxwell and PrivatyTr provide the necessary buffs for them to perform. Substitutions: Maxwell and PrivatyTr can be replaced by other buffers/debuffers. ATK is preferred due to how much True Damage Takina can provide (despite downtime). Plus, Takina has no ATK buff.Liter can be replaced by Moran for increased survivability. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］鉄甲弱点のソロレイド向けの妥当な編成案。ここではアタッカーとしての井ノ上たきなと錦木千束を2枚看板のハイパーキャリーに据える。マクスウェルと宝ものプリバティが、二人が働くために必要なバフを供給する。差し替え：マクスウェルと宝ものプリバティは他のバッファーやデバッファーに置き換え可能。（空白時間があるとはいえ）井ノ上たきなが出せる固定ダメージ量を考えると攻撃力バフが望ましい。加えて、井ノ上たきな自身は攻撃力バフを持たない。生存力を上げたいならリターをモランに置き換え可能。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea III
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A reasonable team idea for Iron-weak Solo Raid. In this team, we feature 3 DPS, but the primary focuses are Chisato & Takina. XDiesel here serves as a debuffer who can make good use of Ada Wong, who also synergizes well with Chisato. Substitutions: Moran can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_en: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea III
archetypes.name_ja: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea III（鉄甲弱点ソロレイドの固定ダメージ編成案 III）

XDiesel here serves as a debuffer who can make good use of Ada Wong, who also synergizes well with Chisato. Substitutions: Moran can be replaced by Liter. (Element: Iron)

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea IV
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team adopts the same idea but uses Takina as off-burst. Takina as off-burst only loses personal DPS (and a small Damage Taken), so using the Burst of another B2 doesn't seem like a bad idea, even more the case if your Takina isn't DPS-built. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_en: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea IV
archetypes.name_ja: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea IV（鉄甲弱点ソロレイドの固定ダメージ編成案 IV）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team adopts the same idea but uses Takina as off-burst. Takina as off-burst only loses personal DPS (and a small Damage Taken), so using the Burst of another B2 doesn't seem like a bad idea, even more the case if your Takina isn't DPS-built. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］同じ発想の編成だが、井ノ上たきなをバースト外で使う。バースト外にしても失うのは本人のDPS（と小幅な被ダメージ増加）だけなので、別のB2のバーストを使うのは悪くない選択に見える。井ノ上たきなをアタッカー寄りに育てていないなら、なおさらだ。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Anti Moran & HelmTr
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is for SpA Attack only. Chisato can cripple Moran with True DMG when assisted by Blanc. Chisato can also block HelmTr's Burst (very common with Moran). Make sure Chisato is linked, and do not use B3 that give themselves a higher ATK that it surpasses Chisato's, such as Liberalio and potentially SWHA. Substitutions: You don't need to use Jackal or the B3 mentioned, but you should protect Chisato and/or ideally use Blanc to counter Damage Reduction. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: Anti Moran & HelmTr（対 モラン＆宝ものヘルム）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is for SpA Attack only. Chisato can cripple Moran with True DMG when assisted by Blanc. Chisato can also block HelmTr's Burst (very common with Moran). Make sure Chisato is linked, and do not use B3 that give themselves a higher ATK that it surpasses Chisato's, such as Liberalio and potentially SWHA. Substitutions: You don't need to use Jackal or the B3 mentioned, but you should protect Chisato and/or ideally use Blanc to counter Damage Reduction. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はスペシャルアリーナの攻撃専用だ。ブランの補助があれば、錦木千束は固定ダメージでモランを機能不全に追い込める。また（モランと組み合わせられることが非常に多い）宝ものヘルムのバーストを封じることもできる。錦木千束を必ずリンクさせ、リバーレリオや場合によってはスノーホワイト：ヘビーアームズのように、自身の攻撃力を錦木千束より高く盛るB3は使わないこと。差し替え：ジャッカルや挙げたB3を必ず使う必要はないが、錦木千束を守ること、そして被ダメージ軽減に対抗するためにできればブランを使うことが望ましい。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea V
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the best Iron-weak SR True DMG comps featuring Ada buffing Chisato while dishing out modest damage as well as PrivatyTr buffing the whole team. Takina must be DPS-invested. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_en: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea V
archetypes.name_ja: Iron-weak Solo Raid True DMG Team Idea V（鉄甲弱点ソロレイドの固定ダメージ編成案 V）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the best Iron-weak SR True DMG comps featuring Ada buffing Chisato while dishing out modest damage as well as PrivatyTr buffing the whole team. Takina must be DPS-invested. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］鉄甲弱点ソロレイドの固定ダメージ編成として最上位の一つ。エイダ・ウォンが自身もそこそこのダメージを出しつつ錦木千束をバフし、宝ものプリバティが編成全体をバフする。井ノ上たきなはアタッカーとして育成しておく必要がある。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Zap Those Raptures with the Electric Girls
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team revolves around 2 heavy DPS but in the final damage charts, Cinderella will always be on top. All of these DPS also share the same trait: having an insane amount of innate ATK buff. This makes Liter inferior to Rouge, who is more ideal for buffing Cinderella. This team works great for both Bossing and Electric-Weak Campaign, provided you can spam properly with Ein and Rouge. Anis: Sparkling Summer’s presence is usually more important because she acts as a buffer for Cindy. Exia (Treasure)/Scarlet can be used as an Off-Burst damage dealer if supports like Anis: Sparkling Summer and Naga don’t fascinate you or are used elsewhere.A variant or two would work best for you depending on your investment; Mirror Container AI is a good place to test them out. Comps with Cindy, whether using Ein or Naga as the fifth unit, have proven to reach Stage 9. Both variants feature Anis: Sparkling Summer.For Electric-Weak Raids, usually Crown will join the strongest DPS (in this case, Cindy’s team). However, outside Electric-Weak Raids, you can choose to use Blanc so that Crown can support other teams with potentially more effective DPS. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は2人の主力アタッカーを軸にするが、最終的なダメージ集計では常にシンデレラが首位に立つ。ここに挙げたアタッカーには共通点があり、いずれも自前の攻撃力バフを異常なほど多く抱えている。そのためリターはルージュに劣り、シンデレラをバフするにはルージュのほうが理想的だ。アインとルージュでしっかり連射できるなら、この編成はボス戦にも電撃弱点のキャンペーンにも強い。アニス：スパークリングサマーの存在は、シンデレラのバッファーとして働くぶん、たいてい重要度が高い。アニス：スパークリングサマーやナガのようなサポーターに魅力を感じない、あるいは他所で使っているなら、（宝ものの）エクシアや紅蓮をバースト外のアタッカーとして使える。どの派生形が最適かは育成状況によるので、ミラーコンテナのAI戦で試すとよい。シンデレラ入りの編成は、5人目にアインを使ってもナガを使ってもステージ9到達が確認されている。いずれの派生形にもアニス：スパークリングサマーが入る。電撃弱点のレイドでは、たいていクラウンが最も強いアタッカー（ここではシンデレラの編成）に加わる。ただし電撃弱点以外のレイドでは、クラウンをより効果的なアタッカーのいる別編成に回せるよう、あえてブランを使う選択もある。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Red Hood Buffer Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a comp that has recently set a new CP record for Crystal Chamber. The gameplay involves using Red Hood’s Burst B1 to line up with Anis: Sparkling Summer’s to avoid sabotaging her DPS (first with Cindy; second with Anis: Sparkling Summer; and then Anis: Sparkling Summer till the end of the battle). Red Hood’s Burst is also effective for Off-Burst DPS, and since Cindy also deals damage during her Off-Burst rotation, Cindy also benefits from it. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］最近クリスタルチェンバーで戦闘力の新記録を打ち立てた編成。立ち回りとしては、レッドフードのバーストをB1として使い、アニス：スパークリングサマーのバーストと噛み合わせて彼女のDPSを損なわないようにする（1巡目はシンデレラ、2巡目はアニス：スパークリングサマー、以降は戦闘終了までアニス：スパークリングサマー）。レッドフードのバーストはバースト外のアタッカーにも有効で、シンデレラもバースト外のローテーション中にダメージを出すため、その恩恵を受けられる。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Off With Those Rapture Heads as an Off Burst DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] As we mentioned above, Cinderella is a great non Burst B3 DPS too. It's a very basic team with 2 piercers and one non Burst DPS. Works very impressively against Electric Weak stages. This team is for Campaign.

archetypes.name: HP Scaling Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Rouge is the best Buffer for Cinderella and 2B - 2 Nikkes who scale on HP. We also have 1 spare slot to put another Nikke here, which can be Modernia or Scarlet as Off-Burst DPS, or Noir to make Cinderella reload less.

archetypes.name: The Exia Coper for the Rougeless
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A tricky team to set up because Mast’s Burst Skill records the two units with the highest ATK in the Burst 2 Stage, while Cindy gains her conversion buff in Burst 3 Stage. For this team to work, then Cindy’s base ATK together with OL must be higher than Anis: Sparkling Summer’s. If you can achieve this, this team is quite good theoretically. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Annihilio Can Only Shudder
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team combines Liter's ATK▲ with SCindy's frontloaded damage as well as NeonVE's medium burst gen with SCindy's. Nayuta, Liter, and XLud make SCindy's burst gen trigger more frequently. XLud also gives Damage Taken. Good rotation has none of them reloading outside Full Burst to maximize burst gen. Don't forget to pre-reload SCindy as this team has no Reload Speed buff. NeonVE + SCindy should be able to abuse Liter's higher CDR cap. Substitutions: Ludmilla: Winter Owner can be replaced by Mihara: Bonding Chain for higher personal damage but less team damage. (속성: Wind)

Don't forget to pre-reload SCindy as this team has no Reload Speed buff. NeonVE + SCindy should be able to abuse Liter's higher CDR cap. Substitutions: Ludmilla: Winter Owner can be replaced by Mihara: Bonding Chain for higher personal damage but less team damage. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はリターの攻撃力アップとシンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブの前倒し火力を組み合わせ、さらにネオン：ビジョン・アイの中程度のバーストゲージ生成を彼女のそれと重ねる。ナユタ、リター、ルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーによって、シンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブのバーストゲージ生成がより頻繁に発動する。ルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーは被ダメージ増加も付与する。良いローテーションでは、バーストゲージ生成を最大化するため誰もフルバースト外でリロードしない。この編成にはリロード速度バフがないので、シンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブの事前リロードを忘れないこと。ネオン：ビジョン・アイ＋シンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブなら、リターの高いクールタイム短縮上限を活かせるはずだ。差し替え：ルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーをミハラ：ボンディングチェーンに置き換えると、本人の火力は上がるが編成全体の火力は下がる。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Cleanse in Clutch
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has a highly situational niche, where Clay is able to cleanse debuffs off from our dps units so that they can function normally. This team is highly specialised for Bosses such as Thermite B or Heavy Metal, who are Wind Weak Bosses but have charge speed debuffs which cause ScarletBS to have much worse damage. Clay's Cleanse in this case helps her a lot since she can remove the debuff and allow Scarlet Black Shadow to function normally. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: All-in on Alice, please!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Forget healing, Alice is the best DPS in town again (given that you are able to spam her ammo)! Infinite ammo on Alice allows her to bypass that Ammo OL requirement and focus on dealing deathly damage to her opponents! If you use Red Hood as B3, you have a double Pierce combo where D:KW will out perform Liter (if both are same investments). This team is for Campaign, and hence RedHood can be used as Solo B1 unit over Liter.

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］回復のことは忘れよう。（弾を撃ち続けられるなら）アリスは再び街一番のアタッカーだ。弾切れしないアリスは最大装填数のオーバーロード要件を回避でき、相手に致命的なダメージを与えることに専念できる。B3にレッドフードを使えば貫通の二段構えとなり、（育成度が同じなら）D：キラーワイフがリターを上回る。これはキャンペーン向けの編成なので、リターの代わりにレッドフードを単独B1として使える。

archetypes.name: The New God Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is the basic structure for most Crown teams. Naga is the absolute BEST choice. Crown + Naga is BETTER than Tia + Naga when it comes to overall damage buffs!! The synergy is clear: Crown Bursts to provide shield to Naga, which activates Naga's Core damage buffs. In return, Naga heals Crown and activates her Attack Damage Buff. With crown's Skill 1 and Burst buffs in tow, they all combine to provide insane, never-seen-before damage buffs to teams! The advantages of being able to use Crown over Tia are simply too many!Rapunzel is a more comfortable/casual choice for when you need a safe and clutch revive with extra heals. One thing to keep in mind is Crown's placement slot. When everyone is full health, the healing effects are applied left to right (P1 to P5) . Hence, Crown should be placed in Position 1 so that when everyone is full health, she receives the heal from Naga/Rapunzel, and activates her skill 2 attack damage buff for us! [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Going behind Tia's back"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is just purely better than Tiga in anyway, sadly.

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］これはほとんどのクラウン編成の基本骨格だ。ナガは文句なしの最良の選択である。総合的なダメージバフで見れば、クラウン＋ナガはティア＋ナガより優れている。噛み合いは明快だ。クラウンがバーストしてナガにシールドを与え、それがナガのコアダメージバフを発動させる。見返りにナガはクラウンを回復し、彼女の攻撃ダメージバフを発動させる。そこにクラウンのスキル1とバーストのバフが加わり、すべてが合わさって前例のないほど途方もないダメージバフを編成にもたらす。ティアではなくクラウンを使えることの利点は、とにかく数え切れないほど多い。ラプンツェルは、追加の回復を伴う安全で確実な蘇生が欲しいときの、より気楽でカジュアルな選択肢だ。一つ気をつけるべきはクラウンの配置枠である。全員が満タンの体力のとき、回復効果は左から右（P1からP5）へ適用される。したがってクラウンはポジション1に置き、全員満タンのときにナガやラプンツェルの回復を受け取って、こちらのためにスキル2の攻撃ダメージバフを発動させるようにすべきだ。［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — 「Going behind Tia's back」］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］残念ながら、これはどう見てもティアの完全な上位互換でしかない。

archetypes.name: Tyrant Class Rapture in sight!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team can prove to be really good for Raids and Bossing. The idea behind it is that any rapture Boss with a "Targets Highest ATK" mechanic will divide its damage dealt to us by 3. Alice, Scarlet Black Shadow and Crown take turns to receive damage. Not to mention, Crown has continuously renewing shields, and Alice has the ability to heal herself!

archetypes.name: Anti-Heavy Metal or Anti-Thermite
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Here Crust acts as either an alternate B2 buffer or as an Off-Burst B2, providing nearly permanent ▲30% caster's ATK as well as Hit Rate debuff cleanse. Since this Boss has a Core, cleansing the Hit Rate debuff will allow you to land Core shots more consistently, increasing damage dealt.If invested, you can choose to use Crust's Burst Skill to buff Scarlet Black Shadow's Burst Skill during her rotation. However, please do mock/check total damage before confirming as using Crown might still be better. If you don't use Scarlet Black Shadow or any other Distributed Damage Dealers, Crust can be fully relegated to the Off-Burst position. Substitutions: Liter can be used instead of Rapi: Red Hood.Grave can be used instead of Crown.Asuka: WIlle can be used over Alice. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Anti-Obelisk (Fire Weak)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Like Heavy Metal, Obelisk also debuffs your team's Hit Rate. Dispelling that debuff will allow your team to land shots more consistently against this Boss, which has a thin body. Since this UR Boss is normally Fire Weak, we use Fire DPS whenever possible. One variant of this team includes Rapi: Red Hood B1 with Asuka/Alice/Rei B3. The other variant has Liter/D: Killer Wife B1 with Rapi: Red Hood B3. Substitutions: Liter can be used instead of Rapi: Red Hood.Grave can be used instead of Crown.Rapi: Red Hood can be used over Asuka.Asuka or Rei Ayanami can be used over Alice. (속성: Fire)

In this example, we use generic B1-B2-B3, but you know exactly what to do if you don't have some.Basically any Boss that has a debuff, Crust can be used to cleanse it so that your units deal damage normally! archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］クラストを差し向けられるボスは数多い。チャタボックスのようなボスは、クラウンやティア、育てた貫通持ちを持っていないためにシールドを用意できず、ミサイルを安定して処理できない初心者にとって大きな脅威になる。デバフ解除を持つクラストがいれば、デバフの積み重ねによる即死を恐れずに、編成としてより多くのダメージを受け止められる。この例では汎用的なB1・B2・B3を使っているが、持っていないキャラがあればどうすべきかは分かるはずだ。要するに、デバフを持つボスであればクラストで解除して、味方が本来どおりのダメージを出せるようにできる。差し替え：ラピ：レッドフードの代わりにリターを使える。グレイブも。

archetypes.name: BREADing in Tetra Tower
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this comp, we use Crust to activate Bready's skills and launch her to decimate Tetra Tower. While not optimal, Bready still has good AoE capabilities and single-target damage, especially with her massive built-in ATK buff. The FLEXES of this comp can be other B3, like Alice, Anis: Sparkling Summer, Ludmilla Winter Owner, or Noir — or if you fancy — another alternate in-Burst B2 like Blanc. Since Bready's Modes last 50 seconds, you can go 2~3 rotations without using Crust's Burst Skill.

archetypes.name: 2 Hyper DPS Not Enough? How About 3?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Ever wonder how much damage a 3 Sustained DPS team deals? Wonder no more because that team is finally here: a good flex Neutral Solo Raid comp. This team features Nayuta as an ATK buffer and screen clearer and Liter as a massive ATK buffer (good for Diesel & Mihara). Diesel gives Damage Taken to Raven and Mihara, who have good off-burst damage.Diesel needs ~2× Max Ammo for burst gen here. Don't let her stacks expire. Substitutions: Nayuta can be replaced by other meta B2 as long as they provide ATK▲, such as Summer Rosanna (enemy respawn parts often), Bunny Ade, or XBrid. B2 with higher burst gen may be preferred over Nayuta even.

Siren is important for burst generation, so there is no replacement for her. She provides a healthy ATK buff, and against Fire-Weak bosses, extra Damage Taken debuffs. Both of these are adored by the three Fire Queens. Siren is important for burst generation, so there is no replacement for her. Note that, since we don't use Crown, Mihara is optimal here because she still gets buffs even as off-burst! Diesel may need 1-2 times Max Ammo lines and to be played manually to quick-shot for burst gen. Don't let her stacks expire. Substitutions: Mihara: Bonding Chain can be replaced by an off-burst buffer like MastM. Ideally, it's not HelmTr because Diesel already has too much ATK DMG. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ブリッド：サイレントトラックは今週実装される新ユニットで、今後の灼熱編成における相方として上位に入る存在になる。彼女はしっかりした攻撃力バフを供給し、灼熱弱点のボス相手には被ダメージ増加デバフも追加で与える。そのどちらも灼熱の女王3人が大好物だ。サイレンはバーストゲージ生成に不可欠なので、彼女の代わりはいない。クラウンを使わない構成なので、バースト外でもバフを受け取れるミハラ：ボンディングチェーンがここでは最適である点に注意。ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツはバーストゲージ生成のために最大装填数のオーバーロードが1〜2行必要で、手動でクイックショットを撃つ必要もあるかもしれない。スタックを切らさないこと。差し替え：ミハラ：ボンディングチェーンはマスト：ロマンチックメイドのようなバースト外のバッファーに置き換え可能。ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツはすでに攻撃ダメージバフを過剰に抱えているので、宝ものヘルムは理想的ではない。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Cinderella and Diesel Making Love

Liter is used for her high ATK buff that pairs well with Diesel, but you can also use Rouge. Substitutions: You can use other B1 CDR instead of Liter.You can also use other offense-buffing B2 instead of Nayuta, preferably one with ATK because Diesel loves one.You can replace HelmTr with an off-burst DPS or other supports like Ada Wong, who might actually be better than HelmTr because Diesel's ATK DMG is diluted.

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］レイヴンやミハラ：ボンディングチェーンの代わりにシンデレラを使う、属性相性のない場面向けの汎用編成。宝ものヘルムが必要なバーストゲージ生成を賄いつつ編成全体の火力を底上げし、ナユタはディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツと相性の良い攻撃力バフを与えつつ弾幕処理も助ける。リターはディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツと噛み合う高い攻撃力バフのために採用しているが、ルージュでも構わない。差し替え：リターの代わりに他のB1クールタイム短縮役を使える。ナユタの代わりに他の攻撃バフ型B2も使えるが、ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツは攻撃力バフを好むので攻撃力持ちが望ましい。宝ものヘルムはバースト外のアタッカーや、エイダ・ウォンのような他のサポーターに置き換え可能で、ディーゼル：ウィンタースイーツの攻撃ダメージバフは希釈されているため、実際にはエイダ・ウォンのほうが優れているかもしれない。

archetypes.name: Shotgun Team 1 - Generic
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Dorothy can go with different teams, one of them is definitely the bread and butter SG comp. Feature Tove (better be Treasure version), Bunny Soda because this team never has CDR. Bunnies provide more shooting time but will have less overall offensive buffs compared to some other supports. Substitutions: Bunny Soda can be replaced with Viper (Treasure) or Drake (Treasure), or even Neve if you have her extremely well built.

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ドロシー：セレンディピティは複数の編成に入れるが、そのうちの一つが間違いなく定番のショットガン編成だ。トーブ（できれば宝もの版）と、この編成にクールタイム短縮役がいないためソーダ：トゥインクルバニーを据える。バニーたちは射撃時間を伸ばしてくれるが、他のサポーターと比べると攻撃バフの総量では劣る。差し替え：ソーダ：トゥインクルバニーは（宝ものの）バイパーやドレイクに置き換え可能で、極めてよく育てているならネヴェでもよい。

archetypes.name: Shotgun Team 2 - Core hits

archetypes.name: Shotgun Team 3 - Drowning in Water
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If heals are not an issue, put Leona and Drake in. You will run this setup against Water weak, Iron weak and Wind weak. For Fire Weak and Electric weak, Doro won't be able to match high Ele Drake/Privaty though, but if you invest your Doro well, just accept the loss rather than using a mid Drake/Priv Substitutions: Drake (Treasure) or Bunny Soda can be replaced with Viper (Treasure). (속성: Water)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］回復に困らないなら、レオナとドレイクを入れよう。この構成は水冷弱点、鉄甲弱点、風圧弱点で使うことになる。ただし灼熱弱点と電撃弱点では、ドロシー：セレンディピティは属性有利のドレイクやプリバティに敵わない。とはいえドロシー：セレンディピティをよく育てているなら、中途半端なドレイクやプリバティを使うくらいなら、その差は受け入れてしまえばよい。差し替え：（宝ものの）ドレイクやソーダ：トゥインクルバニーは（宝ものの）バイパーに置き換え可能。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: 3 RL 3 SG
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] To run this team reliably, you must treasure both Tove and Bay (phase 1 is okay). It gives 3 SG an insane amount of ATK at 3 RL, which allows Soda to wipe most of Nikkes, then they will mow down whatever left with fast AS from Doro, Drake and Soda. Bay will help them heal + protect them from long nuke + prolong team's life by taking most of the damage. Pretty solid team in CA.

Substitutions: Leona can be used in place of Grave if well-invested and against Water-weak, and if she helps SGs reach effective range (wouldn't reach otherwise). BAde can be used in place of Grave but has less convenient burst gen.

This team also comes with Damage Taken and unparalleled teamwide healing. Depending on the circumstances (i.e. whether Hit Rate is more important), Drake's or Noir's Burst Skill might be used. Substitutions: Guilty can replace Soda: Sparkling Bunny.

archetypes.name: Run It Down ft. 5 SGs
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a team for ATK only. The idea behind this team is that you counter a defensive team without proper P1 protection, i.e. to undo their Burst Chain or simply just to kill them before they can retaliate. No, this team cannot reach Full Burst, but who needs that if the enemy is already dead? Alternatively, you can use Pepper/Viper or any other B1/B2 as deemed necessary if you do need Full Burst. Or use Makima if you counter SG teams alike (defending SG hits P5).You can slot in Anis: Sparkling Summer and Privaty: Unkind Maid and replace any of the SGs above if they are more invested. You can also use Laplace (Treasure) because she also hurts right off the bat, not to mention the splash. Ultimately, investments (and element counters) determine damage dealt, and CP is important for avoiding stat penalty from CP deficit. Do pay attention to Burst Gen (if you are planning to Full Burst with this team).

Ultimately, investments (and element counters) determine damage dealt, and CP is important for avoiding stat penalty from CP deficit. Do pay attention to Burst Gen (if you are planning to Full Burst with this team).
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］これは攻撃専用の編成だ。狙いは、P1にまともな防護のない防衛編成を叩くこと——つまり相手のバーストの連鎖を崩すか、単純に反撃される前に倒しきることにある。確かにこの編成ではフルバーストに到達できないが、敵がすでに死んでいるならフルバーストなど誰が要るだろうか。どうしてもフルバーストが必要なら、代わりにペッパーやバイパー、あるいは必要と判断した他のB1・B2を使えばよい。同種のショットガン編成に当てるなら（防衛側のショットガンはP5を撃つので）マキマを使う手もある。アニス：スパークリングサマーやプリバティ：アンカインド・メイドのほうが育っているなら、上記のショットガンのいずれかと入れ替えて組み込んでもよい。（宝ものの）ラプラスも開幕から痛手を与えられるうえ、範囲の巻き込みもあるので使える。最終的に与ダメージを決めるのは育成度（と属性相性）であり、戦闘力の不足によるステータス減衰を避けるという意味で戦闘力も重要だ。（この編成でフルバーストを狙うつもりなら）バーストゲージ生成にも気を配ること。

archetypes.name: 2RL - A Threat to be Reckoned With
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A classic nuke team, but this time with new units running the show! Scarlet gets buffed by Trina, while Pepper softens the Highest ATK unit. Scarlet, Drake (Treasure), and Pepper will also provide immense frontline pressure, making this a very hard to deal with team without using important, high tier units.
archetypes.name_en: 2RL - A Threat to be Reckoned With
archetypes.name_ja: 2RL - A Threat to be Reckoned With（2RL・侮れない脅威）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A classic nuke team, but this time with new units running the show! Scarlet gets buffed by Trina, while Pepper softens the Highest ATK unit. Scarlet, Drake (Treasure), and Pepper will also provide immense frontline pressure, making this a very hard to deal with team without using important, high tier units.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］古典的な爆撃編成だが、今回は新しいユニットが主役を務める。紅蓮はトリナにバフされ、ペッパーが攻撃力最大のユニットを削ってくれる。紅蓮、（宝ものの）ドレイク、ペッパーは前線に凄まじい圧力もかけるので、重要な高ティアユニットを使わずに対処するのが非常に難しい編成になる。

archetypes.name: 3RL - Nuke Assist
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A classic nuke team, where Drake (Treasure) is there to simply provide Burst Generation and slight buffs. Using Maiden or Maid-Priv as main B3 will allow them to deal insane damage once they reach full Burst thanks to Drake (Treasure)’s buffs to SGs.
archetypes.name_ja: 3RL - Nuke Assist（3RL・爆撃アシスト）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A classic nuke team, where Drake (Treasure) is there to simply provide Burst Generation and slight buffs. Using Maiden or Maid-Priv as main B3 will allow them to deal insane damage once they reach full Burst thanks to Drake (Treasure)'s buffs to SGs.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］古典的な爆撃編成で、（宝ものの）ドレイクは単純にバーストゲージ生成と小幅なバフを供給する役目だ。メイデンやプリバティ：アンカインド・メイドをメインのB3に据えれば、（宝ものの）ドレイクによるショットガンへのバフのおかげで、フルバーストに到達した時点で凄まじいダメージを叩き出せる。

archetypes.name: Wind-Weak SR Angle 1
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Nothing too deep to analyze. A simple team that uses E.H. against Wind-weak Bosses effectively. She can be used alongside other meta Neutral Supports & DPS to form a solid team. Good against high-DEF bosses. Substitutions: XLudmilla can be replaced by Neutral Supports & DPS, such as MiharaBC. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Wind-Weak SR Angle 1（風圧弱点ソロレイドの切り口 1）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Nothing too deep to analyze. A simple team that uses E.H. against Wind-weak Bosses effectively. She can be used alongside other meta Neutral Supports & DPS to form a solid team. Good against high-DEF bosses. Substitutions: XLudmilla can be replaced by Neutral Supports & DPS, such as MiharaBC. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］深く分析するほどのことはない。風圧弱点のボスに対してE.H.を効果的に使う、単純な編成だ。彼女は属性を問わないメタのサポーターやアタッカーと並べて手堅い編成を組める。防御力の高いボスに有効。差し替え：ルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーは、ミハラ：ボンディングチェーンのような属性を問わないサポーターやアタッカーに置き換え可能。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Wind-Weak SR Angle 2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of the Siren + Bursting Velvet team that usually uses 3 supports. We replace 1 of them in hopes that E.H.'s personal damage can make up for Siren & Velvet's DPS loss. You can also use her as a replacement if you lack supports. Here, E.H. is generously ATK DMG-buffed by Siren, HelmTr, and PrivatyTr (or Crown off-burst if you use her). Substitutions: PrivatyTr or HelmTr can be replaced by Crown off-burst. Do not use Label B1 here because E.H. already has too much ATK buff. Ideally, the team has ≥1 burst gen support (spammable SR/RL, MG for Siren, or special kits). (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Wind-Weak SR Angle 2（風圧弱点ソロレイドの切り口 2）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of the Siren + Bursting Velvet team that usually uses 3 supports. We replace 1 of them in hopes that E.H.'s personal damage can make up for Siren & Velvet's DPS loss. You can also use her as a replacement if you lack supports. Here, E.H. is generously ATK DMG-buffed by Siren, HelmTr, and PrivatyTr (or Crown off-burst if you use her). Substitutions: PrivatyTr or HelmTr can be replaced by Crown off-burst. Do not use Label B1 here because E.H. already has too much ATK buff. Ideally, the team has at least 1 burst gen support (spammable SR/RL, MG for Siren, or special kits). (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］通常はサポーター3人で組む「サイレン＋バースト運用のベルベット」編成の派生形。そのうち1人を差し替え、E.H.本人の火力がサイレンとベルベットのDPS低下を埋めてくれることに期待する形だ。サポーターが足りない場合の代役としても使える。ここでのE.H.は、サイレン、宝ものヘルム、宝ものプリバティ（あるいはバースト外でクラウンを使うならクラウン）から攻撃ダメージバフを潤沢に受け取る。差し替え：宝ものプリバティか宝ものヘルムを、バースト外のクラウンに置き換え可能。E.H.はすでに攻撃力バフを過剰に抱えているので、ここでレーベルをB1に使ってはいけない。理想を言えば、編成にはバーストゲージ生成役が最低1人欲しい（連射できるスナイパーライフルやロケットランチャー、サイレン向けのマシンガン、あるいは特殊な性能を持つキャラ）。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: The Boring SAnis Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A pretty simple team that all of us have seen on the leaderboards. Dorothy provides CDR, Anis: Sparkling Summer & Ein step on the DPS pedal, and Privaty provides the necessary Reload Speed buffs, as well as Ammo Reduction for Anis: Sparkling Summer. The B2s are the survivability supports to ensure the team stays alive. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: The Boring SAnis Team（退屈なサマーアニス編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A pretty simple team that all of us have seen on the leaderboards. Dorothy provides CDR, Anis: Sparkling Summer & Ein step on the DPS pedal, and Privaty provides the necessary Reload Speed buffs, as well as Ammo Reduction for Anis: Sparkling Summer. The B2s are the survivability supports to ensure the team stays alive. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］誰もがランキングで見たことのある、かなり単純な編成。ドロシーがクールタイム短縮を担い、アニス：スパークリングサマーとアインが火力のアクセルを踏み、プリバティが必要なリロード速度バフと、アニス：スパークリングサマー向けの装填数減少を提供する。B2枠は編成を生き延びさせるための生存サポートだ。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: True Damage Team... Completed?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While we need more potent replacements over Rem and Dolla/Helm: Aquamarine for a better True Damage team, this can absolutely perform at a decent level! The downside is that Frima (Treasure) and Laplace need to have their Favorite Items, which are expensive time investments. Frima also needs Treasure Phase 3 to be a viable support, which can take up to 1.5 months to get.
archetypes.name_ja: True Damage Team... Completed?（固定ダメージ編成…完成？）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] While we need more potent replacements over Rem and Dolla/Helm: Aquamarine for a better True Damage team, this can absolutely perform at a decent level! The downside is that Frima (Treasure) and Laplace need to have their Favorite Items, which are expensive time investments. Frima also needs Treasure Phase 3 to be a viable support, which can take up to 1.5 months to get.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］より良い固定ダメージ編成にするにはレムやドラー、ヘルム：アクアマリンに代わるもっと強力な候補が必要だが、この形でも十分まともな水準で働ける。難点は、（宝ものの）プリムとラプラスに愛用品が必要で、これが時間的に高くつくことだ。プリムはさらに、サポーターとして機能させるために宝もののフェーズ3が必要で、そこまで到達するのに最大1.5か月かかることもある。

archetypes.name: High Power Nuke (3RL)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Opponent running a slow team? This team can effectively counter it. The Blanc version of this team will fare well against most Noah-less teams. Defenders who are Taunters + Biscuit may also prove effective against this team.
archetypes.name_ja: High Power Nuke (3RL)（高火力の爆撃・3RL）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Opponent running a slow team? This team can effectively counter it. The Blanc version of this team will fare well against most Noah-less teams. Defenders who are Taunters + Biscuit may also prove effective against this team.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］相手が遅い編成を使っている？ この編成なら効果的に潰せる。ブラン入りの型は、ノアのいない編成の大半に対してうまく立ち回れる。逆に、挑発役＋ビスケットを据えた防衛側は、この編成に対して有効になり得る。

archetypes.name: Indom, the Savior of DPS with Delayed AoE (3RL)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Water Main B3s like Emilia and Privaty can run into trouble when against this comp since Ein can hunt them down with nuke.
archetypes.name_en: Indom, the Savior of DPS with Delayed AoE (3RL)
archetypes.name_ja: Indom, the Savior of DPS with Delayed AoE (3RL)（不屈は遅発範囲攻撃アタッカーの救世主・3RL）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Water Main B3s like Emilia and Privaty can run into trouble when against this comp since Ein can hunt them down with nuke.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］エミリアやプリバティのような水冷のメインB3は、この編成を相手にすると苦戦しかねない。アインが爆撃で狩りに来るからだ。

archetypes.name: RATATATA DPS Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An all-rounder with a FLEX spot that can be filled with any unit as required. Here, Elegg serves a DPS (and a support), and her goal is to shoot as much as possible. Insert Biscuit for cover repair & healing (note that Elegg is just a sitting duck if she doesn't use Burst Skill), or Scarlet/Guillotine for more damage, assuming that healing is unnecessary. Helm can be a good alternative too.
archetypes.name_ja: RATATATA DPS Team（ダダダダッ火力編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An all-rounder with a FLEX spot that can be filled with any unit as required. Here, Elegg serves a DPS (and a support), and her goal is to shoot as much as possible. Insert Biscuit for cover repair & healing (note that Elegg is just a sitting duck if she doesn't use Burst Skill), or Scarlet/Guillotine for more damage, assuming that healing is unnecessary. Helm can be a good alternative too.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］必要に応じて任意のユニットを入れられる自由枠を持つ万能編成。ここでのエレグはアタッカー（兼サポーター）として働き、目標はとにかく撃ち続けることだ。カバーの修復と回復が欲しければビスケットを入れる（エレグはバーストスキルを使わないとただの的である点に注意）。回復が不要という前提なら、火力を伸ばすために紅蓮やギロチンを入れてもよい。ヘルムも良い候補になる。

archetypes.name: Doro's Redemption Arc I (ft. SElegg)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Doro acts as our primary DPS, HelmTr as our secondary DPS, and SElegg as our off-burst support + DPS. HelmTr provides the necessary healing + burst gen.Only use against Water-weak. Good for Harvester AI because SElegg can continually kill the rocks and mobs, allowing the team to focus-fire on the boss's core all the time. Substitutions: HelmTr can be replaced with XLud. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Doro's Redemption Arc I (ft. SElegg)（ドロシー名誉回復編 I・サマーエレグ入り）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Doro acts as our primary DPS, HelmTr as our secondary DPS, and SElegg as our off-burst support + DPS. HelmTr provides the necessary healing + burst gen. Only use against Water-weak. Good for Harvester AI because SElegg can continually kill the rocks and mobs, allowing the team to focus-fire on the boss's core all the time. Substitutions: HelmTr can be replaced with XLud. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成では、ドロシー：セレンディピティが主軸のアタッカー、宝ものヘルムが二番手のアタッカー、エレグ：ブーム・アンド・ショックがバースト外のサポーター兼アタッカーとして働く。宝ものヘルムは必要な回復とバーストゲージ生成を賄う。水冷弱点相手にのみ使うこと。エレグ：ブーム・アンド・ショックが岩や雑魚を絶えず処理してくれるので、編成が常にボスのコアへ集中砲火できる点で、ハーベスターのAI戦に向いている。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーに置き換え可能。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Doro's Redemption Arc II (ft. SElegg)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A Siren-and-Crown-less variant of the first team, featuring Liter and Grave. In this comp, Liter synergizes well with HelmTr and SElegg, providing ATK buff before their Burst Skill(s)—which amplifies their damage. Doro also gains extra Ammo and Pierce DMG from Grave and Liter. Grave and Liter also work together to achieve/abuse 8.2s CDR, allowing for a total of 15 Full Burst rotations.Only use against Water-weak. Substitutions: HelmTr can be replaced with XLud. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Doro's Redemption Arc II (ft. SElegg)（ドロシー名誉回復編 II・サマーエレグ入り）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A Siren-and-Crown-less variant of the first team, featuring Liter and Grave. In this comp, Liter synergizes well with HelmTr and SElegg, providing ATK buff before their Burst Skill(s) — which amplifies their damage. Doro also gains extra Ammo and Pierce DMG from Grave and Liter. Grave and Liter also work together to achieve/abuse 8.2s CDR, allowing for a total of 15 Full Burst rotations. Only use against Water-weak. Substitutions: HelmTr can be replaced with XLud. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］1つ目の編成からサイレンとクラウンを抜き、リターとグレイブを据えた派生形。この編成ではリターが宝ものヘルムとエレグ：ブーム・アンド・ショックとよく噛み合い、彼女たちのバーストスキルの前に攻撃力バフを乗せてダメージを増幅する。ドロシー：セレンディピティもグレイブとリターから追加の装填数と貫通ダメージを得る。さらにグレイブとリターは協働して8.2秒のクールタイム短縮を成立させ、フルバーストのローテーションを合計15回まで回せるようにする。水冷弱点相手にのみ使うこと。差し替え：宝ものヘルムはルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーに置き換え可能。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: You Are Doroless (ft. SElegg)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If you don't have Doro, or your Doro is unbuilt, and your HelmTr and XLud are omega-strong, this team might be more effective for you. In this team, we don't have "carry DPS", but we stack buffs/debuffs from HelmTr, XLud, and SElegg to achieve greatness and higher total team damage. XLud provides Damage Taken, which amplifies the whole team's damage, including SElegg's. This team might only be effective against bosses with core due to XLud's kit being reliant on it. Substitutions: Siren and Crown can be replaced with Liter and Grave respectively; works the same way as with Doro's alternative team. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: You Are Doroless (ft. SElegg)（ドロシーがいないあなたへ・サマーエレグ入り）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] If you don't have Doro, or your Doro is unbuilt, and your HelmTr and XLud are omega-strong, this team might be more effective for you. In this team, we don't have "carry DPS", but we stack buffs/debuffs from HelmTr, XLud, and SElegg to achieve greatness and higher total team damage. XLud provides Damage Taken, which amplifies the whole team's damage, including SElegg's. This team might only be effective against bosses with core due to XLud's kit being reliant on it. Substitutions: Siren and Crown can be replaced with Liter and Grave respectively; works the same way as with Doro's alternative team. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ドロシー：セレンディピティを持っていない、あるいは育てていなくて、宝ものヘルムとルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーが飛び抜けて強いなら、この編成のほうが有効かもしれない。この編成には「主軸のアタッカー」がいないが、宝ものヘルム、ルドミラ：ウィンターオーナー、エレグ：ブーム・アンド・ショックのバフとデバフを積み重ねることで高い総ダメージに到達する。ルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーは被ダメージ増加を与え、エレグ：ブーム・アンド・ショックを含む編成全体のダメージを増幅する。ただしルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーの性能はコアに依存するため、この編成はコアを持つボスにしか通用しないかもしれない。差し替え：サイレンとクラウンはそれぞれリターとグレイブに置き換え可能で、ドロシー：セレンディピティ版の別案と同じ理屈で機能する。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: Basic Duo Teams
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Liter JKs or Liter Bunnies, both are decent comps where Emilia can easily fit in to. You can expect her to perform well in Campaign and Bosses in these teams. Liter and Naga/Noir provide ATK buffs that Emilia lacks, whereas Tia and Blanc provide separate damage multipliers that can boost her damage substantially! Naga and Blanc also provides heals in case she needs them. One thing to note about the Bunnies comp is their inherent lack of Burst gen, which is remedied by using Emilia as B3!

archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Liter JKs or Liter Bunnies, both are decent comps where Emilia can easily fit in to. You can expect her to perform well in Campaign and Bosses in these teams. Liter and Naga/Noir provide ATK buffs that Emilia lacks, whereas Tia and Blanc provide separate damage multipliers that can boost her damage substantially! Naga and Blanc also provides heals in case she needs them. One thing to note about the Bunnies comp is their inherent lack of Burst gen, which is remedied by using Emilia as B3!
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］リター＋女子高生組でも、リター＋バニー組でも、どちらもエミリアがすんなり収まる悪くない編成だ。これらの編成なら、キャンペーンでもボス戦でも彼女の活躍が見込める。リターとナガ／ノワールはエミリアに欠けている攻撃力バフを供給し、ティアとブランは独立した乗算のダメージ倍率を与えて彼女の火力を大きく伸ばす。ナガとブランは必要なときの回復も担う。バニー編成について一つ注意すべきは、構造的にバーストゲージ生成が不足している点で、これはエミリアをB3に据えることで解消される。

archetypes.name: Rem Synergy
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] We believe that with heals and Buffs for RLs that Rem provides, Emilia and Rem will be able to make a great combo against Bosses, and maybe even Campaign...
archetypes.name_ja: Rem Synergy（レムとの噛み合い）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] We believe that with heals and Buffs for RLs that Rem provides, Emilia and Rem will be able to make a great combo against Bosses, and maybe even Campaign...
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］レムが供給する回復とロケットランチャー向けのバフがあれば、エミリアとレムはボス戦で——ひょっとするとキャンペーンでも——優れた組み合わせになれるはずだと考えている。

archetypes.name: Oneshot, literally
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] 2 RL Emilia which guarantees oneshot easily most team because Miranda allows Emilia Burst shot 100% crit. Require some good Crit Damage lines if you want to run Miranda solo, or just replace Centi with Helm Treasure version to fill the gap

archetypes.name: Two True DMG DPS Tag Together
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This comp features TEmma as in-burst B1 and TEunhwa as in-burst B2. It also features Siren as off-burst B1. TVesti and Ein are incredible True DMG DPS for Campaign because True DMG ignores DEF, which is handy for High Deficit. Unlike our usual mobbing comps, this team doesn't feature Crown, so there is no shield to protect the team (it is replaced by continuous heal; but beware of one-shots!). This team can also be used for Bossing, but targeted B3 based on element is likely a better option.We only recommend using this team in Campaign against Fire-weak and Electric-weak. You can replace Ein with LaplaceTr for Iron-weak, but her compatibility with the team is lower (due to her playstyle and kit). LaplaceTr is also not as good as Ein for mobbing. You can also replace Ein with Rapi: Red Hood, who is a good bruteforcer and should work for most elements (+ good synergy with Siren). If your Ein is weak, then Rapi: Red Hood might even edge her out in Electric-weak, but for Fire and Iron-weak? Rapi: Red Hood is the way. Make sure you manual TEunhwa or Ein for fast burst gen; Siren will "complement" through TEmma's and her own high attack speed. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced with D:Wife, Volume, Dolla, SHelm, Rouge, or Sakura. Beware of Rouge's placement.If in the future ShiftUp releases a broken True DMG DPS that overshadows others even in Neutral, consider replacing one of the B3 with her.

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はエマ：タクティカル・アップをバースト内のB1、ウンファ：タクティカル・アップをバースト内のB2に据え、さらにサイレンをバースト外のB1として使う。固定ダメージは防御力を無視するので、戦闘力が大きく不足する場面で便利であり、ベスティー：タクティカル・アップとアインはキャンペーンにおいて非常に優れた固定ダメージアタッカーだ。いつもの雑魚処理編成と違い、この編成にはクラウンがいないため味方を守るシールドがない（代わりに継続回復が入るが、一撃死には注意）。ボス戦にも使えるが、属性に合わせて狙って選んだB3を使うほうがおそらく良い。キャンペーンでは灼熱弱点と電撃弱点に対してのみこの編成を推奨する。鉄甲弱点なら宝ものラプラスでアインを差し替えられるが、（立ち回りと性能の都合で）編成との噛み合いは落ちる。宝ものラプラスは雑魚処理でもアインに及ばない。アインをラピ：レッドフードに差し替えることもでき、彼女は力押しに強くほとんどの属性で機能する（加えてサイレンとの噛み合いも良い）。アインの育成が浅いなら、電撃弱点でさえラピ：レッドフードが上回るかもしれない。灼熱弱点と鉄甲弱点なら？ ラピ：レッドフード一択だ。バーストゲージを早く溜めるため、ウンファ：タクティカル・アップかアインは必ず手動で操作すること。サイレンはエマ：タクティカル・アップと自身の高い攻撃速度で「補完」してくれる。差し替え：サイレンはD：キラーワイフ、ボリューム、ドラー、ヘルム：アクアマリン、ルージュ、サクラに置き換え可能。ルージュは配置に注意。将来シフトアップが、属性相性なしでも他を霞ませるほど壊れた固定ダメージアタッカーを実装したら、B3の一枠をその子に譲ることを検討しよう。

archetypes.name: Fire For Fire
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of the other comp but uses Rei as a team buffer instead. Since TEmma & TEunhwa are also Fire (same as Vesti), that means Rei can buff all of them. The effectiveness of this team depends on the investments (incl. dupes) of the trio. D:Wife is just an off-burst CDR. She can be swapped with any CDR, as long as they fit the team (preferably high-cap CDR who do not rely on Burst Skill for impact [SHelm is a fine choice, however]). DWife is used in this example because she is Fire (for exaggeration purposes only; she is not the best here). Substitutions: D:Wife can be replaced with Siren, Volume, Dolla, SHelm, Rouge, or Sakura. Beware of Rouge's placement. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Ultra Destroyer MK3
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This is a premium Ultra Anomaly Interception destroyer comp focused around Rapi: Red Hood and Eve, providing them with immense amounts of ATK and CRT buffs (thanks to MastM). Eve provides the team with Damage Taken, increasing RRH's damage—our top DPS & carry—while MastM makes Eve's crit chance somewhat guaranteed, which significantly boosts her viability. Substitutions: You can replace Crown with Anchor: Innocent Maid in non-maxing content like Raids to better distribute your supports. (속성: Iron)
