archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］他の派生形と狙いは同じだが、こちらはバーストスキルダメージ▲を上乗せするために、ラプラス：アルティメットヒーローと合わせてトリナをバーストさせたい。差し替え：どのB3もネオン：ビジョン・アイやクエンシー：エスケープクイーンに置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Lycoris Squamigera
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The regular Hypercarry RRH team, which used to consist of Anis: Star Crown RRH PrivT MastM. Now, just substitute FloraT for MastM. We put FloraT in between Anis: Star and RRH as they have the highest DPS. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Lycoris Squamigera（ナツズイセン）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The regular Hypercarry RRH team, which used to consist of Anis: Star Crown RRH PrivT MastM. Now, just substitute FloraT for MastM. We put FloraT in between Anis: Star and RRH as they have the highest DPS. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］通常のラピ：レッドフードのハイパーキャリー編成。かつてはアニス：スター、クラウン、ラピ：レッドフード、宝ものプリバティ、マスト：ロマンチックメイドで組まれていた。今はマスト：ロマンチックメイドを宝ものフローラに差し替えるだけでよい。宝ものフローラは、最も火力の高いアニス：スターとラピ：レッドフードの間に配置する。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Narcissus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crownless players have been crying about Ultra AI because Cover instantly breaks against it. Now, you can use FloraT. SCindy is in SR mode to Pierce and abuse Parts. AnchorM is to provide some Reload Speed and ATK▲. Substitutions: SCindy can be replaced by any B3, ideally Iron with Pierce, such as Red Hood. AnchorM can be replaced by any 20s or 40s B2 (except MastM). (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: Narcissus（スイセン）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crownless players have been crying about Ultra AI because Cover instantly breaks against it. Now, you can use FloraT. SCindy is in SR mode to Pierce and abuse Parts. AnchorM is to provide some Reload Speed and ATK▲. Substitutions: SCindy can be replaced by any B3, ideally Iron with Pierce, such as Red Hood. AnchorM can be replaced by any 20s or 40s B2 (except MastM). (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］クラウンを持たないプレイヤーは、カバーが一瞬で壊されるためウルトラアノマリー迎撃戦に泣かされてきた。これからは宝ものフローラを使える。シンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブはスナイパーライフルのモードにして貫通で部位を狙い撃つ。アンカー：イノセントメイドはリロード速度と攻撃力▲をいくらか供給する役だ。差し替え：シンデレラ：クリスタルウェーブは任意のB3に置き換え可能で、理想はレッドフードのような貫通持ちの鉄甲。アンカー：イノセントメイドは（マスト：ロマンチックメイドを除く）20秒または40秒のB2なら何にでも置き換え可能。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Fritillaria Imperialis
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crown's and Flora's Shields can stack and block 2 attacks! Combine them together for some "easy" Campaign pushing, especially with True DMG DPS like TVesti!
archetypes.name_ja: Fritillaria Imperialis（ヨウラクユリ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Crown's and Flora's Shields can stack and block 2 attacks! Combine them together for some "easy" Campaign pushing, especially with True DMG DPS like TVesti!
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］クラウンとフローラのシールドは重複し、攻撃を2回防いでくれる。両者を組み合わせれば「楽な」キャンペーン攻略ができる。とりわけベスティー：タクティカル・アップのような固定ダメージアタッカーと合わせるとよい。

archetypes.name: Dendrobium Orchid
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Give more ATK▲, so they can actually hurt Electric-weak Campaign Bosses. Also gives extra Shield and Heal. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: Dendrobium Orchid（デンドロビウム）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Give more ATK▲, so they can actually hurt Electric-weak Campaign Bosses. Also gives extra Shield and Heal. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］攻撃力▲をさらに盛って、電撃弱点のキャンペーンのボスに本当に効くダメージを出させる。加えてシールドと回復も上乗せされる。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Lycoris Sprengeri
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Electric has the best True DMG DPS, so pair them with the best True DMG support. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: Lycoris Sprengeri（ムラサキキツネノカミソリ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Electric has the best True DMG DPS, so pair them with the best True DMG support. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］電撃には最良の固定ダメージアタッカーが揃っている。ならば最良の固定ダメージサポーターと組ませればよい。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Amaryllis
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The "Crown-saving" Arcana-Isa-Cindy team featuring Flora providing Max HP▲ buff (enough for Cindy's Burst Skill even though it lasts 2s) and accelerating Cindy's Beautiful stacking. Flora has decent personal damage here. Ensure FloraT is not reloading outside Full Burst for burst gen. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: Amaryllis（アマリリス）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The "Crown-saving" Arcana-Isa-Cindy team featuring Flora providing Max HP▲ buff (enough for Cindy's Burst Skill even though it lasts 2s) and accelerating Cindy's Beautiful stacking. Flora has decent personal damage here. Ensure FloraT is not reloading outside Full Burst for burst gen. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］クラウンを他所に回せる、アルカナ＋イサベル＋シンデレラの編成。フローラが最大HP▲バフを供給し（持続は2秒だがシンデレラのバーストスキルには十分）、シンデレラの「ビューティフル」スタックの蓄積を加速させる。ここでのフローラは本人の火力もそれなりにある。バーストゲージ生成のため、宝ものフローラがフルバースト外でリロードしないように気をつけること。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Carnation
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the team ideas for Wind-weak Solo Raid. Substitutions: Moran can be swapped for Siren. Place Flora (Treasure) between Siren and AsukaW. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Carnation（カーネーション）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of the team ideas for Wind-weak Solo Raid. Substitutions: Moran can be swapped for Siren. Place Flora (Treasure) between Siren and AsukaW. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］風圧弱点のソロレイド向けの編成案の一つ。差し替え：モランはサイレンと交換可能。（宝ものの）フローラはサイレンと式波・アスカ・ラングレー：WILLEの間に配置する。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Gladiolus
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use Flora (Treasure) to instantly activate Crown's S2 and provide buff for TVesti.
archetypes.name_ja: Gladiolus（グラジオラス）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use Flora (Treasure) to instantly activate Crown's S2 and provide buff for TVesti.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］（宝ものの）フローラでクラウンのスキル2を即座に発動させ、ベスティー：タクティカル・アップにバフを供給する。

archetypes.name: Grave Steals Mari’s EVA friends
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team focuses on buffing Asuka and originally used Mari instead of Grave. Now, Grave is a better option here as she can benefit Asuka's and Rei's buff as well as providing the team with loads of Pierce DMG▲ and ATK DMG▲. If you somehow don't have built Alice, or if you are a fan of Evangelion, this team would excite you. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Grave Steals Mari's EVA friends（グレイブがマリのエヴァ仲間を奪う）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team focuses on buffing Asuka and originally used Mari instead of Grave. Now, Grave is a better option here as she can benefit Asuka's and Rei's buff as well as providing the team with loads of Pierce DMG▲ and ATK DMG▲. If you somehow don't have built Alice, or if you are a fan of Evangelion, this team would excite you. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成はアスカをバフすることに主眼を置いており、もともとはグレイブではなく真希波・マリ・イラストリアスを使っていた。今はグレイブのほうが良い選択で、彼女はアスカとレイのバフの恩恵を受けつつ、編成に大量の貫通ダメージ▲と攻撃ダメージ▲を供給できる。何らかの事情でアリスを育てていないなら、あるいはエヴァンゲリオンのファンなら、この編成は胸が躍るはずだ。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Campaign Shenanigans
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of high-deficit Campaign team fixated on buffing Asuka's and Alice's ATK as much as possible to negate stat penalty. Great for pushing Fire-Weak Campaign (Ch. 28-32). Red Hood as a B1 buffer will provide a significant ATK buff to the team (including Grave — remember, stat conversion buff since Red Hood provides caster’s ATK buff). Grave, Asuka, and Alice can then demolish enemies together with their endless Pierce capabilities and lifesteal. Substitutions: Crown can be used as an off-burst B2 buffer to provide ATK buff and Reload Speed when needed with occasional taunt but without shield. This does mean that Asuka will not enjoy her Elemental DMG buff. When using Crown, you may replace Asuka with Red Hood B3. Naga may be used over an off-burst Crown instead if Core Damage + some heals are more preferable.In stages that do not require CDR, you can ditch Liter/DWife/Rouge and run RH B1, together with Grave B2, and an off-burst Crown, Naga or Modernia. Of course, still using 2 Pierce DPS as the main B3s. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Campaign Shenanigans（キャンペーンの悪ふざけ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A variant of high-deficit Campaign team fixated on buffing Asuka's and Alice's ATK as much as possible to negate stat penalty. Great for pushing Fire-Weak Campaign (Ch. 28-32). Red Hood as a B1 buffer will provide a significant ATK buff to the team (including Grave — remember, stat conversion buff since Red Hood provides caster's ATK buff). Grave, Asuka, and Alice can then demolish enemies together with their endless Pierce capabilities and lifesteal. Substitutions: Crown can be used as an off-burst B2 buffer to provide ATK buff and Reload Speed when needed with occasional taunt but without shield. This does mean that Asuka will not enjoy her Elemental DMG buff. When using Crown, you may replace Asuka with Red Hood B3. Naga may be used over an off-burst Crown instead if Core Damage plus some heals are more preferable. In stages that do not require CDR, you can ditch Liter/DWife/Rouge and run RH B1, together with Grave B2, and an off-burst Crown, Naga or Modernia. Of course, still using 2 Pierce DPS as the main B3s. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］戦闘力が大きく不足する場面向けのキャンペーン編成の派生形で、ステータス減衰を打ち消すためアスカとアリスの攻撃力を可能な限り盛ることに徹している。灼熱弱点のキャンペーン（第28〜32章）の攻略に最適だ。B1バッファーとしてのレッドフードは編成に大きな攻撃力バフを与える（グレイブにも効く——レッドフードは自身の攻撃力を参照するバフを配るので、ステータス変換型のバフだという点を思い出してほしい）。そうすればグレイブ、アスカ、アリスが尽きることのない貫通能力とライフスティールで敵を薙ぎ倒していく。差し替え：クラウンはバースト外のB2バッファーとして使え、必要なときに攻撃力バフとリロード速度を供給し、時折挑発もするがシールドはない。ただしその場合アスカは属性ダメージバフを受け取れない。クラウンを使うなら、アスカをレッドフードのB3に差し替えてもよい。コアダメージといくらかの回復のほうが好ましいなら、バースト外のクラウンの代わりにナガを使ってもよい。クールタイム短縮が不要なステージなら、リターやD：キラーワイフ、ルージュを外し、レッドフードのB1とグレイブのB2、そしてバースト外のクラウン、ナガ、モダニアのいずれかで回せる。もちろんメインのB3には貫通アタッカー2人を据えたままで。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Keep Pressuring The Frontline @3RL
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A very niché attacking team to punish disorganized comps with as few expensive units as possible. Grave and Modernia's Full Burst Adjacency Strike apply strong frontline pressure. Rumani can serve as an additional/secondary tank with some self-heal and taunting, and her being B1 (unlike Centi or Anis) does not block Grave's B2 from being used, opening up positional flexibilities. Use an Off-Burst Centi to accelerate Burst or ClipSG to additionally pressure the enemy's backline.
archetypes.name_ja: Keep Pressuring The Frontline @3RL（3RLで前線を圧迫し続ける）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A very niche attacking team to punish disorganized comps with as few expensive units as possible. Grave and Modernia's Full Burst Adjacency Strike apply strong frontline pressure. Rumani can serve as an additional/secondary tank with some self-heal and taunting, and her being B1 (unlike Centi or Anis) does not block Grave's B2 from being used, opening up positional flexibilities. Use an Off-Burst Centi to accelerate Burst or ClipSG to additionally pressure the enemy's backline.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］高価なユニットをできるだけ使わずに、まとまりのない編成を咎めるための、かなり限定的な攻撃編成。グレイブとモダニアのフルバースト時の隣接攻撃が前線に強い圧力をかける。ルマニは自己回復と挑発を持つ二番手のタンクとして働け、（センチやアニスと違い）彼女がB1であることでグレイブのB2使用を妨げないため、配置の自由度が広がる。バーストを加速したいならバースト外のセンチを、相手の後衛にも圧力をかけたいなら装填数式のショットガンを使うとよい。

archetypes.name: Water Showdown
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Possibly the strongest team for Harvester, but may depend on your investments! Previously, the strongest team was considered to be this same team but with Quency: Escape Queen over xGuillo. However, this team can be expected to give a similar performance, if not a better one. Ludmilla Winter Ownermilla is the major DPS for this Boss, so buffing her seems to be the correct play in order to get stage 7 on this Boss. However, keep in mind that, over time, you can get Quency:EQ’s dupes through wishlisting her. XGuillotine is a limited unit, so you will have to get her dupes right now if you want to aim for getting your title. This team can be considered BiS for Water Bosses with a Core, with the Quency:EQ version giving similar performance compared to this team. (속성: Water)
archetypes.name_ja: Water Showdown（水冷の決着）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Possibly the strongest team for Harvester, but may depend on your investments! Previously, the strongest team was considered to be this same team but with Quency: Escape Queen over xGuillo. However, this team can be expected to give a similar performance, if not a better one. Ludmilla: Winter Owner is the major DPS for this Boss, so buffing her seems to be the correct play in order to get stage 7 on this Boss. However, keep in mind that, over time, you can get Quency:EQ's dupes through wishlisting her. XGuillotine is a limited unit, so you will have to get her dupes right now if you want to aim for getting your title. This team can be considered BiS for Water Bosses with a Core, with the Quency:EQ version giving similar performance compared to this team. (Element: Water)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ハーベスター相手におそらく最強の編成だが、育成度次第かもしれない。以前は、同じ編成でギロチン：ウィンタースレイヤーの代わりにクエンシー：エスケープクイーンを入れた形が最強とされていた。とはいえこの編成も同等か、それ以上の働きが期待できる。このボスに対する主力アタッカーはルドミラ：ウィンターオーナーなので、ステージ7を取るには彼女をバフするのが正解に見える。ただし、クエンシー：エスケープクイーンは希望リストに入れておけば時間をかけて重ねられる点は覚えておきたい。ギロチン：ウィンタースレイヤーは限定ユニットなので、称号を狙うなら今のうちに重ねておく必要がある。この編成はコアを持つ水冷のボスに対する最適解と見なせるが、クエンシー：エスケープクイーン版もこの編成と同程度の働きをする。（属性：水冷）

archetypes.name: A Tower that refuses to get Meta DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An Elysion Tower team for xGuillotiine. xGuillotine takes her time to stack up, but will buff Phantom’s attacks during her own Burst! Substitutions: Diesel can be replaced with MarcianaPhantom can be replaced with Privaty
archetypes.name_en: A Tower that refuses to get Meta DPS
archetypes.name_ja: A Tower that refuses to get Meta DPS（メタのアタッカーを受け付けないタワー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An Elysion Tower team for xGuillotine. xGuillotine takes her time to stack up, but will buff Phantom's attacks during her own Burst! Substitutions: Diesel can be replaced with Marciana. Phantom can be replaced with Privaty
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ギロチン：ウィンタースレイヤー向けのエリシオンタワー編成。彼女はスタックを積むのに時間がかかるが、自身のバースト中にファントムの攻撃をバフしてくれる。差し替え：ディーゼルはマルチャーナに置き換え可能。ファントムはプリバティに置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Campaign Ease-of-Use General Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Helm (Treasure) allows for a lot of extra Burst generation that would otherwise not be present in most team comps in Campaign! She is a huge help and the best off Burst unit to use over Naga in the FLEX slot.
archetypes.name_ja: Campaign Ease-of-Use General Comp（使い勝手重視のキャンペーン汎用編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Helm (Treasure) allows for a lot of extra Burst generation that would otherwise not be present in most team comps in Campaign! She is a huge help and the best off Burst unit to use over Naga in the FLEX slot.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］（宝ものの）ヘルムは、キャンペーンの多くの編成では本来得られない大量のバーストゲージ生成をもたらしてくれる。彼女は大きな助けになり、自由枠ではナガより優先すべき最良のバースト外ユニットだ。

archetypes.name: Anomaly Interception General Comp
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Simply the solution to all Anomaly Interception Bosses. The B3 units are supposed to be element based DPS units.
archetypes.name_ja: Anomaly Interception General Comp（アノマリー迎撃戦の汎用編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Simply the solution to all Anomaly Interception Bosses. The B3 units are supposed to be element based DPS units.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］アノマリー迎撃戦のボス全般に対する、単純明快な解答。B3の枠には属性に合わせたアタッカーを入れる想定だ。

archetypes.name: Elysion Tower ft. HelmT #2
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Redefining Burst generation in Elysion Tower, Helm (Treasure) really does it all! She can even act alongside Mast Anchor to provide immense Heal for the team as Rapi: Red Hood destroys the enemy raptures.
archetypes.name_ja: Elysion Tower ft. HelmT #2（宝ものヘルム入りエリシオンタワー #2）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Redefining Burst generation in Elysion Tower, Helm (Treasure) really does it all! She can even act alongside Mast Anchor to provide immense Heal for the team as Rapi: Red Hood destroys the enemy raptures.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］エリシオンタワーにおけるバーストゲージ生成の常識を塗り替える存在——（宝ものの）ヘルムは本当に何でもこなす。ラピ：レッドフードが敵のラプチャーを破壊していく傍らで、マストやアンカーと並んで編成に絶大な回復を供給することさえできる。

archetypes.name: Can you get past it?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Thanks to Helm, we now can even push the Noise Noah XXX combo into 2 RL. This comp is just insane. It has stalls, it has a huge nuke, and it has huge follow-up attacks from Cinderella too.
archetypes.name_ja: Can you get past it?（これを突破できるか？）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Thanks to Helm, we now can even push the Noise Noah XXX combo into 2 RL. This comp is just insane. It has stalls, it has a huge nuke, and it has huge follow-up attacks from Cinderella too.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ヘルムのおかげで、ノイズ＋ノア＋任意の組み合わせを2RLまで押し込めるようになった。この編成は端的に言って異常だ。足止めもあり、強烈な爆撃もあり、そのうえシンデレラによる強力な追撃まである。

archetypes.name: The ultimate stall
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The popular Nero stall is now immensely strengthened with helm, especially if you have charge speed on your RL units.
archetypes.name_ja: The ultimate stall（究極の足止め）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The popular Nero stall is now immensely strengthened with Helm, especially if you have charge speed on your RL units.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］人気のネロによる足止め編成は、ヘルムの加入で飛躍的に強化された。ロケットランチャーのユニットにチャージ速度を積んでいるなら、なおさらだ。

archetypes.name: True damage cope
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has so much Attack Damage buff for True Damage DPS. Frima can even heal too which is great. The problem is the damage output will look so bad you may ask yourself why you use this team. Still, if you are under high deficit against Mirror Container, this one may do. Or you can wait till you are at 30% deficit and try again.
archetypes.name_ja: True damage cope（固定ダメージで妥協）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has so much Attack Damage buff for True Damage DPS. Frima can even heal too which is great. The problem is the damage output will look so bad you may ask yourself why you use this team. Still, if you are under high deficit against Mirror Container, this one may do. Or you can wait till you are at 30% deficit and try again.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は固定ダメージのアタッカー向けに大量の攻撃ダメージバフを抱えている。プリムは回復までこなすので素晴らしい。問題は、出てくるダメージがあまりに情けなく見えて、なぜこの編成を使っているのか自問したくなることだ。とはいえ、ミラーコンテナ相手に戦闘力が大きく不足しているなら、これでも用は足りる。あるいは戦闘力の不足が30%まで縮まるのを待って、もう一度挑めばよい。

archetypes.name: Jill Tia Naga
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Jill shoots hard per bullet. Jill can molest core, then why not giving her Core Damage buff? Hence we have this team. Also, you can replace Tia with Crown, and Liter with Siren just fine. Why though?
archetypes.name_ja: Jill Tia Naga（ジル＋ティア＋ナガ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Jill shoots hard per bullet. Jill can molest core, then why not giving her Core Damage buff? Hence we have this team. Also, you can replace Tia with Crown, and Liter with Siren just fine. Why though?
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ジル・バレンタインは一発一発が重い。コアも執拗に狙える。ならばコアダメージバフを与えない手はないだろう。そうして生まれたのがこの編成だ。なお、ティアをクラウンに、リターをサイレンに差し替えても問題なく機能する。もっとも、なぜそうするのかは疑問だが。

archetypes.name: Sustained Jill
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features Jill empowered by a Sustained DMG-focused buffer. In this team, Raven acts as a secondary DPS good for neutral, and Helm Treasure provides the team with the necessary burst gen. This team is logically only used as one of the bottom 3 teams in Electric SR. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: Sustained Jill（持続ダメージのジル）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team features Jill empowered by a Sustained DMG-focused buffer. In this team, Raven acts as a secondary DPS good for neutral, and Helm Treasure provides the team with the necessary burst gen. This team is logically only used as one of the bottom 3 teams in Electric SR. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］持続ダメージに特化したバッファーでジル・バレンタインを強化する編成。ここではレイヴンが属性相性のない場面でも使える二番手のアタッカーとして働き、宝ものヘルムが必要なバーストゲージ生成を賄う。理屈のうえで、この編成は電撃ソロレイドにおける下位3編成のうちの一つとしてしか使われない。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: General BIS K Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Expected Raid team for K, where she will replace Ein. Ein is usually in this team comp instead of K due to the reload speed buffs and electric team buffs. However, with K being added and buffing both ExiaT and Summer Anis due to her ammo reduction effect, this team might be seen in upcoming electric raids. Substitutions: Siren and D: Killer Wife are good options for B1-CDR (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: General BIS K Team（Kの汎用最適編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Expected Raid team for K, where she will replace Ein. Ein is usually in this team comp instead of K due to the reload speed buffs and electric team buffs. However, with K being added and buffing both ExiaT and Summer Anis due to her ammo reduction effect, this team might be seen in upcoming electric raids. Substitutions: Siren and D: Killer Wife are good options for B1-CDR (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］Kのレイド編成として想定される形で、彼女がアインの枠に入る。リロード速度バフと電撃編成向けのバフのおかげで、この編成には通常Kではなくアインが入る。しかしKが加わり、装填数減少効果によって宝ものエクシアとアニス：スパークリングサマーの両方をバフするようになったことで、今後の電撃レイドではこの編成が見られるかもしれない。差し替え：B1のクールタイム短縮役にはサイレンとD：キラーワイフが良い候補。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: No Pilgrim Electric Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Basic Electric Bossing Team for commanders who are not lucky enough to get Cinderella. Substitutions: Maiden: Ice Rose can be replaced by Ein, with Summer Anis going in the off-burst slot and Ein becoming main B3.Mari can be replaced with Crown, Grave, Blanc (with Rouge), or Summer Rosanna. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: No Pilgrim Electric Team（ピルグリム抜きの電撃編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Basic Electric Bossing Team for commanders who are not lucky enough to get Cinderella. Substitutions: Maiden: Ice Rose can be replaced by Ein, with Summer Anis going in the off-burst slot and Ein becoming main B3. Mari can be replaced with Crown, Grave, Blanc (with Rouge), or Summer Rosanna. (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］シンデレラを引き当てる幸運に恵まれなかった指揮官向けの、基本的な電撃ボス戦編成。差し替え：メイデン：アイスローズはアインに置き換え可能で、その場合アニス：スパークリングサマーがバースト外の枠に移り、アインがメインのB3になる。真希波・マリ・イラストリアスはクラウン、グレイブ、（ルージュと組ませた）ブラン、ロザンナ：シックオーシャンに置き換え可能。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: The Electric Filler for Maids
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Maid Duo is notorious for electric raids since there is no B1 or B3 electric unit 'free' to fill in the B1 and B3 slots for this team. Rouge is the only electric B1-CDR unit, but she has to go with Cinderella and xMaiden with their own specific support structure. Ein and Summer Anis form a strong team together. Isabel needs Arcana and Scarlet needs Trina and there is no slot for another B2 unit. Hence, with K, we now have a new unit who is open to be used in the Maid team comp to fill in the electric unit requirement! (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: The Electric Filler for Maids（メイド編成の電撃枠を埋める存在）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Maid Duo is notorious for electric raids since there is no B1 or B3 electric unit 'free' to fill in the B1 and B3 slots for this team. Rouge is the only electric B1-CDR unit, but she has to go with Cinderella and xMaiden with their own specific support structure. Ein and Summer Anis form a strong team together. Isabel needs Arcana and Scarlet needs Trina and there is no slot for another B2 unit. Hence, with K, we now have a new unit who is open to be used in the Maid team comp to fill in the electric unit requirement! (Element: Electric)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］メイドデュオは電撃レイドで悪名高い。この編成のB1とB3の枠を埋められる「空いた」電撃ユニットが存在しないからだ。ルージュは唯一の電撃のB1クールタイム短縮役だが、彼女はシンデレラやメイデン：アイスローズと、それぞれ専用のサポート構成で組む必要がある。アインとアニス：スパークリングサマーは二人で強力な編成を成す。イサベルにはアルカナが、紅蓮にはトリナが必要で、もう一人B2を入れる枠はない。そこにKが登場したことで、メイド編成に組み込んで電撃ユニットの要件を満たせる新しい選択肢が生まれたのだ。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Missilis Tribe Tower Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Kilo fits in easily as a meta unit for Missilis tribe tower. We believe that she will be used over Laplace for wave-type stages, but Laplace may be able to compete against her Vs Bosses. While she does not benefit from any ATK buffs, she benefits from Tia's Attack Damage Buff.
archetypes.name_ja: Missilis Tribe Tower Team（ミシリス社タワー編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Kilo fits in easily as a meta unit for Missilis tribe tower. We believe that she will be used over Laplace for wave-type stages, but Laplace may be able to compete against her Vs Bosses. While she does not benefit from any ATK buffs, she benefits from Tia's Attack Damage Buff.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］キロはミシリス社タワーのメタユニットとしてすんなり収まる。波状のステージではラプラスより彼女が使われるようになると見ているが、ボス相手ならラプラスも張り合えるかもしれない。彼女は攻撃力バフの恩恵を一切受けないものの、ティアの攻撃ダメージバフの恩恵は受けられる。

archetypes.name: Kilo-ton
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Simple team, very strong, but very expensive since it uses a lot of good units. Initially this team is 3RL, but with lvl7 Quantum cubes on 3 of the RL units, or with Jackal feed, this team can Burst as fast as 2RL. Noise buffs Kilo, while the others provide Burst gen. Kilo nukes the enemy fast.
archetypes.name_ja: Kilo-ton（キロトン）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Simple team, very strong, but very expensive since it uses a lot of good units. Initially this team is 3RL, but with lvl7 Quantum cubes on 3 of the RL units, or with Jackal feed, this team can Burst as fast as 2RL. Noise buffs Kilo, while the others provide Burst gen. Kilo nukes the enemy fast.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］単純だが非常に強力な編成。ただし優秀なユニットを大量に使うので、かなり高くつく。当初この編成は3RLだが、ロケットランチャーのユニット3人にレベル7の量子キューブを積むか、ジャッカルの供給があれば、2RLの速さでバーストできる。ノイズがキロをバフし、残りはバーストゲージ生成を担う。キロが敵を素早く吹き飛ばす。

archetypes.name: Tactical Label
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Label can be used to deny Electric damage in the first 5 seconds. Using Label in Tactical, albeit not necessary, guarantees survival against fast Electric comps. This team utilizies Buff Overloading technique that makes Rosanna less likely to dispel Label's Damage Reduction.
archetypes.name_ja: Tactical Label（タクティカル・レーベル）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Label can be used to deny Electric damage in the first 5 seconds. Using Label in Tactical, albeit not necessary, guarantees survival against fast Electric comps. This team utilizes Buff Overloading technique that makes Rosanna less likely to dispel Label's Damage Reduction.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］レーベルは最初の5秒間、電撃ダメージを無効化する用途で使える。タクティカル・アップ編成でレーベルを使うのは必須ではないが、速い電撃編成に対する生存を保証してくれる。この編成は「バフ過積載」の技法を利用しており、ロザンナがレーベルの被ダメージ軽減を解除しにくくなる。

archetypes.name: Tower of Fantasy
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Label in Elysion Tower is not the best choice, but she works. She can be deployed in the usual 1-1-2-CDR comp with SolineFT. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by DWife.TEunhwa can be replaced by XBrid (might be better).
archetypes.name_ja: Tower of Fantasy（幻想のタワー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Label in Elysion Tower is not the best choice, but she works. She can be deployed in the usual 1-1-2-CDR comp with SolineFT. Substitutions: SolineFT can be replaced by DWife. TEunhwa can be replaced by XBrid (might be better).
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］エリシオンタワーでのレーベルは最良の選択ではないが、機能はする。ソリン：フロストチケットと組ませた、いつもの「1-1-2＋クールタイム短縮」編成に投入できる。差し替え：ソリン：フロストチケットはD：キラーワイフに置き換え可能。ウンファ：タクティカル・アップはブリッド：サイレントトラックに置き換え可能（そのほうが良いかもしれない）。

archetypes.name: Imagined Feasibility
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The hypothetical scenario where Label gets used in Iron-weak SR in Team 5. Substitutions: Rouge can be replaced by other CDRs.BAde can be replaced by other offensive B2. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: Imagined Feasibility（想像上の実現可能性）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The hypothetical scenario where Label gets used in Iron-weak SR in Team 5. Substitutions: Rouge can be replaced by other CDRs. BAde can be replaced by other offensive B2. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］鉄甲弱点のソロレイドで、5番目の編成にレーベルが起用されるという仮定のシナリオ。差し替え：ルージュは他のクールタイム短縮役に置き換え可能。エード：エージェントバニーは他の攻撃型B2に置き換え可能。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: How Much DR Is Desired?
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Damage Reduction stacking to make sure your team take no damage against Blanc-buffed Electric DPS.
archetypes.name_ja: How Much DR Is Desired?（被ダメージ軽減はどれだけ欲しい？）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Damage Reduction stacking to make sure your team take no damage against Blanc-buffed Electric DPS.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ブランにバフされた電撃アタッカー相手に、味方が一切ダメージを受けないようにするための被ダメージ軽減の積み上げ。

archetypes.name: Siren Hypercarry (No Crown)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Siren hypercarry comp with Crown freed for other teams (in Solo Raid). Substitutions: Label can be replaced by RH B1 or unpaired EmmaTU. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Siren Hypercarry (No Crown)（サイレンのハイパーキャリー・クラウン抜き）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The Siren hypercarry comp with Crown freed for other teams (in Solo Raid). Substitutions: Label can be replaced by RH B1 or unpaired EmmaTU. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］（ソロレイドで）クラウンを他の編成に回せるようにした、サイレンのハイパーキャリー編成。差し替え：レーベルはレッドフードのB1運用や、相方なしのエマ：タクティカル・アップに置き換え可能。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Idols Are My Hero!!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Idols grant ATK DMG▲ and Pierce DMG▲, which Lapluh's Beam loves. Their Max Ammo▲ also allows a 4× Max Ammo Lapluh to hit the optimal breakpoint. Make sure to Burst Lapluh second if she is the highest DPS in a Wind-weak content. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Idols Are My Hero!!（アイドルこそ我がヒーロー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Idols grant ATK DMG▲ and Pierce DMG▲, which Lapluh's Beam loves. Their Max Ammo▲ also allows a 4 times Max Ammo Lapluh to hit the optimal breakpoint. Make sure to Burst Lapluh second if she is the highest DPS in a Wind-weak content. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］アイドルたちは攻撃ダメージ▲と貫通ダメージ▲を与え、これはラプラス：アルティメットヒーローのビームが大好物とするものだ。彼女たちの最大装填数▲のおかげで、最大装填数4倍のラプラス：アルティメットヒーローが理想的な区切りに到達できる。風圧弱点のコンテンツで彼女が最大の火力源なら、必ず2番目にバーストさせること。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Forest Hero
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Lapluh's best B2 partner is Trina, who immensely buffs her Burst Skill ATK DMG. Together with Mom's off-burst buffs and lingering buffs from Cindy's rotation, you can expect Lapluh to deal insane damage. Max Ammo OL is needed for faster Over Energy stacking. This team is played as Rouge-Mom-Cindy, then Rouge-Trina-Lapluh, with Lapluh Bursting second. Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by any B3, but she is the only good Neutral that scales with Max HP▲. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Forest Hero（森のヒーロー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Lapluh's best B2 partner is Trina, who immensely buffs her Burst Skill ATK DMG. Together with Mom's off-burst buffs and lingering buffs from Cindy's rotation, you can expect Lapluh to deal insane damage. Max Ammo OL is needed for faster Over Energy stacking. This team is played as Rouge-Mom-Cindy, then Rouge-Trina-Lapluh, with Lapluh Bursting second. Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by any B3, but she is the only good Neutral that scales with Max HP▲. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ラプラス：アルティメットヒーローにとって最良のB2の相方はトリナで、彼女のバーストスキルの攻撃ダメージを絶大にバフする。そこにマクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニックのバースト外バフと、シンデレラのローテーションから残るバフが加われば、ラプラス：アルティメットヒーローが途方もないダメージを出すのが見込める。オーバーエネルギーを速く積むには最大装填数のオーバーロードが必要だ。この編成はルージュ→マクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニック→シンデレラ、次にルージュ→トリナ→ラプラス：アルティメットヒーローの順で回し、彼女を2番目にバーストさせる。差し替え：シンデレラは任意のB3に置き換え可能だが、最大HP▲を参照する属性を問わない優秀なユニットは彼女だけだ。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Hero's Mom
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A similar team without Trina. This team reduces Lapluh's DMG in favor of Mom's personal damage + an off-burst slot. If your Mom is heavily invested, you can go with this team. Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by any B3, but she is the only good Neutral that scales with Max HP▲. (속성: Wind)
archetypes.name_ja: Hero's Mom（ヒーローの母）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A similar team without Trina. This team reduces Lapluh's DMG in favor of Mom's personal damage plus an off-burst slot. If your Mom is heavily invested, you can go with this team. Substitutions: Cinderella can be replaced by any B3, but she is the only good Neutral that scales with Max HP▲. (Element: Wind)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］トリナを抜いた同趣旨の編成。ラプラス：アルティメットヒーローのダメージを削る代わりに、マクスウェル：オーディナリーメカニック本人の火力とバースト外の枠を得る形だ。彼女を重点的に育てているなら、この編成でよい。差し替え：シンデレラは任意のB3に置き換え可能だが、最大HP▲を参照する属性を問わない優秀なユニットは彼女だけだ。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: The Indomitable Hero
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use this team on Attack to demolish Biscuit teams that can be cheesed (not activated by avoiding damage to below 50%), unprotected Moran teams, and weaker Indom match-ups. Substitutions: HelmTr and CentiTr can be replaced as long as burst gen requirement, usually 2RL, is satisfied.
archetypes.name_ja: The Indomitable Hero（不屈のヒーロー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use this team on Attack to demolish Biscuit teams that can be cheesed (not activated by avoiding damage to below 50%), unprotected Moran teams, and weaker Indom match-ups. Substitutions: HelmTr and CentiTr can be replaced as long as burst gen requirement, usually 2RL, is satisfied.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］攻撃側でこの編成を使い、抜け道のあるビスケット編成（体力を50%未満まで削らないことで発動させない）、無防備なモラン編成、そして不屈の押し合いで劣る相手を叩き潰す。差し替え：バーストゲージ生成の要件（通常は2RL）を満たせる限り、宝ものヘルムと宝ものセンチは置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: The Immune Hero
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use this team on Attack to demolish Biscuit teams that can be cheesed (not activated by avoiding damage to below 50%), unprotected Moran teams, and weaker Indom match-ups. Substitutions: Anis: Star and HelmTr can be replaced as long as burst gen requirement, usually 2RL, is satisfied.
archetypes.name_ja: The Immune Hero（無敵のヒーロー）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Use this team on Attack to demolish Biscuit teams that can be cheesed (not activated by avoiding damage to below 50%), unprotected Moran teams, and weaker Indom match-ups. Substitutions: Anis: Star and HelmTr can be replaced as long as burst gen requirement, usually 2RL, is satisfied.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］攻撃側でこの編成を使い、抜け道のあるビスケット編成（体力を50%未満まで削らないことで発動させない）、無防備なモラン編成、そして不屈の押し合いで劣る相手を叩き潰す。差し替え：バーストゲージ生成の要件（通常は2RL）を満たせる限り、アニス：スターと宝ものヘルムは置き換え可能。

archetypes.name: Bonk Master
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is a random Campaign team example for Lapluh. She can be used as an AoE wiper with Pierce for killing enemies behind shield and cover. If invested with Max Ammo OL, she can stall for Over Energy, allowing her to nuke the stage target with the strongest Single-Target nuke in the game.
archetypes.name_ja: Bonk Master（殴打の達人）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is a random Campaign team example for Lapluh. She can be used as an AoE wiper with Pierce for killing enemies behind shield and cover. If invested with Max Ammo OL, she can stall for Over Energy, allowing her to nuke the stage target with the strongest Single-Target nuke in the game.
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ラプラス：アルティメットヒーロー向けの、キャンペーン編成の一例。彼女は貫通を持つ範囲殲滅役として使え、シールドやカバーの後ろにいる敵も倒せる。最大装填数のオーバーロードを積んで育てれば、オーバーエネルギーが溜まるまで粘ることができ、ゲーム最強の単体火力でステージ目標を吹き飛ばせる。

archetypes.name: Windy Raid ft. 4 DPS
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] For Bossing, especially Solo and Union Raids, it is ideal to pair Scarlet: Black Shadow with Maid Mast. However, in this team, we also have 3 other DPS units that ShiftUp released just for dealing damage to Wind-weak enemies. Siren, Nayuta, and Liberalio all pair up with SBS smoothly and can end up dealing insane damage so much so that it becomes worth it to move Crown to another team! Saving Crown for another team = stonks! (속성: Wind) [다른 출처의 같은 조합 설명 — "Sword, Jellyfish, Octopus"] [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Liberalio takes over the spot of Asuka: WILLE. The new and fastest team to clear Kraken (or stage 7 Kraken) (and at least till 3rd Anniversary) involves the Jellyfish buffing SBS and both of them dealing devestating damage to Kraken! Substitutions: Nayuta can be replaced by Crown. MastM can be replaced by Crown (recommended) or Helm Treasure (less recommended). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］ボス戦、とりわけソロレイドとユニオンレイドでは、紅蓮：ブラックシャドウをマスト：ロマンチックメイドと組ませるのが理想だ。ただしこの編成には、シフトアップが風圧弱点の敵にダメージを出すためだけに実装したかのようなアタッカーがさらに3人いる。サイレン、ナユタ、リバーレリオはいずれも紅蓮：ブラックシャドウと滑らかに噛み合い、最終的にはクラウンを別編成へ回す価値が生まれるほどの途方もないダメージを叩き出せる。クラウンを別編成に温存できる＝大儲けだ。（属性：風圧）［別の出典による同じ編成の説明 — 「Sword, Jellyfish, Octopus」］［出典：prydwen.gg character page］リバーレリオが式波・アスカ・ラングレー：WILLEの枠を引き継ぐ。クラーケン（あるいはステージ7のクラーケン）を（少なくとも3周年までは）最速で攻略する新しい編成は、クラゲが紅蓮：ブラックシャドウをバフし、二人がかりでクラーケンに壊滅的なダメージを与えるというものだ。差し替え：ナユタはクラウンに置き換え可能。マスト：ロマンチックメイドはクラウン（推奨）か宝ものヘルム（あまり推奨しない）に置き換え可能。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: It's Quite Windy Today
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] For Solo Raids, it is looking very plausible that the Maid Duo will babysit the Liberalio + SBS. This is because SBS simply enjoys their Distributed Damage buffs a lot, and Liberalio would enjoy their ATK, Crit, and Reload Speed buffs. Volume is used for Crit synergy and for freeing other B1, but other B1 (except Rapi: Red Hood) also work. Overall, it is a very strong contender for Wind-weak Solo Raids (and Neutral). (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Campaign Hurricane
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] These 2 DPS units, SBS and Liberalio, together provide solid performance on not just bossing, but also Campaign. Liberalio's nuke clears small mobs and paves the path for SBS to deal devestating damage to the remaining mobs. The more Liberalio kills, the more easily SBS can take down the remaining enemies. Together, they create a formidable team on any element, but will mostly be best for Wind-weak. This team may require critfishing on Liberalio's nuke to oneshot bosses (using MastM's 3-stack Burst in tandem with it is most advisable). (속성: Wind)

This team allows for funneling damage into Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose. With Ludmilla Winter Ownermilla’s Damage Taken debuff, we are offered a new type of buff multiplier, which helps Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose deal even more damage! (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Mana's new science funnel
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A typical team against Wind-weak stages. This is just a variation of the old Alice - Scarlet Black Shadow team. Mana can act here as a non-Burst B3 healer, or she can Burst herself too because her damage can pack quite a punch against Wind-weak enemies. Nevertheless, her kit excels against single targets so Bursting with her on mob stages may not be the most ideal. Noir and Sakura: Bloom in Summer are the top choices for FLEX. Do not use an SR or RL unit in FLEX spot. (속성: Wind)

archetypes.name: Alice Funnel
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Let's just say you want a fixed team for Alice, and you don't have charge speed lines on Alice (like Rental Alice), what can you do? Well, good news. Mana can solve that issue!Mana not only provides pure healing to this team, but also provides Alice with enough Charge Speed to reach 100% (assuming 10/x/10 on Alice, as well as Mana skill 2). Hence, this allows us to get 4× Ammo, 4× ATK and 4× ELE on our Alice! Just imagine how many bullets she can Fire with Bastion Cube equipped, not to mention Liter and Grave also give Max Ammo. Furthermore, if an extra buffer is desired, Rei and Maxwell can boost Alice’s damage dealt. Or, you can just slap a second DPS like Asuka (which also buffs her). D:KW is also a good alternative to Liter as she can buff Alice’s Pierce Damage. Substitutions: D: Killer Wife can replace Liter

archetypes.name: The Ultimate Stall
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team utilizes Damage Reduction to its maximum potential by combining units who can trigger Nero's passive and benefit from her "payback". In this 3 RL comp, Helm (Treasure)r, Rapunzel, and Mana continually heal the team while enjoying up to ~75% damage reduction buffs (dependent on investments, doll, and cube), whereas Moran and Nero tank for them. Nero can also gain ≥100% damage reduction here at maximum investments, meaning she will not take any damage at all for 10s after Full Burst! Not to mention, you are well-equipped with double revives, two Full Burst possibilities, charge speed bonus, and 10s lifesteal. That is some insane defense right there.Counterable by Scarlet stall teams or Snow Whiteift 2 RL teams involving Blanc + Rosanna to dispel Mana and counteract Damage Taken. Variants of this team include repositioning some units to let Rapunzel be the first B1 or to let Nero be the main tanker. Do note that Moran's Attract activates first, so she will be the one taunting primary attacks and Nero the secondary attacks as decoy (for Anis: Sparkling Summer's Ray, etc).
archetypes.name_ja: The Ultimate Stall（究極の足止め）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team utilizes Damage Reduction to its maximum potential by combining units who can trigger Nero's passive and benefit from her "payback". In this 3 RL comp, Helm (Treasure), Rapunzel, and Mana continually heal the team while enjoying up to about 75% damage reduction buffs (dependent on investments, doll, and cube), whereas Moran and Nero tank for them. Nero can also gain at least 100% damage reduction here at maximum investments, meaning she will not take any damage at all for 10s after Full Burst! Not to mention, you are well-equipped with double revives, two Full Burst possibilities, charge speed bonus, and 10s lifesteal. That is some insane defense right there. Counterable by Scarlet stall teams or swift Snow White 2 RL teams involving Blanc + Rosanna to dispel Mana and counteract Damage Taken. Variants of this team include repositioning some units to let Rapunzel be the first B1 or to let Nero be the main tanker. Do note that Moran's Attract activates first, so she will be the one taunting primary attacks and Nero the secondary attacks as decoy (for Anis: Sparkling Summer's Ray, etc).
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は、ネロの常時発動スキルを誘発でき、かつ彼女の「お返し」の恩恵を受けられるユニットを組み合わせることで、被ダメージ軽減を最大限に引き出す。この3RL編成では、（宝ものの）ヘルム、ラプンツェル、マナが編成を回復し続けながら最大でおよそ75%の被ダメージ軽減バフを享受し（育成度、ドール、キューブ次第）、モランとネロが彼女たちの盾になる。最大まで育成すればネロはここで100%以上の被ダメージ軽減を得られ、つまりフルバースト後の10秒間はまったくダメージを受けない。しかも蘇生2回、フルバースト2回分の可能性、チャージ速度ボーナス、10秒のライフスティールまで揃っている。とんでもない防御力だ。対策としては、紅蓮の足止め編成か、ブラン＋ロザンナでマナを解除し被ダメージ増加を打ち消す高速スノーホワイトの2RL編成が有効。この編成の派生形として、ラプンツェルを先頭のB1にしたり、ネロを主タンクにしたりする配置換えがある。なお、モランの引き寄せが先に発動するため、主となる攻撃を挑発するのは彼女で、ネロは（アニス：スパークリングサマーのレイなどの）二次的な攻撃を引き受ける囮になる点には注意。

archetypes.name: Admire Captain's Fweeeet!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team uses MirandaTr's guaranteed crit to buff SMarci's S1 Nuke, together with Nayuta's and HelmTr's Burst Gen/ATK DMG (which SMarci lacks in buffing department) and SHelm's Damage Taken + CDR. Substitutions: Nayuta can be replaced by other B2 buffers, such as Ade: Agent Bunny. Helm: Aquamarine can be replaced by any off-burst CDR, but the team will be noticeably weaker. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: Admire Captain's Fweeeet!（キャプテンのホイッスルに聞き惚れろ）

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は宝ものミランダの確定クリティカルでマルチャーナ：マリンスタディのスキル1の一撃をバフし、そこにナユタと宝ものヘルムのバーストゲージ生成・攻撃ダメージ（マルチャーナ：マリンスタディがバフ面で欠いている要素）と、ヘルム：アクアマリンの被ダメージ増加＋クールタイム短縮を重ねる。差し替え：ナユタはエード：エージェントバニーのような他のB2バッファーに置き換え可能。ヘルム：アクアマリンは任意のバースト外クールタイム短縮役に置き換え可能だが、編成は目に見えて弱くなる。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Red Wolf's Fweeeet!
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Same team but replaces HelmTr with Red Hood or other DPS, which may yield higher team damage despite SMarci's lower personal damage. Pay attention to the team's burst gen rate and ensure you bring at least 1 battery. Substitutions: Ade: Agent Bunny can be replaced by other B2 buffers, such as Nayuta, who has healing. Red Hood can be replaced by other DPS such as Milk: Blooming Bunny. Helm: Aquamarine can be replaced by any off-burst CDR, but the team will be noticeably weaker. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: Red Wolf's Fweeeet!（赤いオオカミのホイッスル）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Same team but replaces HelmTr with Red Hood or other DPS, which may yield higher team damage despite SMarci's lower personal damage. Pay attention to the team's burst gen rate and ensure you bring at least 1 battery. Substitutions: Ade: Agent Bunny can be replaced by other B2 buffers, such as Nayuta, who has healing. Red Hood can be replaced by other DPS such as Milk: Blooming Bunny. Helm: Aquamarine can be replaced by any off-burst CDR, but the team will be noticeably weaker. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］同じ編成だが、宝ものヘルムをレッドフードや他のアタッカーに差し替えた形。マルチャーナ：マリンスタディ本人の火力は落ちるものの、編成全体のダメージはこちらのほうが高くなり得る。編成のバーストゲージ生成速度に気を配り、バッテリー役を最低1人は入れること。差し替え：エード：エージェントバニーは、回復を持つナユタなど他のB2バッファーに置き換え可能。レッドフードはミルク：ブルーミングバニーのような他のアタッカーに置き換え可能。ヘルム：アクアマリンは任意のバースト外クールタイム短縮役に置き換え可能だが、編成は目に見えて弱くなる。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: Snow White + Miranda Variation
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this version, Snow White Bursts first and easily gets her final extra 7th Burst off, compared to the rush you have to deal with in the Snow White-Yulha combo. Delaying the first Burst to get both Mari's and Dolla's ATK buffs is a valid strategy to min-max damage. S. Helm substitutes Dolla against Iron-Weak for even more damage! Mari and Helm provide enough Burst gen for the team. (속성: Iron)
archetypes.name_ja: Snow White + Miranda Variation（スノーホワイト＋ミランダ型）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this version, Snow White Bursts first and easily gets her final extra 7th Burst off, compared to the rush you have to deal with in the Snow White-Yulha combo. Delaying the first Burst to get both Mari's and Dolla's ATK buffs is a valid strategy to min-max damage. S. Helm substitutes Dolla against Iron-Weak for even more damage! Mari and Helm provide enough Burst gen for the team. (Element: Iron)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この型ではスノーホワイトが最初にバーストし、スノーホワイト＋ユルハの組み合わせで強いられるような急ぎ回しをせずとも、最後の7回目のバーストを楽に撃ち切れる。真希波・マリ・イラストリアスとドラーの攻撃力バフを両方乗せるために最初のバーストを遅らせるのは、ダメージを詰めるうえで有効な戦略だ。鉄甲弱点相手ならドラーをヘルム：アクアマリンに差し替えると、さらにダメージが伸びる。バーストゲージ生成は真希波・マリ・イラストリアスとヘルムで十分足りる。（属性：鉄甲）

archetypes.name: The Normal Pierce Team
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has everything: 2 strong DPS who scale stupidly hard with Mari's buffs, a CDR, a B2 buffer, and one more slot reserved for healing/protection or Off-Burst DPS/support. If you use Privaty and Dorothy instead of D here, you can have a budget Crown Naga team. Asuka may also fit in but will be less effective compared to the above mentioned units. It is also worth mentioning that Alice is a better fit with Crown and is even better fitted alongside her best buddy, Scarlet: Black Shadow, who needs her Charge Speed to drastically increase her already insane DPS. Hence, we might not see Alice together with Mari unless it is in Campaign and you do not have Crown or Tia-Naga.Since it is possible to use Mari as an Off-Burst buffer, you can also insert Crown here and use Crown's Burst Skill instead. This strategy might be effective against Ultra, where you need to reach Stage 4 before or right upon destroying the Boss's first Core (time gated).
archetypes.name_ja: The Normal Pierce Team（普通の貫通編成）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team has everything: 2 strong DPS who scale stupidly hard with Mari's buffs, a CDR, a B2 buffer, and one more slot reserved for healing/protection or Off-Burst DPS/support. If you use Privaty and Dorothy instead of D here, you can have a budget Crown Naga team. Asuka may also fit in but will be less effective compared to the above mentioned units. It is also worth mentioning that Alice is a better fit with Crown and is even better fitted alongside her best buddy, Scarlet: Black Shadow, who needs her Charge Speed to drastically increase her already insane DPS. Hence, we might not see Alice together with Mari unless it is in Campaign and you do not have Crown or Tia-Naga. Since it is possible to use Mari as an Off-Burst buffer, you can also insert Crown here and use Crown's Burst Skill instead. This strategy might be effective against Ultra, where you need to reach Stage 4 before or right upon destroying the Boss's first Core (time gated).
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成には必要なものが全部ある。真希波・マリ・イラストリアスのバフで馬鹿げたほど伸びる強力なアタッカー2人、クールタイム短縮役、B2バッファー、そして回復・防護かバースト外のアタッカー／サポーターのための枠がもう一つ。ここでDの代わりにプリバティとドロシーを使えば、廉価版のクラウン＋ナガ編成になる。アスカも収まりはするが、前述のユニットと比べると効果は落ちる。それからアリスはクラウンとの相性のほうが良く、さらに言えば相棒の紅蓮：ブラックシャドウと並べるのが最も良い。彼女はすでに凄まじいDPSをさらに跳ね上げるためにアリスのチャージ速度を必要とするからだ。したがって、キャンペーンでクラウンもティア＋ナガも持っていない場合を除けば、アリスと真希波・マリ・イラストリアスが同席する場面はあまりないだろう。真希波・マリ・イラストリアスはバースト外のバッファーとしても使えるので、ここにクラウンを入れて代わりにクラウンのバーストスキルを使う手もある。この戦略は、ボスの最初のコアを破壊する前か、破壊した直後にステージ4へ到達する必要がある（時間制限のある）ウルトラ相手に有効かもしれない。

archetypes.name: 3RL Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Mari is used as a simple damage buffer for nukes. Scarlet or Rei can be replaced by any fast nuker DPS. Red Hood is used as a B1 unit to buff both Mari's and the nuker's AoE. The special assist from Mari comes when she uses her Burst Skill!
archetypes.name_ja: 3RL Nuke（3RLの爆撃）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Mari is used as a simple damage buffer for nukes. Scarlet or Rei can be replaced by any fast nuker DPS. Red Hood is used as a B1 unit to buff both Mari's and the nuker's AoE. The special assist from Mari comes when she uses her Burst Skill!
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］真希波・マリ・イラストリアスは、爆撃向けの単純なダメージバッファーとして使う。紅蓮やレイは、素早く爆撃できるアタッカーなら何にでも置き換えられる。レッドフードはB1として、真希波・マリ・イラストリアスと爆撃役の両方の範囲攻撃をバフするために使う。真希波・マリ・イラストリアスの特別な援護は、彼女がバーストスキルを使ったときに現れる。

archetypes.name: El Macho Venciendo Kraken
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] A lot of players will have an easier time with Kraken once Macho duos are released. It’s because although Kraken has a Core, Scarlet Black Shadow won’t have access to it half of the time, making Naga quite obsolete. In exchange, Mast will give Scarlet Black Shadow a huge Distributed Damage buff very early on, while preventing Alice losing Ammo too with the 109% reload speed. This comp is definitely the strongest Wind Weak comp, it doesn't matter if the Boss has a Core or not. Substitutions: Replace Anchor with Crown if you want to tank the shockwave (속성: Wind)

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］マッチョ・デュオが実装されれば、多くのプレイヤーにとってクラーケン戦はぐっと楽になる。クラーケンにはコアがあるものの、紅蓮：ブラックシャドウは半分の時間それを狙えないため、ナガがほぼ無用の長物になるからだ。代わりにマストは、ごく早い段階で紅蓮：ブラックシャドウに巨大な分配ダメージバフを与えつつ、109%のリロード速度でアリスの装填数の目減りも防いでくれる。この編成は、ボスにコアがあろうとなかろうと、間違いなく最強の風圧弱点編成だ。差し替え：衝撃波を受け止めたいならアンカー：イノセントメイドをクラウンに差し替える。（属性：風圧）

archetypes.name: Cingodrella
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Electric funneling comp but with new variation featuring duo Macho. The fun part of this comp is that all ATK buffs are caster’s ATK, so it is not affected by Cindy’s lower base ATK stat. Hence, their buffs to Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose will remain as effective. Depending on the Boss type, distance, and element, they may be able to compete with the popular Electric funneling comp, and you get more heals. (속성: Electric)
archetypes.name_ja: Cingodrella（シンデレラ・エル・マッチョ）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Electric funneling comp but with new variation featuring duo Macho. The fun part of this comp is that all ATK buffs are caster's ATK, so it is not affected by Cindy's lower base ATK stat. Hence, their buffs to Cinderella and Maiden: Ice Rose will remain as effective. archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］電撃の火力集約編成だが、マッチョ・デュオを据えた新しい型。この編成の面白いところは、攻撃力バフがすべて「使用者自身の攻撃力」を参照する形式なので、シンデレラの低い基礎攻撃力に影響されない点だ。したがって、シンデレラとメイデン：アイスローズへのバフは効果を保つ。ボスの種類、距離、属性によっては、人気の電撃集約編成と張り合える可能性があり、しかも回復量はこちらが上だ。（属性：電撃）

archetypes.name: Rosy’s Revenge
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This comp is 3 RL, but Rosanna will be buffed with Mast’s Crit Rate and ATK, which makes it easier to confirm kills with Burst. A variation of Scarlet - Anne: Miracle Fairy - Rosanna comp without healing/reviving.
archetypes.name_ja: Rosy's Revenge（ロージーの復讐）

archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成は3RLだが、ロザンナがマストのクリティカル率と攻撃力でバフされるので、バーストでの確殺が取りやすくなる。紅蓮＋エヌ：ミラクルフェアリー＋ロザンナ編成から回復と蘇生を抜いた派生形だ。

archetypes.name: Triple Moms? No, Quadruple.
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] Weaker than FloraT's and Crown's version, but if you use both of them somewhere else, Mom or Nayuta is the next best choice. (속성: Electric)

archetypes.name: Cheap 2RL Siren + Lib Nuke
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] The perfect 100% burst gen 2RL Attack team without too many meta units. Note that Liberalio's burst gen is reduced against decoys and shielded P5.

archetypes.name: Crown Fire Team ft. Rapipi & Mihara
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] One of Mihara’s best teams for Non-Core Fire. This team has healing, high burst generation, and continuous single-target damage that's admirable against targets without core. Mihara also bursts second, which is her optimal rotation. Stable and reliable, although it might be outshone in core environments. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Fire)

archetypes.name: Mono Fire ft. Grave (No Core)
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] In this team, Mihara: Bonding Chain acts as an off-burst character that deals continuous damage without having to do anything. Against single targets, her off-burst damage surpasses Modernia's. However, you should use her Burst Skill at least once toward the end for some extra damage out of her DoT. Substitutions: Siren can be replaced by Liter. (속성: Fire)

They are also all Fire units, which benefit from the compounding effect they apply to one another. Substitutions: Crown can be replaced by Grave. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］この編成のミハラ：ボンディングチェーンは1番目か2番目にバーストし（好みで選んでよい。自分の育成状況でどちらが多くダメージを出すか試してほしい）、クラウンまたはグレイブ、ラピ：レッドフード、綾波レイにバフされる主力アタッカーとなる。全員が灼熱ユニットでもあるため、互いにかけ合う効果が積み重なる恩恵も受けられる。差し替え：クラウンはグレイブに置き換え可能。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) I
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An alternative Fire Team against core enemies for players without a built Alice. This team revolves around boosting the team's Core Damage and buff inflation in general. Asuka can be hot-swappable with Alice, though it's less optimal in equal investments. Substitutions: Asuka-Shikinami-Langley can be replaced by Alice. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Alternative Fire (Core) I（灼熱の別案・コアあり I）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] An alternative Fire Team against core enemies for players without a built Alice. This team revolves around boosting the team's Core Damage and buff inflation in general. Asuka can be hot-swappable with Alice, though it's less optimal in equal investments. Substitutions: Asuka Shikinami Langley can be replaced by Alice. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］アリスを育てていないプレイヤー向けの、コアを持つ敵に対する灼熱編成の別案。編成全体のコアダメージを底上げし、バフを盛り込むことを軸にしている。アスカはアリスとそのまま交換できるが、育成度が同等ならアリスのほうが最適だ。差し替え：式波・アスカ・ラングレーはアリスに置き換え可能。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) II
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is similar to BiS non-core team, which uses HelmTr, but replaces her with Naga/Mast Maid, which may potentially be better against targets with core. (속성: Fire)
archetypes.name_ja: Alternative Fire (Core) II（灼熱の別案・コアあり II）
archetypes.note_en: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team is similar to BiS non-core team, which uses HelmTr, but replaces her with Naga/Mast Maid, which may potentially be better against targets with core. (Element: Fire)
archetypes.note_ja: ［出典：prydwen.gg character page］宝ものヘルムを使うコアなし相手の最適編成に近い形だが、彼女をナガやマスト：ロマンチックメイドに差し替えている。コアを持つ相手にはそちらのほうが良い可能性がある。（属性：灼熱）

archetypes.name: Alternative Fire (Core) III
archetypes.note: [Source: prydwen.gg character page] This team doesn't have any healing and exchanges it for more damage. Mast Maid provides the team with increased ATK, CRTs, and Reload Speed. She also synergizes with Siren. Do note that you want to only Burst with her at either 2 or 3 stacks of Drunken. (속성: Fire)
